chapters.title: Chapter 3480 Are You Free? IV
paragraphs: Bob portrayed the images of the two beings clearly before the man standing above a radiant sea as he spoke out coldly.

"These two creatures acted from orders under you to ensure that someone else entered the Purgatory Lands. It was an event that initiated a Point of Unraveling that has led to utterly drastic and disastrous changes as of now."
"Now, I cannot seem to find these two, so it just leads me to come to you- the one responsible for giving the order. May I ask just what prompted you to do something like this?"
His question was a simple one.
The man who heard it had a complex expression as he stared at the image of the woman between the two entities that Bob had portrayed.
He seemed to feel a mixture of guilt and relief at Bob's words as he sighed.
"Would you believe me if I told you that this was not my own doing? That even I was following the orders of someone else without knowing what they would lead to?"
His eyes looked distraught and filled with unknown weavings of complexity as Bob looked towards him coldly!
"You, who sits on the Council of the Logos of the Wheel, was following the orders of another? Do you mind enlightening me as to who this another is?"
His gaze was cold. His figure had begun cracking with boundless weavings of authority.
But at such a time...
HUUUM!
A burst of authority radiated outwards as behind the figure of the Council Member of the Logos the Wheel, another entity appeared!
The appearance of this entity caused Bob's eyes to become unfathomably sharp as he was someone that Bob knew.
Someone that Bob had just been with not too long ago!
This Entity who looked like a wizened old man looked towards Bob and spoke out while shaking his head and tapping out towards the Council Member near him.

"You never could just leave things alone, Bob. Do there always have to be answers? At times, I think it is better when things are left to the unknown. When mysteries remain a mystery. When there aren't always clear answers to every single thing."
He had only tapped out towards the council member, and yet this being who had a terrifying Source Complexity found his mouth disappearing while his weavings became entirely locked down!
His eyes showed an ashen expression of shock and incredulity as an instant later, he was wrapped up in an undeniable light as he disappeared!
The one responsible for this looked towards Bob calmly as around him, space began to distort as other figures also appeared. The wizened old man....was none other than the Great Sage!
Bob looked towards him and the complexities of other entities currently appearing as his eyes became exceedingly cold and callous. The Great Sage.
A Watcher of the Wheelomachy!
He appeared at this juncture as, behind him, entities filled with unique and eerie complexities appeared one by one as there were nine in number.

What was even more unique was that these entities were covered in obsidian armaments, with their heads showing no facial features as only a single brilliant vertical white band of light could be seen!

And it wasn't just this as towards his left and right, space distorted as on one side, a massive entity that looked like a round singularity radiating thousands of obsidian tentacles all around appeared.

Behind it, variations of similar obsidian armored entities with vertical white bands on their faceless heads could also be seen. Another group appeared to his right with similar get ups, and behind him...
WUUU!
A gorgeous woman palpating with weavings of power appeared, her body adorned in multiple golden jewels, crystals, and necklaces as she glittered from head to toe.
It was Persephael of the Watchers of the Wheelomachy.
She also had the unknown Faceless Entities behind her as at this moment, they entirely surrounded Bob.
Looking at all of them, Bob turned silent and introspective as he grabbed his chin and spoke.

"Members of the Wheelomachy, and the Logos of the Wheel working hand in hand, and now you have these unknown vile creatures behind you. I almost want to ask why. I almost want to ask for the reason behind all of this. What you all could possibly hope to achieve with everything that you have already attained with existence. If the reason for this is greater complexity, I ask you, even after you attain that...do you think it will be enough? You already sit atop the Frequencies of the Wheel, observing and seeing the countless complexities of existence. If even this was not fulfilling for you, do you truly think your voracious complexities would ever be fulfilled?"
He uttered out his words calmly as if he was not just surrounded by an unknown number of terrifyingly powerful complex existences. A heavy silence fell in the surroundings as nobody spoke.
The Great Sage looked contemplative as Persephael only shook her head.
"You are right. No reason for questions and answers. Just know that you stood as an obstacle to something, and that obstacle needs to be cleared."
WAA!
As she spoke, her surroundings glittered with dazzling gems and crystals as a terrifying complexity was about to erupt from her.
Bob looked towards her and others in the surroundings as he shook his head with a sigh.
"You seem to have prepared a great deal. Do you think all of this will be enough to kill me?"
His words were so calm that one would think he was asking about the weather. And yet towards his words, everyone here became grim as the Great Sage shook his head.
"Killing you would be far, far too hard. Containing a majority of your complexity here though...that is manageable."
With those words...
BOOM!
Everything exploded.

The scene that Noah was observing and feeling as if he was at the center where Bob experienced all of these things shattered. His eyes were somber, and the illusory screen between them faded away as Bob looked towards him calmly.

"I am currently bound and held down without being able to move much. The Watchers of the Wheelomachy... I do not know who among them is compromised. I also do not know the extent to which the Logos of the Wheel is compromised."

"Thus, I have to turn towards other sources to see if they can help. Others who may be able to ride this erupting chaos like never before and possibly restore a semblance of order to it. I come to you to ask whether you are willing. It will be incredibly dangerous, with those you come across being Pioneers and Source Complexity entities that have waded across Existence for cycles. You may gain something, or you may not. You may achieve something, or you may not. The results are completely unclear."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3481 The Wheelomachy! I
paragraphs: The results were completely unclear as he may be able to achieve something, or achieve nothing!
He could live through it gloriously, or he could die under the weight of complexity.
Bob was sure to state this with clarity as truly, much about what would soon unfold...was unknown.
His singularities were calm.
Almost as if he wasn't currently under siege by multiple terrifying existences!
He looked towards Ozymandias as he continued.

"They tried to peer into you before, but I turned their attention away for the most part when they questioned the single Existence Severing entity that was waging a war against Pioneers. But since you were involved within this Point of Origin where existence unraveled, they're likely to send their forces after you- or a version of you. Be ready and prepared for something like this. What choice will you make?"
Choices.
As always, it came down to a choice that Noah himself had to make.
Bob looked out to the shattered weavings of existence all around them as his voice echoed out mesmerizingly.
"You could very well choose to walk away. That might even be a wise choice. But I will need to know soon if that is the case so that I can make other preparations."
It was a choice, but the matter was time sensitive.
And yet in the span of an instant, millions of calculations and thoughts could be computed as Noah's weavings had long since come to a decision.

"I am willing. Although I don't know how much help I will be when it comes to these entities that have already attained their Source complexity far too long ago. I have only just recently Severed the Weavings of my Existence."
Yes.
The enemies were truly far too big.

"Does that not make it more fun? There's increasing chaos and disorder, and the possible collapse of the Wheel of Existence as the end goal of this unknown force, but it doesn't have to be all doom and gloom, right?"
Far too distant!
And yet towards such a reality, Bob smiled.

"Does that not make it more fun? There's increasing chaos and disorder, and the possible collapse of the Wheel of Existence as the end goal of this unknown force, but it doesn't have to be all doom and gloom, right?"
WAA!
The eyes of Ozymandias flashed coldly.
"The collapse of the Wheel of Existence?"
He had to ask.
And Bob only waved his hands dismissively as he replied.

"Just a possible theory among many that I have as to what exactly could set off people that I have known for eons to leave behind everything they preached. But what matters the most is understanding the why. The why...is always the crux to everything. For what is all of this occurring? Why should this Change occur? Why and how did others jump off the threads of this Change to use it to their advantage? And last but not least, who the fuck are these Faceless Lifeforms, and why are we only seeing them now for the first time?"

There were a great deal of things to understand regarding what had happened and what would be coming. Bob shook his head as he asked all of this, his singularity coming to focus on Ozymandias once more.

"I do not have much time as my weavings continue to be sealed even now. To be prepared for what is to come since you are up to the task, you will need to understand the origins of many things and increase your complexity. I stem from the Wheelomachy. I have been a Watcher of the Wheelomachy for as long as I can remember. There is very little that I kept from them, but I of course had a cautious nature. I hid a shred of myself- completely separate from the current me as they will not be able to seal that part of me, but it lies dormant and weak in another Frequency of Existence. That will need to be woken up if I am to be of any help in the future to come. But to get to that Frequency...you will have to use the channels of the Wheelomachy."
The Channels of the Wheelomachy!

"Established Channels through different Frequencies of Existence. To access them, you will need to enter the Palaces of the Wheelomachy that stand veiled in the highest edges of the Expanse- into areas that mainly those of the Source Complexity could easily access. It will be arduous, but you will have to find a way into these domains and not be captured by any Watchers as I truly cannot say who has been turned or not. It will also be within my domains as you may even have enemies wading through them to ensure I am sealed. Here are some secret pathways I enacted myself into the Palaces of the Wheelomachy within this Frequency, along with the information on which Frequency you will need to reach where my dormant isolated self is hidden, and other miscellaneous things that may be of use..."
Bob tapped his finger out as threads of gold light unfurled and flowed towards Ozymandias.
Records.
Information.

"The Wheelomachy...was something that I now realize I took great pride in. It gave me a great sense of purpose. The one who introduced me to it...was a great woman. She taught me purpose and direction of complexity. A modus operandi for life. I had her teach me for many years just what it meant to be a Watcher. I learned...from the First Watcher of the Wheelomachy."
WAA!
His singularities seemed despondent and filled with complex emotions as if he was recalling a distant past.
But he continued nonetheless.

"I do not ask of you to be a Watcher of the Wheelomachy, but you following this path would fit the description that she set down when she first taught me. You would fit the description to be her Great Disciple. The Great Disciple of the First Water, just second in line after me. Well, that is if you do not die and get your weavings of complexity utterly obliterated in the chaos to come. After all, you have to be alive to enjoy your distinctions, right?"
As he said this.
Bob's body began to splinter and crack!

chapters.title: Chapter 3482 The Wheelomachy! II
paragraphs: The visage of someone unfathomably powerful...was splitting apart and beginning to fade.

"Those assholes really planned well. Especially those Faceless Entities you observed in that scene. They seem to hold a sort of complexity that is resistant to The Change that has begun spreading with this Frequency as the Source. Take caution against them when you do come across them. I do not fully grasp your level of complexity, but it is possible for anyone who has Severed their weavings of existence and then Pioneered their own path to potentially leave a Frequency of Existence. If a path is available for them. If they have unique means. For you, if you can access the paths I set within the Wheelomachy, they can lead you to anywhere you wish to go. As of this moment onward, you can take and consider yourself distinguished as a Watcher of the Wheelomachy. Not just any Watcher, but one of Direct Descent from the First Watcher of the Wheelomachy who passed her weavings to me. That is if you wish to take on this distinction. And if I have one last piece of advice for you..."
His singularities turned melancholic and filled with complexity.
A last piece of advice.
As he said this, his lower half began to shatter and fade away while his voice was just as resonant.

"Everyone seems to be chasing after more and more complexity. To get closer and closer to the Wheel. If this is the only drive one has- just an endless need to increase the complexity of existence, you will come to find that it never ends. You will always want more no matter what you achieve. Your life...would never have that sense of fulfillment and happiness."
WAA!

"Do you know who I envy? The farmer who wakes up daily to tend to his fields. No recognition of Mana, Extremes, or weavings of existence. Just a mundane life where they live every day doing what they love. There are hardships here and there. Sickness. Loss. But at the end of the day, they live a century of fulfillment before they die peacefully. I envy the quintillions of entities out there whose lives are filled with simplicity- who are not seeking a constant drive for greater complexity. The more complex our existences become, the more entwined we seem to ever increasing problems. That...is our burden to bear. But for you my friend, I would advise you to find simplicity. Fulfillment for you to enjoy this fickle weaving of life now, and not as some distant goal in the future. After all, the future is not guaranteed."
HUUUM!
His visage began to shake and dissipate.
His round head glistened in the fractured space as he looked towards Ozymandias for a few more seconds before...he entirely disappeared.
His words buzzed within Noah's weavings. Fulfillment.
Contentment!
Every single entity was just constantly chasing for greater and greater complexity as many never stopped to think about anything else.
Noah genuinely loved the feeling whenever he did make advancements, whenever he understood more about the mysteries of power and complexity.
This was part of his contentment. He also had other things that he never gave up no matter how complex he became.
His family.
His women.

The mundane action of intimacy he had with his women- he never left it behind as this was also part of his fulfillment. While he was stuck in Hell Terra Firma as existence unraveled around him, did he not enjoy this fulfillment with Barbatos?
So when it came to a sense of happiness and contentment, Noah's weavings did not leave companionship behind.
But there was one thing he thought of that he had not gone around to doing.

It may seem like years ago when mere days and weeks had passed, but he had envisioned that when he reached a level of power where he did not have to worry about others harming him or those he loved, he would retire to be a farmer and just enjoy his days!
Every day, he seemed to be reaching a new level of power.
But his enemies also became stronger with every passing day.
Threats became more and more immense with every passing day!
If it continued like this, would he not be forever waiting for that day to retire on some fantastical farm that would never exist?
He watched Bob dissipate entirely as this being left him with bundles of information regarding the Expanse, the Wheelomachy, the Logos of the Wheel, and more as a truly arduous road lay ahead!

Did he have to always keep the end goal he only imagined towards a peaceful end that may never come? What stopped him from doing it now even amidst all of this chaos? There was nothing denying him of this as he nodded while thinking of his next steps.
Around him, the veiled cluster of shattered space began to unravel as the memories and bundles of information from Bob all flowed throughout his weavings.
Many things had occurred.

The Change that many people felt was coming bloomed as Noah was either a core figure in its initiation or simply one of the figures that contributed to this Change as his first entrance and exit into Hell Terra Firma had given free reign.
Akin to a spark lighting up dry leaves in a forest, and now a fire was spreading rapidly all around.
But the stage had already been prepared. Dried branches and leaves were stretched out across this Frequency and other Frequencies of the Wheel.
And as the Weavings of Existence began to burn, those who were always there to watch it or aid in its correction were currently preoccupied in their own musings of war.
The Logos of the Wheel was compromised alongside the Watchers of the Wheelomachy!
And in the middle of all of this, the appearance of unknown Faceless Entities embroiled in the midst of all of this chaos.

Now, Noah had to pick apart and face all of this all, all the while dealing with his own aims of expansion into the Purgatory Lands as he obtained enough fuel to elevate his own increasing Complexity of Existence!
The stage was set, and now there was only magnificence to follow....

While he was stuck in Hell Terra Firma as existence unraveled around him, did he not enjoy this fulfillment with Barbatos?
So when it came to a sense of happiness and contentment, Noah's weavings did not leave companionship behind.
But there was one thing he thought of that he had not gone around to doing.

It may seem like years ago when mere days and weeks had passed, but he had envisioned that when he reached a level of power where he did not have to worry about others harming him or those he loved, he would retire to be a farmer and just enjoy his days!
Every day, he seemed to be reaching a new level of power.
But his enemies also became stronger with every passing day.
Threats became more and more immense with every passing day!
If it continued like this, would he not be forever waiting for that day to retire on some fantastical farm that would never exist?
He watched Bob dissipate entirely as this being left him with bundles of information regarding the Expanse, the Wheelomachy, the Logos of the Wheel, and more as a truly arduous road lay ahead!
Did he have to always keep the end goal he only imagined towards a peaceful end that may never come?
What stopped him from doing it now even amidst all of this chaos?
There was nothing denying him of this as he nodded while thinking of his next steps.
Around him, the veiled cluster of shattered space began to unravel as the memories and bundles of information from Bob all flowed throughout his weavings.
Many things had occurred.

The Change that many people felt was coming bloomed as Noah was either a core figure in its initiation or simply one of the figures that contributed to this Change as his first entrance and exit into Hell Terra Firma had given free reign.
Akin to a spark lighting up dry leaves in a forest, and now a fire was spreading rapidly all around.
But the stage had already been prepared.
Dried branches and leaves were stretched out across this Frequency and other Frequencies of the Wheel.
And as the Weavings of Existence began to burn, those who were always there to watch it or aid in its correction were currently preoccupied in their own musings of war.
The Logos of the Wheel was compromised alongside the Watchers of the Wheelomachy!
And in the middle of all of this, the appearance of unknown Faceless Entities embroiled in the midst of all of this chaos.

Now, Noah had to pick apart and face all of this all, all the while dealing with his own aims of expansion into the Purgatory Lands as he obtained enough fuel to elevate his own increasing Complexity of Existence!
The stage was set, and now there was only magnificence to follow....

chapters.title: Chapter 3483 The Wheelomachy! III
paragraphs: The Expanse.
A once gorgeous place filled with golden Strings of Existence stretching throughout!

Now, many of these strings had snapped or seemed deteriorated, their brilliance heavily gone as the surroundings were filled with tendrils of gray light that seemed to greatly lower the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence.
At this moment.
CRACK!
The bright Blancverse holding a core force of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse had a crack emerge on it, its brilliance dimming greatly!

Near it, the Great Mother had a complex expression as she looked out towards the area where the Instrument of the Beyonder had been enclosed in, but his figure was gradually appearing as the tentacles of the Great Mother called out.
|O Great Instrument! Something is occurring in the Megalos Beyond! Something even heavier than here!|
She let out all her reservations and called out.
It mattered not if he truly had the Resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
He was still Ozymandias.
He was still the Instrument she followed!
And at this moment, something that caused her to even feel a sense of terror was occurring within the Megalos, her connections telling her many things.
So she called out to the Great Instrument.
And...
HUUUM!
Space distorted as he appeared right before her tentacled form.
The sensation that she felt was...that of great pressure. As if a stifling being of pure power was standing before her!
This...was the same lifeform that the Observer of Old and Young had brought before her mere days ago?
Standing before him, she didn't let the heavy sense of pressure emanating from him cause her to feel lesser, but she instead felt even more exhilaration as she continued.

|O Great Instrument...let me be the first to congratulate you on your grand rise in power and ask for your aid and brilliance to shine over the Megalos Beyond as foretold by the Great Beyonder! At this moment, I am receiving weavings that in different areas, terrifying and brutal Faceless Entities have appeared as they massacre our people and erect Towers from their bodies that radiate complex domains of oppression!|
WAA!
She called out to him for help.

She didn't think to send word to the grand Palaces of the Expanse where Existence Severing Outerversal Morphons and Pioneer Great Ones might be- because these very same beings had stood against the Great Instrument of the Beyonder just recently for their own aims.
They were merely Heretics.
So she looked up towards the promised being as he looked down at her, his weavings erupting out silently to wrap around her as he nodded.
|Let's go.|
Without fear. Without asking for benefits.
He moved.
The Great Mother watched such an unfolding weaving as her convictions became ever stronger!
The figures disappeared as they left behind the Blancverses of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse- those within them filled with chaotic weavings as they reacted to the Changes around them!
Away from this region, away from the Expanse entirely.
Megalos Ynerre.
In the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
At the center of the illusory Extremity Vein that had the Frequency Gateway underneath it.
A ring of a cerulean Aletheian Haven of pure mana could be seen at the very center of the Extremity Vein!
Inside of this ring.
Layers of stellar blue rivers flowed in the surroundings as they seemed to isolate any possible effects of the Change that was affecting everything across the Megalos and the Expanse.
Uniquely, it was not just within this haven, but even within the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed, the effects of reduced Atmospheric Weavings of Existence were minimal if any at all!
This was because no one's connection to the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and the very pillars of authorities that made it up... were truly severed from existence.
The sheer implications of this were far too grand to have even portrayed themselves yet, with the boons of true severing still only just showing a small part of themselves at this moment.

So within that cerulean haven, boundless stellar rivers seethed and continued to bloom every second as the concentration of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence had risen to terrifying levels, and it was all filled with Mana!
This Mana Haven did not contain much within it apart from these stellar rivers and seas of potent authority, with the only thing being a small world at its very center.
A small blue world brimming with life as currently, the figure of Noah and the Infiniverse Megalos Body were the only ones here.
They were located in an area filled with the aura of abundant life, with a small wooden structure standing tall while surrounded by many plots nearby.
A Ranch.
Surrounded by dazzling fertile land and radiant streams of rivers nearby.
Small clusters of floating islands hung in the skies, white gold clouds permeating through them as they looked like ornamental stars.
It was a gorgeous scene as in front of the empty plots of farmland, Noah could be seen standing serenely with a sense of peace!
His body was adorned in loose white pants and an unbuttoned white shirt, a straw hat on his head as his whole body glimmered with complex radiance.

Not too far from him, the Infiniverse Megalos Body held a gold basket with her two hands as she was adorned with a simple white dress filled with musings of runes, her eyes bright as her expression held a wry smile.

Noah had an expression of contentment as a Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel was held in his hand as he looked at all of this. A simple ranch behind him, cultivated plots rich with mana in front of him.
Even in the midst of erupting chaos.
Even as it seemed existence was burning!
Nothing prevented him from living his dream.
Farming.
"I have seeds of all sorts of spiritual herbs used in the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, Master."
Beside him, the Infiniverse Megalos Body walked forward while bringing the golden basket forward, but Noah shook his head.
"From this day onward, I will live my little dream of peacefully retiring on a farm, but I will not be planting mere seeds of just anything."
WAA!
As he spoke, his body began to light up with countless complex weavings of brilliance.
Loot. Cheats. Protagonist. Quintessence. Infinity!
Many severed weavings of existence bloomed as Noah's figure looked like an ancient king waking up to see his lands!
"I will be cultivating Seeds of Existence itself and see what sprouts."

chapters.title: Chapter 3484 The Wheelomachy! IV
paragraphs: The cultivation of Seeds of Existence themselves!
Noah spoke such grand words as he waved his hands and caused the appearance of pieces of bodies of Pioneers and Existence Severing entities to appear en masse above.
Moments later, they began to flow down and sink into the plots of earth seamlessly.
"For fertilizer, there should be abundant mana and the dredges of Existence Severing entities and Pioneers that have built up their existence for eons."

The fertilizer- the fuel alone for the things that he would cultivate were the records and weavings of entities that had severed their own existence and even Pioneered their paths as they searched for a source!
As for the seeds...
His right hand rose as on his palm, incandescent blue light gathered until it formed a singularity.
It was a Severed Seed of Mana.

What he was cultivating was himself. His aspects. His concepts. Enriched in his own severed weavings of existence, the weavings of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and of the Megalos themselves...just what would he be able to pluck at the end of it all? The blue singularity in his hands floated out and sank into the center of the first plot before Noah- the intense waves of complexity within it being suffocating as at this time, a simple white gold throne rose from the earth behind Noah as he sat down.
He closed his eyes.
From his body, countless threads of severed weavings were visualized as they stemmed from him and spread out over the throne and the earth, going towards many different directions.

One thread was connected to the singularity he just planted. This thread was getting brighter and brighter as he continued to fill it with authority, weavings of Cheats, Loot, Quintessence, and many others flowing into it with unfathomable purity and grandeur.

If one looked at Noah right now, they would only observe a scene of utter peace and tranquility as he began cultivating severed existence itself- seated on a white gold throne as countless strings flowed from him and stretched out in different directions, with the figure of a gorgeous woman by his side who stood patiently!
In such peace and tranquility.
"This is it...." Noah nodded while breathing out as he opened his eyes.
He waved his left hand to bring forth the illusionary figures of Faceless Entities with white bands on their heads, and the illusory image of a spinning Wheel!
Faceless Entities.
They seemed to have come forth the moment after the change began as even the compromised Watchers of the Wheelomachy and Logos of the Wheel had these entities behind them.
And apart from this, Noah had also glimpsed them from the remnant memories of the Sword of the Commonwealth, and now even the Great Mother mentioned them within the Megalos Beyond.
They were spread out everywhere.
Noah had many things to do, and these unknown Faceless Entities were at the forefront of the mystery as he turned his head to look at the spinning wheel he also conjured.
A Representation of the Wheelomachy!
The place he had to enter in order to obtain the weavings Bob left behind- to locate the channel that would lead to the Frequency of Existence where he left behind a small part of himself.

Bob had given Noah many threads of knowledge regarding the Palaces of the Wheelomachy and which regions he could cross while evading the danger of unknowns as, at this moment, even Bob was not sure who could be trusted.
It was bound to be dangerous.
He could just as easily be captured by a Source Complexity Watcher of the Wheelomachy!

So in the face of such a difficult task that made even Bob blatantly say success or failure was unknown, how would Noah approach it? How could he obtain more information about the Faceless Entities and even infiltrate the Wheelomachy?!
The answer he came up with was a surprisingly simple one.
"Dream..."
HUUM!
Above him, a dazzling Severed Rune of Amarantos Dream of the Megalos bloomed.
Severed.
Elevated!
Noah knew that with it, he could be even more purposeful in the Dreams he had as currently, he held bountiful weavings of what he wanted to Dream about.
"From the weavings of Bob, I accept the distinction of a Watcher of the Wheelomachy."
HUUM!
The Severed Weavings of the Rune of Amarantos Dream of the Megalos began to spin.

In his hand, the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel burned brightly as it released a dull gold light that covered the Rune of Existence spinning above Noah, covering it and beginning to modify it entirely as Noah continued!
"Not just any Watcher, but one stemming from the line of the First Watcher who founded the Wheelomachy!"
His voice gradually gained more and more authority as he lay back on his throne.
While farming. While cultivating his weavings of existence.
"I will dream of the Wheelomachy. The Watchers of the Wheelomachy of these very weavings of existence."
He gave the severed weavings purpose and direction as the modified Rune of AMARANTOS spun heavily, releasing blinding light as a part of Noah's weavings...fell into a slumber.
While cultivating his very existence, he also began to dream as beside him, the Infiniverse Megalos Body nodded while pointing to the blue skies.

The areas she pointed to split wide open as from above, dazzling crimson gold Globules of Blood of Pioneers appeared- these being products brought out of Hell Terra Firma recently as the distortion of time went into full effect.

The Globule of Blood of a Pioneer fell down from the skies and drenched the plot of land containing the Severed Seed of Mana, vibrant incandescence exploding out as complex weavings of existence came together!
At the same time, Noah's body continued to pulse as even though he had begun to dream, he still felt everything.
One after another, more and more Severed Seeds of Existence formed around him like dazzling singularities before they flew towards an empty plot to be cultivated.
Occasionally, the skies would open and rain down drops of Blood of Pioneers as what he was doing was enough to baffle any normal entity at this moment!
And yet he did such grandiose actions as while proceeding with the Severing and cultivation of his weavings, he dreamed!
He dreamed of the Megalos.
He dreamed of the Expanse.
He dreamed of the Wheelomachy!

chapters.title: Chapter 3485 The Wheelomachy! V
paragraphs: There was only darkness.

But the darkness did not last long as gradually, an emergence of light bloomed. He felt like he was waking up from an extremely long slumber but unlike before, when he woke up this time, he felt everything with extreme clarity.
He knew who he was, and he knew exactly who he had commandeered the weavings of.
'Tam of the Singed, a Disciple of the Great Watcher, Bob!'
His power was now extremely purposeful and precise.
He wanted to dream of the Wheelomachy, and he wanted to dream of the weavings, closest to Bob!
And so he came to dream through the eyes of one of his Disciples.

There were many disciples among the Watchers of the Wheelomachy- entities who took care of the daily living of the Watchers themselves and managed to keep a contact with Palaces of the Expanse to send word of any happenings.
They would judge what is prevalent and important to pass on to Watchers as they were akin to gatekeepers.
At times, they would even set off themselves to fix issues that did not need the attention of the Watchers.
The Disciple of the Watchers, Tam, was one such being as at this moment, Noah's weavings within him opened his eyes and silently observed everything without radiating his authority.

After all, he was bound to be in a land filled with entities that held terrifying complexities. A single glance at him may just expose that he was someone else and cause the stream to end rather early.

When he opened his eyes, he saw that he was not alone. A few inches away from him, there was the figure of a gorgeous woman with a frowning expression. She was adorned in white battle robes, and her red hair danced calmly below her shoulders. Her crimson eyes looked like vertical slits as she stared ahead.
Ahead.
Ahead of them, one could see a radiant space filled with a calm white-gold glow as within it, the suspended brilliance of multiple different colored wheels could be seen.
The wheels that lay flat and were used as platforms as on top of them, the auras of terrifying entities who at the very least were Pioneers could be seen.
The least powerful complexities...were Pioneers.
Noah was one such being as currently, he was exploring the path of Tam while looking around.

The atmosphere was a somber and heavy one as there were dozens of small wheel platforms like the one he was standing on, with many of them holding Pioneers while others...radiated the same suffocation as Barbatos!
Source Complexity!
And at the very forefront.
Where all eyes were currently gathered towards.
There was a golden wheel platform that had utterly majestic auras flowing on it.
It was the aura of Watchers!
All others on the suspended wheel platforms in the surroundings seem to be looking towards them as the woman near Noah had a stern expression while she voiced out to him.
|None of this makes sense. Why can we not contact Sir Bob? And those complexities behind the Watchers...|
Her voice was stern. She was known as Vashti. A powerful Disciple who was working under Sir Bob for many eons, someone close to finding her Source!
But she spoke of the complexities behind the Watchers.
Because behind the Watchers at this moment, one could see the appearance of entities silently standing in the back.
Their bodies were all humanoid, and they were...Faceless.

White bands went up in the center of where their faces used to be as many were staring towards them, even one or two Watchers on that golden platform also frowning while gazing towards them as if they didn't know who or what they were!
Noah looked at them with shining eyes as it seemed things were going to be exceedingly difficult. The Faceless Entities had already reached the highest rungs of the Wheelomachy as Bob feared.
So he shook his head calmly as complexity began to bloom up ahead.
|Let's just watch for now.|
They were all gathered here for something after the Change bloomed.
After one Frequency and now many more were being affected!
|O Disciples of the Wheelomachy! O Watchers of the Wheelomachy!|
HUUUM!
Up ahead, on the singular golden platform where many eyes were locked onto, an ancient voice began to echo out.
The one speaking was a man advanced in years as his eyes showed immense complexity and wisdom.
Adorned in a white robe with a head full of white hair and a long white beard, he was none other than the Great Sage.
Interminable brilliance of Anti-Matter swirled around him as beside him, the Watcher Persephael could be seen among a dozen other Watchers.
Once the Great Sage held everyone's attention, his wizened eyes shone as he continued.

|Over the years, we all expected a Change. We all knew the change was coming, but none of us knew that it would be this drastic. But we do not fear such Change. We are Watchers of the Wheel. We have seen Ages come and go in the past. We have seen Lineages rise and fall, Palaces of Existence radiantly shine for an Age before crumbling in another. We observe and we correct as needed. But this change...it came with a heavy loss.|
His aged face looked to be filled with sadness.
His eyes that had seen too much lustrously shone as he continued!
|Rarely, if ever, do we have a Watcher of the Wheelomachy fall. Our complexities are far too bright for this. And yet today, with the emergence of this Change, A Watcher has fallen.|
HUUM!
The gazes of many changed.
Shock overtook many eyes.
Disbelief flashed on the Disciple of Bob, Vashti! She looked at the Watchers of the platform as some seemed equally surprised and in disbelief at such words!
And yet the Great Sage continued.
|One of the strongest among us. An Entity of illustrious stature whose weavings stretch back to the very First Watcher. Sir Bob...has fallen.|
BOOM!
A heavy silence of disbelief descended.
Sir Bob?
He had his intricacies.
He had his personality.
But he was the one Watcher that nobody would associate with death!

sentences.text: There was only darkness.
But the darkness did not last long as gradually, an emergence of light bloomed.
He felt like he was waking up from an extremely long slumber but unlike before, when he woke up this time, he felt everything with extreme clarity.
He knew who he was, and he knew exactly who he had commandeered the weavings of.
'Tam of the Singed, a Disciple of the Great Watcher, Bob!'
His power was now extremely purposeful and precise.
He wanted to dream of the Wheelomachy, and he wanted to dream of the weavings, closest to Bob!
And so he came to dream through the eyes of one of his Disciples.

There were many disciples among the Watchers of the Wheelomachy- entities who took care of the daily living of the Watchers themselves and managed to keep a contact with Palaces of the Expanse to send word of any happenings.
They would judge what is prevalent and important to pass on to Watchers as they were akin to gatekeepers.
At times, they would even set off themselves to fix issues that did not need the attention of the Watchers.
The Disciple of the Watchers, Tam, was one such being as at this moment, Noah's weavings within him opened his eyes and silently observed everything without radiating his authority.
After all, he was bound to be in a land filled with entities that held terrifying complexities.
A single glance at him may just expose that he was someone else and cause the stream to end rather early.
When he opened his eyes, he saw that he was not alone.
A few inches away from him, there was the figure of a gorgeous woman with a frowning expression.
She was adorned in white battle robes, and her red hair danced calmly below her shoulders.
Her crimson eyes looked like vertical slits as she stared ahead.
Ahead.
Ahead of them, one could see a radiant space filled with a calm white-gold glow as within it, the suspended brilliance of multiple different colored wheels could be seen.
The wheels that lay flat and were used as platforms as on top of them, the auras of terrifying entities who at the very least were Pioneers could be seen.
The least powerful complexities...were Pioneers.
Noah was one such being as currently, he was exploring the path of Tam while looking around.

The atmosphere was a somber and heavy one as there were dozens of small wheel platforms like the one he was standing on, with many of them holding Pioneers while others...radiated the same suffocation as Barbatos!
Source Complexity!
And at the very forefront.
Where all eyes were currently gathered towards.
There was a golden wheel platform that had utterly majestic auras flowing on it.
It was the aura of Watchers!
All others on the suspended wheel platforms in the surroundings seem to be looking towards them as the woman near Noah had a stern expression while she voiced out to him.
|None of this makes sense.
Why can we not contact Sir Bob?
And those complexities behind the Watchers...|
Her voice was stern.
She was known as Vashti.
A powerful Disciple who was working under Sir Bob for many eons, someone close to finding her Source!
But she spoke of the complexities behind the Watchers.
Because behind the Watchers at this moment, one could see the appearance of entities silently standing in the back.
Their bodies were all humanoid, and they were...Faceless.

White bands went up in the center of where their faces used to be as many were staring towards them, even one or two Watchers on that golden platform also frowning while gazing towards them as if they didn't know who or what they were!
Noah looked at them with shining eyes as it seemed things were going to be exceedingly difficult.
The Faceless Entities had already reached the highest rungs of the Wheelomachy as Bob feared.
So he shook his head calmly as complexity began to bloom up ahead.
|Let's just watch for now.|
They were all gathered here for something after the Change bloomed.
After one Frequency and now many more were being affected!
|O Disciples of the Wheelomachy!
O Watchers of the Wheelomachy!|
HUUUM!
Up ahead, on the singular golden platform where many eyes were locked onto, an ancient voice began to echo out.
The one speaking was a man advanced in years as his eyes showed immense complexity and wisdom.
Adorned in a white robe with a head full of white hair and a long white beard, he was none other than the Great Sage.
Interminable brilliance of Anti-Matter swirled around him as beside him, the Watcher Persephael could be seen among a dozen other Watchers.
Once the Great Sage held everyone's attention, his wizened eyes shone as he continued.
|Over the years, we all expected a Change.
We all knew the change was coming, but none of us knew that it would be this drastic.
But we do not fear such Change.
We are Watchers of the Wheel.
We have seen Ages come and go in the past.
We have seen Lineages rise and fall, Palaces of Existence radiantly shine for an Age before crumbling in another.
We observe and we correct as needed.
But this change...it came with a heavy loss.|
His aged face looked to be filled with sadness.
His eyes that had seen too much lustrously shone as he continued!
|Rarely, if ever, do we have a Watcher of the Wheelomachy fall.
Our complexities are far too bright for this.
And yet today, with the emergence of this Change, A Watcher has fallen.|
HUUM!
The gazes of many changed.
Shock overtook many eyes.
Disbelief flashed on the Disciple of Bob, Vashti!
She looked at the Watchers of the platform as some seemed equally surprised and in disbelief at such words!
And yet the Great Sage continued.
|One of the strongest among us.
An Entity of illustrious stature whose weavings stretch back to the very First Watcher.
Sir Bob...has fallen.|
BOOM!
A heavy silence of disbelief descended.
Sir Bob?
He had his intricacies.
He had his personality.
But he was the one Watcher that nobody would associate with death!

chapters.title: Chapter 3486 The Wheelomachy! VI
paragraphs: Sir Bob!
He was just too powerful for many to even imagine he would fall.
And yet the Great Sage stated such a shocking fact as near Noah...
|Impossible!|
Vashti gritted her teeth as her single word roared out in his mind.
She wasn't the only one as on the gold wheel platform of the Watchers, there were multiple Watchers that turned towards the Great Sage with heavy questions!
Noah looked at this and sneered inwardly as he remembered the scene of the Great Sage and Persephael surrounding Bob with many other forces.
Even entities as distinguished as them could do this? Just what reason lay behind the betrayal of their very values?!
At such a time...
|Silence!|
A booming roar echoed out as Persephael, glittering in golden jewels and necklaces, pulled in everyone's gazes.
She looked at the Watchers and Disciples as she spoke out with a trace of burning anger in her voice.
|It is something that should be impossible, and yet it occurred! Do you know why? It is because he was betrayed!|

|If you look, you can also see that on this platform, other Watchers apart from him are missing. Watcher Nigel, Watcher Noxana, Watcher Richter! As of this moment, they are all suspect and complicit in the decimation of the Weavings of Bob! After the advent of this Change, when Sir Bob went to understand its Origins in the domains of the Logos of the Wheel...his weavings disappeared there alongside these beings. Traitors of the Wheelomachy!|
Shocking words echoed out from Persephael as the rage in her eyes was palpable.
Yet her words only caused more somber gazes and shock to spread as she continued.

|In the history of the Wheelomachy, we have never faced something like this. For our own people to do this- the complexities behind it are too unfathomable to grasp! We know that they did not work alone if they were able to do this to Sir Bob, and what is left to do now is understand why...and ensure that the weavings of complexities of these traitors are collapsed on sight! To understand just why this Change would bring something like this to our own peop-...!|
The Great Sage placed his hand on Persephael and stopped her words as she heaved.
His gaze was somber as he looked at everyone and spoke deeply.

|The Wheelomachy is an unshakable behemoth across the ages. Whatever comes and goes, the Wheelomachy remains standing because it has to. We are stretched out in this Frequency of the Wheel and many other Frequencies as our job...is to observe and ensure. There is a Change, yes. We will understand it. The Change has caused some complexities to shift their allegiances, and we will understand this too. Behind us here...|
The Great Sage pointed towards the Faceless Entities emanating a unique air of power this whole time.

|These are Impartial Watchers that Sir Bob, Persephael, and I have been developing these past years. The only Legacy left behind by Sir Bob as he sensed what was coming more than any of us ever did. I did not understand why the secrecy at the time, why he asked us to keep it from others- but it seems to be precisely for this moment. These Impartial Watchers are the greatest weapon he left behind as their complexities cannot be influenced. Their weavings cannot be corrupted. They only take the best possible route to ensure the turns of the Wheel of Existence. To ensure order and stability in the coming chaos. They will stand guard alongside you in the Palaces of the Wheelomachy. They will aid in the observation of the flow of Frequencies...and root out any remaining enemies within the Wheelomachy!|
Noah's weavings seethed as he listened to all of this with bright eyes.
To distort falsehood and truth this well...this Great Sage was truly something else!
A clamor rose out as many looked towards the Faceless Entities.
The Impartial Watchers!
Beside Noah, Vashti had a cold expression as she shook her head.
|What is this? We have been with Sir Bob all of these years along with others. Nothing like this...-|
Her words stopped.
Noah had placed his hand on her shoulders as silently, behind them...
An Impartial Watcher floated over and descended on the Wheel they were on!
Not just them, but all Disciples of Watchers on other platforms of Wheels had a similar occurrence!
The Great Sage looked at all of this as he voiced out.

|The Watchers of the Wheelomachy have remained a force of the Wheel across the Ages, and this will not change. We will be in communication with other Great Watchers across the Frequencies. We will observe and understand as in no time, the flow of the Wheel will be returned to what it was. Until then, continue your honored duties. Your selfless tasks. Observe the weavings of the Megalos and the Expanse. Any findings can be passed on to the Impartial Watchers as if there is any sickness, it will be purified. If there are any rats...they will not be able to hide in the dark for much longer!|
WAA!
|Return to your posts and prepare. Observe. Watch. Our Watch..is never over.|
Brilliance shone all around as heavy complexity seethed.
On the Platform of the Wheel that Noah and Vashti were on...
|Come with me.|
An intent bloomed from the Faceless Entity- The Impartial Watcher behind them as a channel that looked like a wormhole opened up behind them!
There were many such channels that led to different areas in the Palaces of the Wheelomachy.

Vashti's gaze was cold as she heard the cold, commanding voice of the Impartial Watcher, but she gazed in other areas where many were returning to their posts as she was also going to follow, even with all her doubts!
Yet Noah kept his hand on her shoulder as he gazed at the Faceless Entity before him who was already entering the channel without even waiting for their affirmation.
His weavings were unique.
His weavings were truly Severed.
He was the Weaver of Extremity.
He was the Weaver of Existence.
Having Severed Existence itself, he was extremely perceptive to the possible changes others wanted to exert on his weavings!
And this Impartial Watcher before them- this Faceless Entity...was intending to collapse the weavings of Vashti and Tam!
The few Disciples of Sir Bob.
Was it a cleanup?
As Noah wondered this, he sent his intent towards Vashti silently.
|That so called Impartial Watcher ahead of us intends to collapse our weavings. There is a plot afoot. If you wish to live...do not make any move against it. Let me take the fall.|
Vashti's visage subtly trembled before her crimson eyes flashed furiously, but she followed!

As for Noah...it seemed like he would have to stretch his muscles out fully to understand the extent of power of just this single Faceless Entity, and plan a path ahead for him to enter the abode of Bob after this Dream ended!

chapters.title: Chapter 3487 Impartial?! I
paragraphs: History was always written by the victors.
There were ages of war that came and went, with countless atrocities being
committed over time as after the end of these wars...it was always unique that one barely heard anything relating to them, or if they were recorded in history, it was only a mere mention of them.
The Megalonians undergoing a genocide and being cleansed out of existence.
It was an event that many simply knew had occurred a great number of years ago!
There were no waves of outpouring sympathy for the Megalonians, nor did many have thoughts of empathy or understanding regarding them.
At most, other complex entities would look at this event and regret that they were not there to be able to partake in such a thing to increase their own complexity!
This was war. This was history.
At this very moment, the history of the Wheelomachy was being rewritten as there was nobody to stand against this.
Nobody spoke up and said it was entirely false!
Because even if they had their doubts, how could they raise their complexities against those at the very peak of power who were actively writing this history?
So many followed.

The Watchers of the Wheelomachy here and the Disciples of the Wheelomachy saw the Faceless Entities- the so called Impartial Watchers, spread out across the channels of the Palaces of the Wheelomachy as they would arrive in regions where one could observe any large scale changes on certain Spokes of the Wheel among other things! They watched, and they followed.

In one corner, Vashti heard Noah's weavings that told her to not make any moves- that the Impartial Watcher ahead of them was already planning and set in stone to collapse their weavings of existence!
She heard this as her heart lurched, thinking about everything else that had just occurred as well as their positions as she gritted her teeth and continued forward.
They were the Disciples of Bob.
Bob had gone missing as he was considered fallen, while other Watchers were accused of plotting against him and currently missing!
So what would happen to the Disciples of Watchers that were missing? The Disciples of Bob?
Vashti closed her eyes at this reality as she kept her torn complexity in her heart, proceeding ahead while getting ready for anything.
She followed Sir Bob because it gave her purpose. Because she saw all the good that he did over the eons!
But now...he was gone.
And now, what would happen to the rest of them?
In her musings.
They crossed across a channel built like a wormhole as they arrived in a domain filled with dazzling radiance.
Far ahead, there was a massive construct that looked like a Wheel surrounded by multicolored floating islands filled with power.

The massive structure that looked like a wheel held a brilliant singularity at its very center, with a dozen brilliant Lines- Frequencies, shown extending from the central singularity and connecting to the ends of the wheel!
12 brilliant lines. 12 Spokes of the Wheel.
Alexander looked at them calmly as the memories that Bob had left behind slowly overlapped.
This place he knew.
His eyes further honed in one of Spoke of the Wheel ahead- one that seemed no different from the others as this was actually something that Bob left behind!
For anyone observing it, it may seem like a representation of a Spoke of a Wheel- of a Frequency of Existence.
But it was actually a secret passage Bob left behind that led into a deeper area within the Wheelomachy where he had to cross through in order to enter the isolated secret domain.
The isolated domain that would have an established channel leading to the Frequency of Existence where Bob hid another part of him.
This...was the pathway he needed to take as others could not see this, nor could they follow him.
Otherwise, if a Source Complexity or higher was close behind, everything would be for naught.
So in this dream...he wasn't able to do too much but set up the opportunity for himself and plan ahead.
In this Dream, he would get familiar with these Faceless Entities.
These beings seeking to impose themselves as Impartial Watchers!
Noah looked ahead at the muscular oversized humanoid entity covered by some sort. of obsidian wrapping as he voiced out nonchalantly.
"For someone seeking to call themselves an Impartial Watcher, you sure emanate a large amount of killing intent. I ask you, where exactly is the impartiality here?"
WAA!
A few words were uttered from him.
And yet the heavy visage of the Faceless Entity ahead stopped in its place as...its head turned around unnaturally!

Even without the rest of its body turning, its head made a 180 degree turn as the vertical band of white brilliance on its face shone, the head then tilting to the side as an eerie intent radiated from this creature!
I was giving absolutely nothing away. How could a creature like you have sensed my
intent?
The words were calm.
The words were eerie!
This creature didn't even deny it as when Vashti heard its intent, her face turned more ashen as the gravity of the situation fully settled in!
These Impartial Watchers were instated by the very higher echelons of the Watchers of the Wheelomachy!
The Great Sage and Persephael herself stated that they were things worked on jointly with Bob!
What did it truly mean these Faceless Entities, these Impartial Watchers, were turning their swords unto them?

The implications caused her to feel a heavy sense of suffocation as even her path. wavered slightly. But the voice of the man beside her rang out once more in her mind. He intends to kill us both, but you can still save yourself. Do not attack him. Instead... begin directing your attacks unto me. As if you found something wrong with me and joined this Impartial Watcher to stand against me. This...is the only way for you to survive this ordeal. After that, bide your time and wait. Someone sent by Sir Bob himself will contact you. Be ready!|
HUUM!
Brilliance unfolded.
Complexity began to burn!

chapters.title: Chapter 3488 Impartial?! II
paragraphs: Complexity burned as at this moment, inside of a dream... the Quintessential League of Existence unfurled!
The visage of the Faceless Entity did not seem to care that the direction of its face did not match its body- as if inside of that obsidian suit, it was not even a skeletal
structure to match the humanoid appearance it held.
It only looked at the changing weavings of Existence after Noah released the Relegation Zone of Existence as it raised one of its hands to the skies.
Dull creature, I commend you for your bravery in facing something that you do not understand. For that, I will teach you the difference between you and I before you perish.|
WAA!
Its fist was raised to the skies.
The vertical white band on its head shone with radiance as it uttered out.
"Between you and I...Existence is of no consequence to me."
HUUM!
Its fist clenched.
And the surroundings instantly felt like they were being squeezed as weavings of Existence shattered to reveal...obsidian Runes.

These are my Exodus Runes that have nearly grasped a Source. A path I follow that you could never understand. If a single one of these Exodus Runes touch you, your existence collapses. Your Path collapses. Regardless of your Complexity, unless you have attained a Source...you will perish. Before something like this...what can a creature like you even do?
WU!
WU!
As the Impartial Watcher finished speaking, drums like the beat of a heart began to boom out in the surroundings.
As if a symphony was being played!
As if a soundtrack to a grand battle blooming was just now unfolding!
Inside the weavings of a Dream, Noah fully brought out his truly severed Weavings of Existence as the bounds that were there for him before were nonexistent at this moment.
If he couldn't fully take out his Infinite Mana, his Quintessence, and anything else inside a Dream... he could do so this moment with utter ease!
True Severing.
If Noah could express what it meant the most at this moment, there could be only a single word for it.
Freedom.
Freedom!
DUM!
In the surroundings, terrifying obsidian Rules that caused space to quake and shatter as they moved swirled towards him by the dozens!
Exodus Runes.
If a single one touched you, you were dead,
If a single one made contact with you, your path would collapse!

These were the assertions of the Impartial Watcher as could they truly do such a thing against Noah's severed weavings of existence?! Especially when the Quintessential League of Existence was already deployed?!
Noah felt the Freedom that came with True Severing of Existence as he closed his eyes towards the incoming Exodus Runes.
The freedom that came with his severing made him feel like you could do anything.
He didn't need a preset movement. No skill. No modus operandi.
He simply had to take his severed existence and unleash it outwardly as at this moment, he called out grandly.
"Aura."
HUUM!
Around his body.
As if it were the emergence of multiple different colored flames of magisterial light, multiple paths bloomed in the form of auras that dripped of majesty!
They caused his figure to seem like an otherworldly celestial as the moment that the Exodus Runes pummeling towards his body neared him, the eruption of all of these Auras knocked them away!
Alongside this contact, multiple of the newly rising auras also dimmed and shattered.
The different colored auras caused his body to emanate a heart shaking feeling of brilliance and oppression.
So much so that even the figure of Vashti nearby looked over in alarm as if she didn't recognize him!
"Interesting."
Noah looked at the auras around him that had either dimmed or shattered as terrifyingly enough, these Exodus Runes were no joking matter!
And seeing his opposition to them, the Faceless Entity had its white bar flash as it brought its hands forward and slapped out.
BOOM!
Even more Exodus Runes flourished as it felt like Existence itself was being drained to bring them to fruition.

Gray cracks unfolded in the surroundings as the levels of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence went further down, making it twice as hard for others to affect existence! And yet the Impartial Watcher moved as if this didn't bother him one bit! Towards the emergence of even more Exodus Runes, Noah's weavings flourished as he uttered out once more.
"Haki."
WU!
A silent and clear oppressive air erupted from him and covered everything nearby.
It felt like the weight and tonnage of an unfathomable weaving of Existence crashed down, its pressure suffocating everything as the Exodus Runes slowed!
But more than that...
"Severed Passages of Existence..."
His voice echoed out again as above and below, radiant multicolored mountains shattered space and emerged from the cracks.
They were not illusory.

They seemed unfathomably solid and real as they pointed their mountain peaks towards the Faceless Entity and the Exodus Runes floating around- these runes shaking from the pressure as some even began to splinter and shatter!
Some of the Severed Passages of Existence shone with a lustrous cerulean radiance, others were colorless, and others shone gold and purple!
But they emerged and gushed out seas of brilliance that covered everything nearby, exerting their influence at this moment and utterly denying the shocking weavings of the Faceless Entity.
It was a shocking emergence of complex weavings of existence as at such a scene...
Incorrigible.
The Faceless Entity uttered out with a great sense of distaste.
He brought his hands to his chest as in the next moment, a horrific complexity
radiated from him as an illusory dark tower began to form around him!
A dark tower that gradually turned from illusory to real, moving along with the figure
of the Faceless Entity as he shot towards Noah!
BOOM! Seas of lustrous multicolored brilliance were cleaved apart like paper.
The heavy tonnage of Haki and widespread auras was withstood!
RIIP!
The peak of the Dark Tower passed through a cerulean Severed Passage of Existence
as this passage...was cut in half!
And the Dark Tower twisted space and tore through everything to arrive right before
Noah.
His magisterial auras buzzed and squeezed, his severed existence feeling a heavy
pressure that sought to tear him apart!
A type of Complexity...that he had never come across.
A type of complexity that felt...dirty.
A complexity that was unlike any that he had faced before!
"OOOH!"
He bellowed out towards the peak of the Dark Tower threatening to pierce his
weavings, multiple Severed Passages of Existence lining up behind him and supporting him as his figure burned with glorious multicolored auras.
And an unfathomable impact that tore apart the very fabric of the weavings of
existence bloomed!

chapters.title: Chapter 3489 Collapse! I
paragraphs: A heavy impact.

One that caused all nearby weavings to tear, the gray tendrils of light that were spread out across the Expanse blooming from the cracks as the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence tremendously began to reduce.

In the chaotic mess of weavings, the visage of Noah became clear as his multicolored auras of Severed Ordinances danced wildly around him, but there lay a huge gash on his chest as radiant gold blood was spilling out!
Opposite him, a Dark Tower flickered around an Impartial Watcher as he raised his hand to feel his head- feeling a tear around the vertical white band on its head.
A tear!

From this tear, countless viscous masses wriggled like trillions of worms that threatened to come out- as if the whole body of the Faceless Entity was made up of this wriggling mass for its structure.
It was an extremely eerie thing to observe as feeling the wound on its head, the Impartial Watcher radiated weaving of utter horror as if it were enraged.
|A dull creature with your complexity actually dares to wound me?! With a measly complexity such as that, you are lucky that you did not perish from the last hit- and this luck is over!|
HUUM!
The Dark Tower that was flashing on and off around him became even more solidified as in its surroundings, the Exodus Runes manifested by the dozens.
Noah looked at all of this as in the distance, his gaze was cold as he actually did not refute this being.
Currently, his complexity was still low in comparison to them.
"You are right..."
So he admitted it freely.
But at the same time...
"And yet, even with this level of complexity, I will get to see what lies behind that half-torn veil."
He spoke as he gazed intently at the tear near the white band of brilliance on the head of the Faceless Entity.
Yes, this being was right regarding Noah's complexity being a little off. But...what exactly was Noah's strongest point?
What could he do that others could only dream of? "If the pressure of a few mountains could cause a tear on your body...what about a few more?"
A simple question.
One that was followed by the emergence of 9 dazzlingly radiant Severed Passages of Existence.

Each one shone with a different Severed Ordinance under his banner as after they appeared, the Faceless Entity harrumphed as he pointed the tip of the Dark Tower swirling with Exodus Runes in his direction once more!
But after the appearance of the 9 dazzlingly radiant Severed Passages of Existence...another 9 bloomed.

They gushed out seas of weavings that were all focused on the Faceless Entity, the swirling Exodus Runes and the Dark Tower being halted where they stood at this moment from the sheer accumulated pressure of all of these celestial mountains!
And another instant later, nine more Severed Passages of Existence bloomed as the shattered space in the surroundings seemed to be getting packed by radiant mountains. They did not stop!
From the top. From the bottom. From the left and right!
Dazzling mountains appeared and gushed out their pressure all around- the center of their target being a single Faceless Entity!
He no longer moved.
He couldn't!
The accumulated complexities of all of the Severed Passages of Existence that had already wounded him before were now much more numerous, and they continued to bloom more and more endlessly as...
CRACK!
The tear around the white band on the head of this entity became wider and wider.
The pressure he withstood became heavier and heavier!
And all around, the number of Severed Passages of Existence only increased!
As if the cost to bring them to fruition didn't matter.
As if there were endless reserves of weavings to bring more and more out endlessly.
And well...this wasn't too far off.
HUUUM!

A unique melody played and reached a crescendo as the massive mountains gushing out heavy pressure compounded their force, only adding more and more over time as the visage of the Faceless Entity could not move a single muscle.
Its body creaked as more and more tears appeared, and that which lay underneath its black veil continued to wriggle madly as if it was about to break out!
Noah looked at all of this as he uttered out coldly.
"Sever."
WU!

His own body, covered in glorious auras and radiating waves of Haki, became surrounded by purple radiance as it turned into a streak of light that passed through the gushing mountain peak of one Severed Passage of Existence, and it flickered out from another Severed Passage of Existence!
SAA! SAA! SAA!
He turned into a blur of light that disappeared into one Passage and reappeared from another, with his immensity and pressure only becoming more intense through every Passage he passed through.
Eventually, he was only a flicker of light that was passing through from one dazzling mountain to another until ultimately...
SAA!

After passing through mountains that felt like hundreds of times in an extremely short span, his figure aimed towards the suspended Faceless Entity who bore all the terrifying pressure at this moment!
It was too fast.
It was too bright!
BOOM!
A light of severing passed through a Faceless Entity.
True Severing through and through!
Brilliance unfurled as Noah's figure reappeared miles away from the Faceless Entity.
He raised his hands to look at the body he occupied as currently, it was fissured and breaking apart.
He...had overdone the complexity of this Pioneer he possessed who was destined for death in the hands of this Faceless Entity!
His output exceeded what this body could handle.
But behind him...
CRACK!

A Dark Tower crumbled along with Exodus Runes, with the dominating visage of the Faceless One being utterly still as in the next moment, the white band of brilliance on the head of this being shattered!
It shattered.

And the moment it did, a deathly howl of utmost vileness, vengeance, and retribution erupted as the black veil holding the form of the humanoid Faceless Entity tore and split apart- an obsidian mass beginning to wiggle out of it!
Almost as if that white band had been a shackle that kept everything in!

chapters.title: Chapter 3490 Collapse! II
paragraphs: The dazzling white band!
The moment that it shattered, an ancient and deep howl filled with countless negative weavings echoed out, and from the black veil, a mass of wriggling obsidian weavings began to spill out.
The composition felt like oil. Yet there was a form of solidity as it was extremely eerie to observe!

The humanoid appearance instantly deformed as this expanding mass of darkness veered all of its weavings behind and began to roar out towards Noah, its complexity achieving a level at least three times what it was before.
Meaning it was inescapable.
And yet...
Noah felt a profound sensation within his weavings of existence as he stayed still.
As his own body was cracking apart, he watched as in the next moment...
HUUU!
The exposed obsidian mass that had spilled out of the Faceless Entity...seethed in space as it began to burn with scorching black flames!
As if there was some sort of revulsion with the very surrounding weavings of Existence!

Noah kept his eyes opened wide as he saw without the alteration of nearby weavings by anyone, the very calm and unbothered Atmospheric Weavings of Existence in the surroundings pressed down and caused the mass spilling out the Faceless Entity to be scorched.

As if an object that had a very negative reaction to the weavings of existence themselves appeared, and they were finally discovered the moment that they were no longer contained in that humanoid body and that shining white band!
|SCREE!|

A screech bellowed out from the wriggling burning mass, Noah feeling that even with its terrifying complexity, it could not do anything against the extremely volatile reaction it was facing with the surrounding weavings of Existence, and his own eyes captured everything occurring with rapt attention as he came to see...small, faint wooden translucent Runes of Existence by the Millions swirling and pressing down on the Faceless Entity from all around.
Barely observable!

It was only because of his proximity and rapt attention that he even observed them at this moment and because their structure closely resembled the wooden-like rune he had seen forged from something he had obtained recently.
The Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel!

He glimpsed millions of runes similar to what it produced, and these runes had bloomed silently and without the effort of anyone else to scorch the body of the Faceless Entity that rapidly reduced in size and complexity, leaving behind a pungent smell!
No matter its complexity. No matter how much it struggled.

The horrific reality unfolded swiftly and powerfully as, within a few milliseconds, the black mass was entirely scorched and eradicated- the obsidian remnants slowly becoming translucent before they exploded in a shower of complexity!

Complexity that instantly permeated the surroundings and fantastically caused the shattered space and gray tendrils of light to recede, the concentration of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence rapidly rising and becoming enriched as even Noah's body that was breaking apart felt a heavy sense of rejuvenation momentarily.
It was an astounding scene.
And it was one that Noah could not dwell in for too long as he instantly turned towards a shocked Vashti in the distance, sending his intent out as he 'attacked' her!
|My weavings are already collapsing. Finish them off to ensure that my death is not in vain- otherwise, you will soon follow me in death.|
WAA!
The commotion here was quick, but it was also grand.
They were still within the bounds of the many Palaces of the Wheelomachy as many terrifying weavings were drawn over!
The most powerful ones were just about to arrive as Vashti hid the torn emotions in her eyes and steeled herself, shouting out as her body stepped forward with dominance.
Around her, an illusory visage of a primordial bullet ant formed as it pulsed with complexity- an invisible stinger shooting out towards Noah's body!
It was a culmination of a finishing battle as at such a time, multiple auras also bloomed from different directions.
BOOM!
The stinger of the massive primordial bullet ant pierced through the body Noah's weavings currently possessed, his weaving further continuing their collapse as he looked towards Vashti coldly.
|Someone will reach out to you. Be ready.|
Feeling the overbearing auras leaking from all around, Noah dissipated his weavings entirely as his dream...came to an end!
As his dream came to an end...
|What happened here?!|

The commanding voice of Persephael boomed as a few other Watchers and Disciples appeared all around, the figure of Vashti looking torn as she looked towards all of them while pointing towards the figure of Disciple Tam of the Singed that was entirely collapsing.
|A traitor of the Wheelomachy...he attacked the Impartial Watcher as I barely managed to help, but it was too late!|
A story was weaved.
Persephael's eyes were sharp as she looked around and saw the overly enriched Atmospheric Weavings of Existence, the Faceless Entity nowhere to be seen.
Near her, there was another Watcher who was not aligned with her who also came here, and he was watching her reaction and the weavings down below closely!
Even if Persephael did not believe the weavings of this story, she could not delve too deeply into it as the disappearance of the Impartial Watcher meant far too many things.
It was also a consequential moment because as far as she knew...this was the first Faceless Entity to fall since their campaign began!
And the one who had done so...was a mere Disciple of Bob?
Persephael turned silent as complex weavings covered this small part of the Palaces of the Wheelomachy!
Far from here.
Outside the Expanse.
On a budding farm contained inside a dazzling Haven within the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
|A short dream has come to an end.|

A humble farmer opened his eyes while he sat on a throne, continuing his peaceful endeavors as nobody knew he had closed his eyes briefly to dream...and had infiltrated the Wheelomachy while killing a Faceless Entity at the same time!
From the closure of his eyes.
From a Dream!
Ah!
