The horrific reality unfolded swiftly and powerfully as, within a few milliseconds, the black mass was entirely scorched and eradicated- the obsidian remnants slowly becoming translucent before they exploded in a shower of complexity!

Complexity that instantly permeated the surroundings and fantastically caused the shattered space and gray tendrils of light to recede, the concentration of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence rapidly rising and becoming enriched as even Noah's body that was breaking apart felt a heavy sense of rejuvenation momentarily.
It was an astounding scene.
And it was one that Noah could not dwell in for too long as he instantly turned towards a shocked Vashti in the distance, sending his intent out as he 'attacked' her!
|My weavings are already collapsing.
Finish them off to ensure that my death is not in vain- otherwise, you will soon follow me in death.|
WAA!
The commotion here was quick, but it was also grand.
They were still within the bounds of the many Palaces of the Wheelomachy as many terrifying weavings were drawn over!
The most powerful ones were just about to arrive as Vashti hid the torn emotions in her eyes and steeled herself, shouting out as her body stepped forward with dominance.
Around her, an illusory visage of a primordial bullet ant formed as it pulsed with complexity- an invisible stinger shooting out towards Noah's body!
It was a culmination of a finishing battle as at such a time, multiple auras also bloomed from different directions.
BOOM!
The stinger of the massive primordial bullet ant pierced through the body Noah's weavings currently possessed, his weaving further continuing their collapse as he looked towards Vashti coldly.
|Someone will reach out to you.
Be ready.|
Feeling the overbearing auras leaking from all around, Noah dissipated his weavings entirely as his dream...came to an end!
As his dream came to an end...
|What happened here?!|

The commanding voice of Persephael boomed as a few other Watchers and Disciples appeared all around, the figure of Vashti looking torn as she looked towards all of them while pointing towards the figure of Disciple Tam of the Singed that was entirely collapsing.
|A traitor of the Wheelomachy...he attacked the Impartial Watcher as I barely managed to help, but it was too late!|
A story was weaved.
Persephael's eyes were sharp as she looked around and saw the overly enriched Atmospheric Weavings of Existence, the Faceless Entity nowhere to be seen.
Near her, there was another Watcher who was not aligned with her who also came here, and he was watching her reaction and the weavings down below closely!
Even if Persephael did not believe the weavings of this story, she could not delve too deeply into it as the disappearance of the Impartial Watcher meant far too many things.
It was also a consequential moment because as far as she knew...this was the first Faceless Entity to fall since their campaign began!
And the one who had done so...was a mere Disciple of Bob?
Persephael turned silent as complex weavings covered this small part of the Palaces of the Wheelomachy!
Far from here.
Outside the Expanse.
On a budding farm contained inside a dazzling Haven within the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
|A short dream has come to an end.|

A humble farmer opened his eyes while he sat on a throne, continuing his peaceful endeavors as nobody knew he had closed his eyes briefly to dream...and had infiltrated the Wheelomachy while killing a Faceless Entity at the same time!
From the closure of his eyes.
From a Dream!
Ah!

chapters.title: Chapter 3491 Singed! I
paragraphs: |The weavings of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos you can obtain are Quintessential.|
|All memories of Tam of the Singed are retained.|
|The Weavings of this single Dream can be retrieved, with all components viable for retrieval due to the current Proficiency of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos.|
|The Components of the Dream capable of being retrieved are as follows.|

|Source of Existence of the Singed- entities burned with the Flame of the Wheel of Existence and hold complex weavings around it. The Ordinance of the Singed. Cycles of refinement of the purity of an Ordinance of Existence.|

|Weavings and the Reconstruction of Tam of the Singed. The accumulated Path of the Singed that has been compressed into an Ordinance of Existence matching the complexity of other Ordinances under your banner.|
Two dazzling singularities danced above his opened eyes- circulating around a Rune of Existence as this time, he didn't have to make a choice!
Due to Severing the weavings of Amarantos, he could obtain absolutely everything.
And so he did.
|All aforementioned components of the Dream of Tam of the Singed have been selected for retrieval.|
|Nothing of the Dream of Tam of the Singed has been lost.|
Around Noah, weavings burned richly and with heavy radiance.
He looked around him as he felt the descent of fantastical complexity- all from the AMARANTOS Rune as it pulled the Source of Existence of the Singed!
They were entities who were burned with the Flame of the Wheel of Existence and held complex weavings around it. But what did that truly mean?
Alongside it came the Ordinance of the Singed and cycles of refinement of this Ordinance, and the Weavings and the Reconstruction of Tam of the Singed himself!
The entity who would have died along with Vashti had Noah not begun to Dream when he did.
His weavings collapsed regardless, and yet at this moment, they were being reconstructed!
Was this what it meant to be Singed? Touched by the Flame of the Wheel of Existence? What even was this Flame, and what would happen as Noah obtained the very Source of Existence of the Singed?!
HUUM!
The storm of weavings around him felt ancient and pristine as his Atlas vibrated and howled like a beast.
Another Mundi of Power lit up!
The process was fast.
The process was seamless as after all, he had Severed Absolute Efficiency among many other things!
|The System of Existence of the Singed is deemed sufficiently different enough to occupy its own Mundi of Power.|
Inside of the unfathomably heavy Severed Atlas of Existence, a small, gold flame bloomed within a Mundi.
It was miniscule.
And yet the moment it bloomed...
WUU!
An ancient and chaotic air of brilliance emanated from Noah!
No sooner had such an air begun to bloom did he wave his hands to produce a drop of Blood, and it sank into his body right after.
|The System of Existence of the Singed is undergoing its first Severing.|
The air emanating out became even more intense!
At the same time.
In front of Noah, a humanoid body was being reconstructed, its musculature shimmering bright gold as its makeup looked scorched.
Burnt.
And yet this burnt makeup gave this form such tremendous glory that within seconds of its conception, it opened its mouth to breathe heavily as if it had been drowning this whole time!
Deep, heavy, breaths.
And gradually, cognizance and recognition rose within his bronze eyes, his slightly bronze burnt skin and golden hair shining brightly as he almost looked solid.
Almost.
After he acclimated, he turned towards the visage of Noah seated on a simple throne as the moment he did so, he felt the ancient air leaking from him as he also felt like he recognized this being!
A flash of recognition flashed in the bronze eyes of Tam of the Singed as he bowed towards Noah a moment later while voicing out.

"I knew an end was coming alongside a new beginning, but I never knew what it would entail. The Wheel turns as the wheel turns without a path being too clear. My thanks to you, O Origin Singed, for your help."
His words were serene and full of respect.

Noah's eyes opened wide as he felt the continued changes within his body, his hands holding the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel feeling a burning sensation as his rising Source of the Singed was reacting to it!
Tam of the Singed- his Reconstruction anyways, stood before him and called him an Origin Singed.
"Why do you call me an Origin Singed?"
He asked succinctly as over his skin, golden flames began to burn.
And Tam bent his head even deeper as he answered.

"The Singed is a rare Lineage that cannot be passed down. There are not many of us across the Frequencies of the Wheel. We were blessed to be burned by the Flame of the Wheel of Existence, giving us greater purpose and understanding- a closeness to the Wheel that others cannot imagine. I have only met a few other Singed across a few Frequencies, but none have radiated a flame as bright as yours, Sir. You can only be someone much more blessed than us, and the only one I can think of is an Origin Singed."
Tam maintained his calmness and reverence as Noah looked at him closely while feeling the changes brought about by the System of Existence of the Singed.

Within him, the severed weavings of Runes resonated and burned heavily due to it as he felt like he was a beginner of this language before, but he was now rapidly becoming proficient as he attained a more advanced level!
The System of Existence of Kuklos also burned brightly as the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel in his hands did the same.
Everything...relating to the Wheel.
To be burned by the Flame of the Wheel.
To be Singed.
Just what did it entail?

chapters.title: Chapter 3492 Singed! II
paragraphs: As Noah grasped the ongoing changes, he waved his hands up and asked calmly.
"What does it mean to you to be a Singed?"
A simple enough question was asked as Tam raised his upper body and replied with clear eyes.

"To be Singed is to be freed. To look past existence and what is good or evil. What is right and what is wrong. To only observe and ensure the flow of the Wheel of Existence when needed to. I joined the service of the Wheelomachy because they closely sought something like this. As a Singed, there is no outlined purpose or path for one to take, and the only thing you need to do is exist. By simply existing as someone burned by the Flame of the Wheel, things will naturally unfold around you, and you will become entangled if ever the flow of weavings requires assistance to keep the Wheel turning."

"My flow of weavings were entangled with Sirs precisely because it seems at this moment in time, the flow of the weavings of the Wheel are not as they should be. Things have gotten chaotic. For my old weavings to collapse and be reborn here simply means I am where I need to be in order to aid in the restoration of the smooth flow of the Wheel."
His words were filled with absolute confidence as he spoke, Noah tapping the side of his throne as beside him, the Infiniverse Megalos Body had a calm expression.
"Is that right?"
A question and a statement that didn't need an answer.

Noah gazed out towards his plots of farms as at the very center, saplings were already blooming and radiating a heavy glow of complexity- their progression being extremely fast as soon enough, they would bear fruits.

The cultivated severed weavings bathed in the Blood of Pioneers could only bear fruit that should allow for multiple severings once consumed- and this would allow for continued elevation of complexity while satisfying Noah's dream!
But he looked at the growing saplings as he thought of the words of Tam.
The flow of the Wheel.
For one to be where they need to be, or where they should be.
There was no outline or set path for one to take or follow, but they would inevitably be entangled in some way if ever the flow of the Wheel was off and needed to be set back.
Noah looked out at the brilliance all around him as he felt like he was constantly struggling against this.
The singular struggle ever since he began as a hunter on that blue planet.
The struggle of control. Of Choices. Of freedom.
He didn't like it when it felt like there was an invisible hand steering things forward!

The words of Tam said otherwise as he stated that one was not given a set purpose or path to follow, and that simply by existing, they would be entangled in a way that eventually...they may play a part in restoring the flow of the Wheel!
The flow.
"The flow..."
HUUM!

He uttered two words as in his body, the weavings of the Singed entirely became Severed and free of influence, golden flames burning around him as the ancient air he radiated only became more intense.
Before him, Tam's back was slightly bent as if he could sense the opposition in Noah's words, and he spoke out slowly.

"The flow does not necessarily mean a predestined path that has to be followed. What many do not understand regarding order and chaos is that they believe the flow of the Wheel is the maintenance of stability and order. Even the Watchers of the Wheelomachy have a similar ideology. As a Singed, we know this to not be true. Order and chaos are simply part of the flow of the Wheel. The Change currently unfolding is not something to be scared of as it should also be part of the flow, part of the turn of the Wheel. A period of chaos before a period of order. Or even a period of prolonged chaos- none of us truly know. But nobody is forced to follow a particular destiny of order or chaos. Nobody. Sir can even look within the depths of your Flame and feel. There, you can observe that at any moment if you so choose, you can disperse the flame that makes you Singed."
WAA!
Noah's eyes were placid as he looked within the depths of his existence.
The flickering golden flame in a Mundi of Power that had just bloomed!
At its depths, this flame had a center that seemed indestructible, and yet if Noah so chose, a mere thought from him could collapse it.
And everything about it would fade away.
The Flame of the Burnt Ones.
The Singed who were touched by the Flame of the Wheel of Existence!
Noah was now one of these beings as he didn't have some austere flame smash into him and burn him, but retrieved and took the weavings of a Singed himself before he severed them away from Existence.
And now, he would be involved in even more Entanglements that involved the flow of the Wheel of Existence.

The closer one was to the Wheel, the more Entanglements there would be. Simply because they knew the language. They could more easily go with the flow. But they all also had a choice...to not be involved!
In that case, another entity would be entangled for the sake of the flow of the Wheel. "..."
Noah's weavings burned silently as he finished his thoughts.
The struggle of influence and control...seemed to be getting more and more complex!
As a Flame burned around his body, his eyes became ever so brighter as he gradually came to a realization.
The Severed Weavings of Causality burned.
Uncertainty and Relativity burned!
Destiny burned!
He came to a realization that if he wished for a level of extreme control over his weavings without any influence or bursts of causality, he would have to not interact with others at all.
To isolate himself and do absolutely nothing.

If he closed up shop and retreated to Hell Terra Firma without worrying about what Bob left behind. What the Change meant for all Frequencies, or who the Faceless Entities were...he could effectively isolate and cut himself off of all these possible weavings!
Whenever he continued interacting with others, a level of outside influence came as he would have to make choices.
Like the choice to agree to Bob's request and enter the line descending from the First Watcher.

This choice led for him to Dream in order to enter the Palaces of Wheelomachy, and he now became entangled with Faceless Entities and even held another System of Existence due to it...and not even an hour had passed!

If he didn't isolate himself and not bother with anything, how would this affect his own complexity? If he continued to interact with the weavings and flow of the Wheel...how would this continue to affect his complexity?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3493 Singed! III
paragraphs: The struggle for control over his weavings!
To obtain control absolutely, isolation was the only path and this way, there would be no interactions with other weavings. No choices to make due to causality that came from interacting with others.
Just seclusion away from everything as if the flow of the Wheel flows as it should always flow, would there be someone else who can come along and face whatever mystery was currently unfolding?
If Noah didn't bother with Bob's weavings and he remained sealed.
Would there be someone similar to Bob in other Frequencies who would be able to stand against the Faceless Entities and return leadership to the Wheelomachy?
The more he thought of isolation as means of absolute control, the more he thought as his weavings went towards a few specific beings.
The Great Beyonder. The Omnifather.
Where were they in all this? If they couldn't be found currently, did they take that step of isolation to attain full control of their own weavings?
Millions of thoughts crossed Noah's mind as he felt the not so subtle changes to his physiology and being as the System of Existence of the Singed continued to empower everything.
He waved his hands as he called out Severed Outerversal Authority.
WU!
Obsidian brilliance bloomed, but around it- silent golden flames seethed as even these weavings became burnt!

And its severed intensity and complexity took a step higher- at least by a factor of two. Noah was musing the possibility of isolation, but in the depths of his heart, he knew that it wasn't something he would do.

Just lock himself away? He knew that eventually, there would be someone or something that takes the reins, and in his isolation- such a being or their forces could appear and destroy everything he had built!
Hell Terra Firma was isolated and unique, but even he could go in and out. What if another force came that could do something similar with all these ongoing changes?
No amount of isolation would be enough.
So was there actually a choice, or an illusion of one?
He would actively continue to be involved.
Because his involvement led to something like this.
He raised his and observed the golden flames burning around him.
To become a Burnt One.
To be Singed by the Flame of the Wheel!
It seemed to carry a grandiose meaning as he wondered- apart from Tam of the Singed, how many more lay out there?!
Within the same Frequency of Existence.
Megalos Nihilos.

Across the stretches of the vast regions equivalent to the size of tens of thousands of Omniverse, there was one region that was free of any signs of complexity and life forms apart from a single one.
A massive creature in the form of a massive 81 legged spider.
The 81 legs looked like massive spikes as each one was the size of a hundredth of an Omniverse, and it held nine shining gold eyes that looked ahead with wisdom and serenity.
The gold eyes showed a shocking level of complexity that far exceeded anything a Pioneer could exhibit as they could seemingly see through too many things.
Its exterior looked white gold as at this moment, it was staring out blankly as an intent radiated from it- almost as if it was talking to itself.
|There exist a great many parasites out there, but a Parasite of Existence like you is rare. Lazy, slovenly, and idle in nature, and yet the spread is rapid.|
This massive entity was talking as if there was someone before it, and yet it was the only form of life here!
But it continued regardless.
|You clutched onto my underlings and then latched onto my weavings through that connection. A blindspot. But even then, I sensed it right away as soon as it occurred.|
Its words were filled with ancient power as it became silent after these last words.
As if it was waiting.
And after a few seconds...another voice echoed out, also from the massive white gold spider!
|Why did you leave me be? I have only continued to assimilate small parts of you since then. Even now, you could cut these parts off and extinguish me at will, and yet you haven't. Why?|
Why.
It was always a why.
The eyes of the massive spider sparkled at such a question as it answered calmly.

|You should have felt it too the moment that you latched onto me. You became burnt beyond recognition. You were singed by my very own existence as from that moment on, you became part of something larger. The moment you became tainted by the Flame of the Wheel of Existence, your position exceeded even my earliest underlings who could not have my lineage passed down to. You became part of me as that could not have been a mistake. So why would I have done anything to you?|
An immense silence followed.
The ancient voice that had echoed out seemed amused by this as it continued.

|You were called the Great Usurper, yes? Does this scare you? The possibility of a purpose grander than anything you had before? Becoming singed by the Flame of the Wheel of Existence means that whether you like it or not, events will start unraveling around you. Causality will twist and distort in ways you cannot even imagine- all for the flow of the Wheel. You can run from it, or choose to ignore it I suppose, but I've only found myself at peace just going with the flow. And hey, there is the added bonus of an accelerated rise in complexity compared to any other creatures.|
The intent of the Usurper was silent at all of these words.
After some time, his voice echoed out.
|You realize that I will not stop assimilating your weavings? In some time, your complexity will disappear as I take it over entirely. Is that purpose for you?|
His voice carried a hint of defiance.
As if he detested the idea of some destined purpose!

sentences.text: The struggle for control over his weavings!
To obtain control absolutely, isolation was the only path and this way, there would be no interactions with other weavings.
No choices to make due to causality that came from interacting with others.
Just seclusion away from everything as if the flow of the Wheel flows as it should always flow, would there be someone else who can come along and face whatever mystery was currently unfolding?
If Noah didn't bother with Bob's weavings and he remained sealed.
Would there be someone similar to Bob in other Frequencies who would be able to stand against the Faceless Entities and return leadership to the Wheelomachy?
The more he thought of isolation as means of absolute control, the more he thought as his weavings went towards a few specific beings.
The Great Beyonder.
The Omnifather.
Where were they in all this?
If they couldn't be found currently, did they take that step of isolation to attain full control of their own weavings?
Millions of thoughts crossed Noah's mind as he felt the not so subtle changes to his physiology and being as the System of Existence of the Singed continued to empower everything.
He waved his hands as he called out Severed Outerversal Authority.
WU!
Obsidian brilliance bloomed, but around it- silent golden flames seethed as even these weavings became burnt!
And its severed intensity and complexity took a step higher- at least by a factor of two.
Noah was musing the possibility of isolation, but in the depths of his heart, he knew that it wasn't something he would do.
Just lock himself away?
He knew that eventually, there would be someone or something that takes the reins, and in his isolation- such a being or their forces could appear and destroy everything he had built!
Hell Terra Firma was isolated and unique, but even he could go in and out.
What if another force came that could do something similar with all these ongoing changes?
No amount of isolation would be enough.
So was there actually a choice, or an illusion of one?
He would actively continue to be involved.
Because his involvement led to something like this.
He raised his and observed the golden flames burning around him.
To become a Burnt One.
To be Singed by the Flame of the Wheel!
It seemed to carry a grandiose meaning as he wondered- apart from Tam of the Singed, how many more lay out there?!
Within the same Frequency of Existence.
Megalos Nihilos.

Across the stretches of the vast regions equivalent to the size of tens of thousands of Omniverse, there was one region that was free of any signs of complexity and life forms apart from a single one.
A massive creature in the form of a massive 81 legged spider.
The 81 legs looked like massive spikes as each one was the size of a hundredth of an Omniverse, and it held nine shining gold eyes that looked ahead with wisdom and serenity.
The gold eyes showed a shocking level of complexity that far exceeded anything a Pioneer could exhibit as they could seemingly see through too many things.
Its exterior looked white gold as at this moment, it was staring out blankly as an intent radiated from it- almost as if it was talking to itself.
|There exist a great many parasites out there, but a Parasite of Existence like you is rare.
Lazy, slovenly, and idle in nature, and yet the spread is rapid.|
This massive entity was talking as if there was someone before it, and yet it was the only form of life here!
But it continued regardless.
|You clutched onto my underlings and then latched onto my weavings through that connection.
A blindspot.
But even then, I sensed it right away as soon as it occurred.|
Its words were filled with ancient power as it became silent after these last words.
As if it was waiting.
And after a few seconds...another voice echoed out, also from the massive white gold spider!
|Why did you leave me be?
I have only continued to assimilate small parts of you since then.
Even now, you could cut these parts off and extinguish me at will, and yet you haven't.
Why?|
Why.
It was always a why.
The eyes of the massive spider sparkled at such a question as it answered calmly.
|You should have felt it too the moment that you latched onto me.
You became burnt beyond recognition.
You were singed by my very own existence as from that moment on, you became part of something larger.
The moment you became tainted by the Flame of the Wheel of Existence, your position exceeded even my earliest underlings who could not have my lineage passed down to.
You became part of me as that could not have been a mistake.
So why would I have done anything to you?|
An immense silence followed.
The ancient voice that had echoed out seemed amused by this as it continued.
|You were called the Great Usurper, yes?
Does this scare you?
The possibility of a purpose grander than anything you had before?
Becoming singed by the Flame of the Wheel of Existence means that whether you like it or not, events will start unraveling around you.
Causality will twist and distort in ways you cannot even imagine- all for the flow of the Wheel.
You can run from it, or choose to ignore it I suppose, but I've only found myself at peace just going with the flow.
And hey, there is the added bonus of an accelerated rise in complexity compared to any other creatures.|
The intent of the Usurper was silent at all of these words.
After some time, his voice echoed out.
|You realize that I will not stop assimilating your weavings?
In some time, your complexity will disappear as I take it over entirely.
Is that purpose for you?|
His voice carried a hint of defiance.
As if he detested the idea of some destined purpose!

chapters.title: Chapter 3494 Singed! IV
paragraphs: And yet the reply of the white gold spider burning with Source complexity was a somber one.

"Maybe, maybe not. If you do succeed in assimilating my weavings, will you still be you, or will my source be potent enough where you won't be the same anymore? Either way, whoever is in control will continue to have access to weavings of the Wheel. You will begin to see the flow clearly, and you can decide on whether you will kindle chaos or order. Choices. At the end of the day, it's all about choices..."
The voice remained as ancient as ever as at that moment, the massive figure of the white gold spider began moving across the gray white space of Megalos Nihilos.
Inside of it, a uniquely terrifying will continued assimilating its weavings without pause!
Far from Megalos Nihilos.
Within the weavings of the Megalos Beyond.
Near a Pantheon that was known as the Pantheon of Desoto.

A collection of humanoid Faceless Entities could be seen descending on the top of this Pantheon, the aura of a slumbering Pioneer and a dozen Existence Severing entities arising from it to face these unknown enemies!
An even further distance away from this Pantheon, there was a figure shining with obsidian gold light who was watching this entire event unfold.
It was a massive entity that had a worm like body for the bottom, and above, 18 serpentine heads sprouted!
Each of these heads shone with a golden brilliance as its eyes burned with a terrifying gold flame.
|What vile creatures are you? To mask yourselves like this bloom along with this Change?|
It asked the question to itself as there was nobody to answer, but its gold eyes could already see what would happen once the Outerversal Morphons and these Faceless Entities clashed.
Decimation would ensue.
And so, it made a choice.
|Starfall.|
HUUM!
From a distance.
An unfathomably far distance!
This entity uttered out calmly as the very fabric of the Megalos Beyond trembled.
An unfathomably far distance!
This entity uttered out calmly as the very fabric of the Megalos Beyond trembled.
Outerversal authority surged madly as golden flames also converged around them like singularities, forming massive swirls of black and gold that were the size of a hundredth of an Omniverse!
Starfall, this entity called it.
The fall of stars.
And yet, what formed were swirling masses of black and gold simmering with an ember of a scorching flame that was the size of a hundredth of an Omniverse.
Thousands of them formed as when observing the Pantheon in the far distance, this single cluster of scorching black gold masses...would cover all of this Pantheon!
The heat was so scalding that after they formed and began to descend, those down below felt their veiled skins prickling even from afar.
The white bands on the Faceless Entities brightened as they looked up and saw the scene.
The Outerversal Morphons below that were just rising to fight saw this scene and sought to back away in fright!
And yet regardless of their size, they came down with such shocking speed that they were already above the Faceless Entities and above the Pantheon before even an instant passed.
OOOH!

Roars of utter complexity bloomed from the Faceless Entities as terrifying dark towers erupted from their bodies, with some blooming with millions of terrifying dark Runes to explode out heavily as if they were directed towards the Pantheon below, it would be eradicated in an instant!
And yet...
SKEE!
When the scorching masses of black and gold came down, all of these millions of runes and towers lit up as if they were paper and became scorches entirely- turned into ash!

Thereafter, the thousands of scorching black gold masses smashed and uniquely passed through the Faceless Entities, descending onto the Pantheon below as they also...passed through the Pantheon as if they weren't even real.
Outerversal Morphons cried out and expected death, but they were shocked to find that they only felt a warmness as these terrifying masses passed through them and the black earth below them too.
But the Faceless Entities...
Their bodies trembled as the white bands on their heads vibrated only slightly before their white bands burnt away, and the masses within began to wriggle as they revealed themselves right after!
But even before they came out, even they became covered by a golden flame as they were scorched out of existence.
The scene was horror inducing to look at as Outerversal Morphons down below only stared dumbly.
Far above, the 18 headed black gold Outerversal Morphon had grim eyes as it looked at the wriggling masses that erupted from the bodies that were no longer veiled.
|Unnatural...|
Unnatural.
This was the word that this creature used as golden flames of a Singed burned within its eyes!
|O Master, why are you not here for this? What path did you take as all we are left with is your supposed Instrument in these times of uncertainty?|

The terrifyingly complex entity called out silently as in the distance, the utterly gorgeous scene of thousands of fantastical black gold masses passing through a Pantheon harmlessly and extending down below played out.
Far from here.
Away from these Megalos and Expanse- away from this Frequency of Existence entirely.
Inside another Spoke of the Wheel, within the Expanse.
A secret abode inside of a Blancverse within a Blancverse that only the highest echelons of the Logos of the Wheel knew of.
Here, in an isolated domain, a man found himself confined as all around him, there was only white blankness.

In such a space, light flickered as...a pristine and utterly magisterial black cat with a jewel on its head appeared, her serpentine eyes looking at the man with calmness as he also rose up to look at her.
His eyes flashed coldly as he spoke out.
"You give me a mission to issue, one that has caused a rift between the Wheelomachy and the Logos of the Wheel, and now I stand here confined. Do you care to explain any of this at all?"

chapters.title: Chapter 3495 Entanglements! I
paragraphs: A black cat in an expanse of white looked at a man who was seeking answers!
A father who had left behind his daughter.
"O McAllister, why point any fingers at this moment? In these grand weavings of the Wheel, everybody makes their own choices and owns up to their consequences."
The cat opened her mouth and uttered such words with a smile as McAllister remained cold and impassive.
His Source may not be as complex as hers, but he was not afraid of her. He was not afraid of death!
She saw his cold gaze as her smile became even wider.
"Okay, okay, it was my choice to hand you that mission and subsequently, I shall bear the consequences. What answers do you want? I will speak about what I can to the best of my abilities."
Her serpentine eyes blinked with honesty.
McAllister looked at her sharply as he asked.
"Those Faceless...Entities I barely glimpsed before being taken away. What are they? Since when did the Logos become aligned with them?"
The Black Cat blinked as it promised to answer the best it could, but the first question alone was already so heavy!
She paced around the white space for a moment before she spoke out seriously.
"For now, think of them as distant allies that have been with the Logos for some time, but are only able to move right now."
Allies.
Allies!
This word resounded in McAllister's mind as he asked sharply.

"When did the Logos of the Wheel ever need allies? Even the Watchers of the Wheelomachy, we didn't get too close to. Why these beings? For what purpose is the Logos of the Wheel moving towards at this moment?"
Purpose.
Every single entity seemed to be looking for it!
What were the Logos of the Wheel moving towards now with these Faceless Entities also at the helm?
The Black Cat was silent as after some time, she resumed once more.

"In the past, many of the missions completed...had inferences and ideas from them. Assassinate this entity, propel that entity, destroy that Alliance, ensure the eradication of these Lineages across the Frequencies...many different aspects of what the Logos of the Wheel has done had their influence behind it. I tell you this to allow you to understand where we came from, as only after understanding this can you understand where we are going. And as of this moment, I can tell you that it is all for greater Complexity."
Complexity.
"All of this...just for Complexity?"
The eyes of McAllister were dazed slightly as the Black Cat nodded.
"That and more, but you don't have the qualifications just yet. You can gain them. You can get access to understand more if you want."
"If I want?"

"Mmm. And I will keep it simple too. Join us- truly join us, and we can get you your daughter back. I know the regret you feel must be consuming you whole. And you won't even have to do anything crazy. The first and only mission you will be given is leading a few Faceless Lifeforms to track down the last thing we could recover from the weavings of your daughter before she disappeared. You see, they consider it truly important to wrap up loose ends, especially those involved directly or indirectly in contributing to the change. Your daughter is already pardoned as we simply need the one she became entangled with after her mission. A name we were able to dig out after much arduous work before the weavings of your daughter disappeared, and this same name is your target- should you choose to accept it."
Before the weavings of his daughter disappeared entirely, she had an entanglement!
Who? What was the target being put down for him to chase?
He calmly listened to the Black Cat as she opened her feline mouth.

"All I have for you is a name. You will have to find its weavings and everything else. Your target, should you choose to accept, will be someone called Noah Osmont. Just digging up that name came with a tremendous cost as we know nothing else. But this creature needs to be captured preferably. The Faceless Lifeforms will do the work, you will simply lead them. What shall it be?"
A choice had to be made.
McAllister thought about his daughter as he closed his eyes.
Her rage. Her disappointment. He convinced himself he didn't care. He told himself he had Severed everything!
And yet...
"Haa...." He sighed as he rose from the white blank space.
"Let us get it over with."
"Haha, I'm glad we can see eye to eye. It is good to have you back, little guy."
WUU!
The white space around them fluctuated.
It broke down and deteriorated as if it were a painting, revealing clear skies nearby as McAllister felt terrifying auras bloom behind him as if they were already there to begin with.

His gaze turned around to see the blank expressionless heads of Faceless Lifeforms who had a radiant white bar on their heads- and there were 12 in number as each one did not seem to have complexity any lesser than his!
They gave him an eerie feeling as the Black Cat in front of him spoke out.
"Your Faceless Squadron to lead. They will listen to your orders for the most part, and they would only not listen under very unique circumstances."
"Oh? And what would be designated as a unique circumstance?"
McAllister asked as the Black Cat only smiled.

"Don't worry too much about that. Head towards where you sent your daughter, and start there to find the weavings and location of this Noah Osmont. You get to him, you get to your daughter. Good luck."
WAP!

With a glimmer, the Black Cat disappeared as McAllister was left behind with the Faceless Lifeforms. He glanced at them as the unfamiliar sense only increased, but he buried it deep within himself as he spoke out.
"Let's go!"
He moved.
They moved.
Their goal was someone called Noah Osmont!

chapters.title: Chapter 3496 Entanglements! II
paragraphs: A Black Cat had disappeared in one region and appeared in another.
At this moment, she appeared in a serene blue domain that had a sea stretching out in all directions, and at its very center, there was an illusion of a massive tree.
The sea seemed to be reflecting itself above with a scintillating light, but the tree took center point!
The trunk of the tree was made up of countless lines, and it had branches shooting out from the top and bottom of the trunk as they connected onto a round ring brimming with brilliance.
A Round Wheel!

A wheel that spun with a buzzing humming sound as while it did so, the cerulean waters of the vast sea gravitated upwards before they fell off to the side, creating a fabulous scene filled with beauty.
It was a representation of something grand as at this moment, the Black Cat stepped on the blue waters to near this massive illusory image that had a single entity near it.
A humanoid entity shrouded in black, his head entirely covered as only a white vertical band of light was present at its very center.
The Black Cat came to stand near him as she looked at her reflection in the water.
Her clear eyes.
Her deep complexity.
She looked at herself, and a moment later, she spoke out.
"Must things be done this way in order for us to achieve what we want?"
Her words held no doubt, but they genuinely asked!
She genuinely wanted to know!
And the being before her continued watching the representation of a grand construct before he turned around.
His blank face locked onto the Black Cat looking at her reflection as an intent weaved out from him slowly.
"To effect changes...sometimes violence is required. A type of necessary violence."
Necessary violence.
The Black Cat mulled over this word before she shook her head and replied.
"From my experience, those who rush to violence are those most incompetent- regardless of the form of violence it is."
"From my experience, those who rush to violence are those most incompetent- regardless of the form of violence it is."
"We did not rush to this. For eons, we thought, for eons, we planned. Only after countless calculations and possibilities did we make a move."
His reply was a placid one as at such a moment, the Black Cat stopped staring at her reflection and looked at this being directly.
She looked at the black suit covering him as well as the white band shining brilliantly over his face.
She remembered eons of a face. Eons!
And now, she could no longer see it.
"Did you have to change yourself for this violence? From now on until our complexities collapse, I will never be able to see your face again, O Giuseppe."
The Black Cat stared at the Faceless Lifeform as she asked this, and it was followed by a heavy silence before the white band radiated a warm smile and replied.

"Out there, the Wheel of Existence has far too many complexities. Ankyras of Omniverses and Frequencies. Singed Ones, and other mysteries we cannot even fathom. Choosing to go against the Wheel is tantamount to choosing death. Unless there is true confidence behind everything, I would not have changed. To be able to stand for what is to come, to be able to fight the terrifying monsters out there...sometimes the only solution is to become one yourself."
WAA!

"Oh, and once we succeed, our weavings of existence will never collapse, O Azzurra. Wait for me. Continue waiting for me. When the dust settles. When the Wheel burns like never before. When all Frequencies stand below our feet...wait for me!"
The words were filled with conviction and confidence, and a Black Cat listened to them calmly as she couldn't reply!
Weavings continued to unfold.
The Wheel continued to turn.
In another Frequency of Existence entirely, weavings of change continued to unfold as causality spun its web.
Within the Expanse, inside a stretch of a vast golden sea.
Golden Titans floated within in large numbers as at the very center, a massive Golden Titan brimming with Source Complexity opened its eyes.
"I can finally move freely, but..."
A heavy golden brilliance burned around its body as before it, an illusory scene of events that had occurred not too long ago played out!
The scene was showing an obsidian gold winged Outerversal Morphon standing against Pioneers of all shapes and sizes as he bellowed out.

"Let us end our current Entanglement. You all came here to know whether I held the Resurgence of the lineage of Megalonians. I will tell you now that I hold what could not be obtained eons ago. The singular Megalonian who chose to dissipate his weavings of Existence instead of being devoured. I have taken the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian for myself!"
A confession.
A grand one at that as the Golden Titan looked at with a burning gaze and repeated the words uttered by the being in that scene right after.
"Ashes to ashes, dust to dust...is that right? Since a big guy like you appeared, since you affirm the weavings of a Megalonian, and even go further to eradicate my people...!"
His gaze was filled with a brutal rising rage as his Source burned.

"Let's see, you also killed the Pioneers of Palaces of Dark Matter and Antimatter...even your own Morphons. That will make it even easier. In this budding chaos, the weavings of a Megalonian and what that can produce will be critical. I...am coming for you, so called Instrument!"
WAA!
Weavings of plans began to be hatched.
It wasn't just occurring in this one area as multiple Palaces faced the decimation of their people at the hands of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
At this moment, they confirmed his weavings as if they were going to send anything towards him, it would have to be the allure of a Source Complexity!
And so, causality began to distort as the entanglements of the past bloomed into new Entanglements for the future. One thing led to another, and the grand weavings of the Wheel continued to unfold!

A Round Wheel!

chapters.title: Chapter 3497 Entanglements! III
paragraphs: The Expanse began to burn with activity.
Very few times in the eons past has there been a cluster of organized activity as much as at this moment.

Multiple factors came together to bring this to fruition as the very structure of the Expanse changed, with many Palaces of the Expanse experiencing the drop of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence as Strings of Existence snapped, and rifts of gray light spread throughout.
The root cause of a change like this had to be discovered, and while they were doing this...the weavings of the Megalonian that had made an enemy out of dozens of Palaces had to be obtained.
And so, like a roaring machine, complexity erupted and unfolded towards unknown directions.
One of the key figures at the center of all of this remained in the Megalos Ynnere.
He was but a humble farmer!
Inside Omniverse X-999. Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Noah sat on a throne surrounded by plots of farms as in front of him, the figure of Tam of the Singed bowed down while continuing to voice out its weavings.
"I seek permission from the Origin Singed to uncover more regarding those Faceless creatures that are now permeating across the Wheelomachy."
The reconstruction of Tam recalled everything up to its death. Within it, the Faceless Entities took center point in terms of importance.

"They seem opposed not to existence itself...but the very flow of the Wheel. The white band of light on their heads should serve as some form of a veil that keeps their true selves hidden. If ever they are exposed, their weavings fundamentally break down just from being exposed to the weavings of the Wheel. I believe these beings are extremely dangerous, and the fact they managed to enter the depths of the Wheelomachy is even more. Permit me to understand more about them, O Origin Singed."
Tam made a plea.

Noah looked at him calmly and thought of the Faceless Entity- as well as the massive eruption of what seemed like True Runes of Existence grinding their true body down the moment that it was revealed.
As if the Wheel itself was against these creatures.
This begged a critical question to be asked.
Exactly what types of entities would be so entirely opposed to the weavings of the Wheel that unless they were wrapped in a unique Faceless veil, they would be turned to ash?
A question without an answer as Noah nodded while pushing his straw hat up and looking around him.

"Your weavings were perfectly reconstructed as you hold the power of a Pioneer. If you want to come in contact with Faceless Entities that you should be able to handle, you can do so in the Megalos Ynnere. Here, in the Omniverses of the Commonwealth, there should be Faceless Entities running rampant."
Noah said such words as he thought of the memories of a now eradicated Sword of the Commonwealth.
If it was happening in one Omniverse, it was happening in others.
Tam listened to this as he bowed down even further.
"You had already grasped the flow of the Wheel this much, forgive me for being presumptuous in even asking. With your permission, I will take my leave right away."
Within Tam of the Singed, a dazzling gold flame still burned brightly as this entity remained one of the Burnt Ones.

He didn't hesitate to entangle himself in more things as Noah nodded with a sigh, sending forward a burst of weavings of information regarding the Omniverses of the Commonwealth into Tam before he waved.
"Go."
The Singed bowed before him again before the light of a gold flame wrapped around him, and he disappeared.
This was yet another choice that was made. From this, there would be more Entanglements as Noah wondered how it would unfold.

Tam of the Singed sets out to eradicate Faceless Entities under his permission. He is able to handle them enough as alarms are raised towards stronger Faceless Entities, and after a day or two- they descend onto Megalos Ynnere as at that time, who would be there to oppose them? "Is that how causality will play out?"
Noah smiled as he thought of that possibility.
Causality. Entanglements!

Since he confirmed with himself that he would not go to the route of isolation to prevent being swept by the flow of the Wheel, he might as well jump in fully and control the flow as much as he could.
So that later on down the line, he would not be put in a position where he was forced to make a certain choice.
The more control that he had, the easier the choices that he could make. And as always, the answer lay with complexity.
The more powerful he was, the more complex he was, the more choices became viable to him. And before him, there lay a few paths of increasing complexity.

One he had to wait for, with him not being able to contact Disciple Vashti within the Wheelomachy to enter the channel Bob left behind until things cooled down. At this moment, other Watchers should still be questioning her or observing the surroundings heavily.
Another path was the Resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian that many would chase after, meaning powerful entities would rush to wherever he appeared.
But this time, they knew his terrifying level of power as it would not just be Pioneers of Existence.

And even the Pioneers of Existence that would come may be of extremely high tier as defeating them would not be as easy. And when Source Complexity entities arrived? It would only mean a body of his getting captured.
So once more, it boiled down to power and complexity.
At this moment, he did not fear Pioneers of Existence as every single part of his was truly severed, with some surging up towards the first blockade.
The 27th Severing where the resources required jumped up by three times.
At this moment, only cheats had crossed this threshold as coming in close behind were Infinity, Quintessence, Protagonist, and a few others.
But at the same time, his heart was telling him to Sever the Atlas of Existence itself and the Systems of Existence contained within it many times over!
Because what would happen if he was able to sever the System of Existence of the Singed to the theoretical 81st Severing?

chapters.title: Chapter 3498 Entanglements! IV
paragraphs: There were many possibilities on which routes he could take regarding his own complexity.

Just as it was a daring question to ask what would happen if he was able to sever the System of Existence of the Singed to the theoretical 81st Severing, it was just as daring to ask what Cheats would bring if it reached that same height.
Or Infinity. Or Mana.
Or even the Amarantos Rune of Existence!
Each possibility seemed to hold heavy implications as the main thing in all of this...were the required resources for the Severings.

This was the fuel to his complexity at this moment as he felt like the more rounds of severings his aspects went through, the more complex he would become to the extent that even entities who had attained their Source would be manageable to him. Source Complexity.
Many wondered just what shocking intricacies such a stage held, but Noah didn't have to!
He had a Source Complexity entity tell him exactly how her power felt at that stage as from this, Noah was confident in not being able to suppress one at this moment.
He thought of the qualities Barbatos spoke of and shook his head.
"A Source is a qualitative jump. To overcome it..."
His figure rose from the throne and arrived before a stellar blue stalk that had bloomed into a tree.
He felt the vibrant complexity of this tree he was cultivating as after a few seconds...he spoke commandingly to the Infiniverse Megalos Body standing calmly beside his throne.
"Proceed with the switch. The Infiniverse Megalos Seed cannot be collecting dust in Hell Terra Firma like this."
Yes.
Many answers lay in Hell Terra Firma.
The answer to rapid complexity without much danger lay in Hell Terra Firma!
Satellites had been deployed. The lands were being mapped. More Settlements would be conquered as more Pioneers would follow, and eventually...even Source Complexity entities!
But Hell Terra Firma still held something far too critical.
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed itself.
The Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed was a good representation, but it was a shell compared to the Infiniverse Megalos Seed within Hell Terra Firma!
The Extremity Vein there. The Aletheian Havens there that were forged unceasingly. Its complexity that exceeded many Omniverses.
And the fact that even though its components had undergone True Severing...it was locked away in a place without Authorities to show just what heavy brilliance it could now unleash.
But most of all.
Noah's connection to the Infiniverse Megalos Seed was unbreakable.
Irrefutable.
Indefatigable!
He was Singed.
His Ordinances were Singed.
The pillars of authority that made up the Infiniverse Megalos Seed...were also Singed!
Just what did something like that mean? To be touched by the Flame of the Wheel of Existence, entities were elevated to a shocking extreme.
But it was something that could not even be passed on to one's Lineage.
In history, has a Planet ever been Singed? A Galaxy? A Reality? An Existential Domain? An Omniverse? A Megalos?!
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed was something far more special than any of these, and at this moment, it became Singed.
It couldn't be locked away any longer!
"I was just waiting for the command, Master. All preparations have been set."
Beside his throne, the Infiniverse Megalos Body smiled brilliantly as everything began to shake.
Noah's body was surrounded by an ever burning golden flame as he looked at his stellar farm before taking a step forward, disappearing from this domain and reappearing outside of it a moment later!
Outside, many things had changed.
The stable Frequency Gateway that looked like a wormhole stood like a multicolored circular sea by itself.
Above it, the bounds of the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed had been pulled and miniaturized as currently, it floated like an incandescent star above the Frequency Gateway.
That was where Noah had just come from!
The Infiniverse Megalos Body already prepared everything as Noah stared at the Frequency Gateway below, the miniaturized Infiniverse Megalos Seed beginning to descend freely at this moment!
Past the Frequency Gateway.
In Hell Terra Firma.
At the center of an advanced metallic technological base where not even a fly could pass through.
Another body of Noah stared at the Infiniverse Megalos Seed that was currently the size of a basketball.
Just as it could deny the terrifying rulings of Hell Terra Firma to expand into hundreds of miles while its power increased, it could miniaturize itself with even greater ease!
The dazzling multicolored Frequency Gateway that was now a stable channel was easy to isolate and leave by itself.
The Miniaturized Infiniverse Megalos Seed now slowly descended onto the channel as beside Noah, Barbatos, Ruination, and the Infiniverse Megalos Body looked at this with shining eyes.
Those who were locked within could be taken out in just a few more days safely. This method would be even quicker while achieving a terrifying feat.
As the process unfolded, Noah turned to look at Ruination.
"You go in as well. Let us see how bright your flame is. The Autonomous Quintessential Androids will take care of things here."
Ruination was another unbreakable connection that was nearly a part of Noah.
Another Burnt One!
She couldn't remain in Hell Terra Firma to collect dust either.

The crimson haired girl looked towards her Master and nodded, her figure sprinting on the metallic floor below them before she arrived on the outer ring of the Frequency Gateway and dove down gracefully!
Things went in, and other things would come out.
The Infiniverse Megalos Body here held bright eyes as she spoke.
"Monitoring for any changes as the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed both cross through the Frequency Gateway simultaneously."
Two unfathomably massive objects were miniaturized and passing across the same gateway!
It was a critical point in time as Noah closed his eyes, feeling his connection to both as they traveled across the only stable channel in and out of Hell Terra Firma!
A moment where another choice was made that would heavily change the direction of the flow of weavings from here on out!

chapters.title: Chapter 3499 The Embers of a Flame! I
paragraphs: A stable pathway that, the moment it was established...fissures and cracks extended across the Expanse as an unraveling reached an irreversible point.
A Change bloomed.
Whether it was a piece of the puzzle or a main part of it didn't matter- whether it was simply a small domino- a grand piece that was tipped over and caused everything else to fall did not matter!
What mattered was that it was there.
That one could pass through Hell Terra Firma and out.
And at this moment, something utterly massive crossed out!
It was made small.
It crossed the waters of the channel rapidly as while sharing the unbreakable connection, Noah observed it all!
Beside him, the Infiniverse Megalos Body continued her monitoring.
"Approaching 50% progress across the Frequency Gateway on both sides and accelerating."
A unique point approached.
Within the channel, the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed and the Infiniverse Megalos Seed passed each other.
Fantastical arcs of multicolored light flashed between them- almost as if the Infiniverse Megalos Seed was about to pull and swallow the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed whole!
But all there was...remained to be this interaction of arcs of light that allowed for a small segment of the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed to be pulled into the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
A farm and its radiant cerulean haven it was on.
That was it!
SAA!
The two objects passed each other and accelerated ever faster.
In Hell Terra Firma, Noah got ready to receive the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Outside of Hell Terra Firma, another body of his got ready for the return of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed for the first time since its disappearance!
|The passage of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed outside of Hell Terra Firma has been deemed a success.|
An intent rang out from the Infiniverse Megalos Body within Noah's mind.
It was the affirmation of a successful action as on the other side of the Frequency Gateway, a blinding ball of brilliance ascended with a terrifying weight and pressure!
With its ascension back into a Frequency of Existence, its complexity was shooting up rapidly as what it was made of was completely Severed.
Manadynamics. Relativity. Genesis. Dreams. Helios. Polarity! All these and more were severed as if the pillars of a structure became even more immense; the structure itself would be even more so!
But...there was something else in addition to many severings.
All these Severings had been affiliated with burns.
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed itself became afflicted with these burns!
It became Singed.
At this moment, it broke out of the Frequency Gateway entirely and spun above the isolated domain within Omniverse X-999, and in the next moment...
BOOOM!
One of the heaviest explosions of complexity Noah had ever come across thundered out.

It was accompanied by an eruption of a blinding golden flame that covered the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, this flame radiating such a terrifyingly complex light that it was reflected across Omniverse X-999 and a distance of tens of Omniverses beyond it!
That was just heavy and complex it was.
|Countless changes within the Infiniverse Megalos Seed are occurring and being analyzed for quantification in real-time.|
|The Extremity Vein is increasing in depth and complexity.|
|The Aletheian Havens are increasing in depth and complexity.|
|An Unknown Factor is budding from the center of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and catalyzing an advanced process.|
Noah's eyes were bright.
He basked in the grandiose light of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as prompts continued!
|The Analysis of the budding Unknown Factor causing an advanced change has been analyzed to be the Embers of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence.|
HUUM!
Immense heat was given off from the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Heat so complex and so unfathomable that it brought with it countless changes!
In Omniverse X-999, the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence were low just like many other areas across Megalos Ynerre, with cracks spread out across.
The moment that the blinding heat of complexity stemming from Embers within the Infiniverse Megalos Seed spread out...the cracks in space were pulled together as if the heat forced them close!
The Atmospheric Weavings of Existence...began to rise up once more!

At the center of Omniverse X-999, a certain Omniversal Ankyra looked around somberly as Autarchical authorities surrounded him protectively, and yet they felt like bundles of paper that could be shredded at any second with the swirling complexity nearby.

All that occurred was being monitored heavily as the one responsible for it all continued to receive shocking prompts. |Through the Embers of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence and the true severing of Existence, the Infiniverse Megalos Seed begins to bloom into the Infiniverse Megalos.|
|The Extremity Vein is transforming into the Severed Vein of Existence.|
|The Aletheian Havens are transforming into Severed Megalos Pantheonic Havens.|
|Embers begin to gather intensity at the center of the blooming Infiniverse Megalos.|
WAA!
The process was shocking to observe.
The massive infinity shaped Vein constricted and expanded over and over again as it was made aflame- iridescent golden flames raging over it and roaring out maddeningly!
The Aletheian Havens...rapidly expanded and increased in size and complexity as they became Severed Megalos Pantheonic Havens.
All over these different colored Havens, massive golden mountainous passages bloomed as they had eruptions of lava like gold flames blasting down and bathing absolutely everything.
It was a glorious scene to observe as while all of this occurred, Noah felt his own complexity rising in feedback to the budding Infiniverse Megalos!
It was always like this, wasn't it?

The more complex he became, the more complex the Infiniverse Megalos became...and vice versa. The two of them only propelled each other higher and higher as currently, the Infiniverse Megalos had taken center stage while it bloomed from a Megalos Seed and into a Megalos!
|Weavings of Complexity have reached a critical level.|
|Embers make way for an impossibility.|
|A Sliver of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence has been born in the Infiniverse Megalos.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3500 The Embers of a Flame! II
paragraphs: BOOM!

An explosive boom of complexity erupted as Noah's body felt a surge of simmering flames- his entire figure becoming shrouded by gold fires at this moment as he turned into a streak of light towards the Infiniverse Megalos!
He had to see it.
He could feel the change, but he had to see it!
The prompt that came with utterly shocking implications continued to flash over his eyes again and again!
|A Sliver of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence has been born in the Infiniverse Megalos.|
A Sliver.
A Sliver!
He moved across vast distances to appear in the core region of complexity- the area that held his multicolored throne which had countless lines connected to it shooting out all around.
It was currently empty and bathed with simmering crimson gold flames, and opposite it...a small point of singularity emanating waves of shocking heat was blooming.
If it truly was what it stated it was, this was far too fantastical.
Far too unreal!
Nearby, the visage of the Infiniverse Megalos Body formed and gazed at this scene with a somber expression, going forward to grasp what was budding from embers.
Her figure became tainted pure gold as what was budding within the core of the Infiniverse Megalos was something that she held full control over.
She cradled the embers.
She cradled what they were giving birth to.
And from the singularity...
BOOM!
Another burst of complexity erupted as a slender, thin strand of a flame bloomed!
It was pure white gold and only inches in size.
It felt faint as if it could flicker away and be put out at any moment!
It was...a wisp of a flame.
A Sliver of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence!
Noah observed it silently.
The Infiniverse Megalos Body itself was silent as it looked at the sliver of a flame blankly.
It was only after a few seconds passed that a brilliant light returned to her eyes as prompts resumed resounding within Noah's mind!
|A Sliver of the Flame of the Wheel. A Wisp of a Flame that carries with it countless complex computations.|
|Current Analysis shows the possibility of elevation in many areas being feasible due to it. Current Analysis also shows that the brilliance of the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel is not infinite.|
The complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos was moving rapidly to analyze the shocking object that had appeared.
And with every passing second, more possibilities were unlocked as finally, a clear usage came out!

|Inside the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel, trillions of runes have been discovered in its composition. The Wisp can be utilized for the transformation of normal Runes of Existence to True Runes of Existence.|

|The complexity of the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel is greater and more intricate than many other things previously observed. It has an effect of purifying complexity and elevating the complexity of those burned by it as it has been deemed possible to continue the Severings of aspects with it in a limited manner every single day. Too much usage of the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel may cause it to dim and die out.|
WAA!
A heavy, heavy possibility of wonder came.
Changing Runes of Existence to True Runes of Existence was terrifying enough as this was something that the Core Trace of the Wheel of Existence did after the input of endless droves of weavings.
But...complexity could also be raised by using this flame to complete Severings.
Severings!
The one thing he had to work extremely hard to achieve by obtaining bundles of resources.
This Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel could theoretically perform these severings as per the words of the Infiniverse Megalos!
But this was not it.

|Other applications include the purification of Existence itself due to prolonged exposure to the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel, with this theoretically allowing your existence to develop immunity to all fire-based weavings of existence.|

|Prolonged exposure to the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel will theoretically also begin cultivating Raw Severed Existential Power- a type of complexity where all of your weavings can be culminated to a raw power that overcomes any other complex weavings.|
One thing after another bloomed as Noah found himself nearing this dazzling white gold flame.
It looked so small that at any moment, one may think that it could just fade away, but it remained brightly burning above the palms of the Infiniverse Megalos Body who cradled it.

Initially, the fair skin on her palm had burned and nearly melted, but the glow of the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel gradually infused something into her as her skin stopped being affected moments later and healed!
The more Noah got closer, the more scorching heat he felt from this small wisp as ahead of him, the eyes of the Infiniverse Megalos Body were burning with golden flames as she asked.
|What would you like to do, Master?|
There were a variety of choices that could be made as they sought to understand exactly what had been born in the process of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed becoming an Infiniverse Megalos.
The Extremity Vein that stood guard at the center of the Infiniverse changed to become the Severed Vein of Existence while the Aletheian Havens became the Severed Megalos Pantheonic Havens.
But the most profound of all was the birth of this Wisp of the Flame that came from Embers- mere embers due to the Infiniverse Megalos being Singed!
And it only became Singed...due to its connection to Noah.
And Noah himself became Singed from a single Dream he held while farming as he followed up on the Weavings of the Wheelomachy left behind by Bob!
All of it...stemmed from causality and Entanglements.

Noah once more affirmed to himself that isolation was not the answer, and that he had to keep actively moving with the flow of the Wheel while controlling for as many things as he could under his own standing!
So he approached the burning white gold wisp as he called out.
"Let my weavings be Severed by the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel."
WAA!
It would be limited in number, but the first order of business was clear!

chapters.title: Chapter 3501 The Embers of a Flame! III
paragraphs: A wisp.
A white gold flame that was at most three inches in size, and yet its brilliance and heat were so powerful that everything in the surroundings felt suffocatingly hot.
By no means should such a small thing be capable of grand workings, and yet at this moment, the figure of The Infiniverse Megalos Body holding it whispered to the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel!
She whispered to it.
And a moment later, this Sliver of a flame flickered before it released a pillar of white gold flames ten times its size that smashed onto Noah's figure!
Noah's body stood still as this pillar of Flames smashed into him, his existence feeling like it was basking in immensely hot weavings that sought a direction at this time.
And direction he gave as he pointed toward a Source within him that was very familiar with the white gold flames!
They instantly coursed through and arrived at a certain part of him as the moment they did...
BOOM!
A ring of white gold flames burst from his glorious visage as a prompt arose.
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 2nd Severing.|
BOOM!
Another ringed blast of white flames erupted from him a second later as...
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 3rd Severing.|
After one, there came another. The Infiniverse Megalos had stated that the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel could be used in a limited manner every single day to elevate complexity.
What exactly was its definition of limited?
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
More and more blasts of white gold flames emanated from Noah as with each blast, his magnificence showed increased grandiosity and complexity as prompts began to flow down rapidly over his eyes!
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 4th Severing.|
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 5th Severing...|
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 9th Severing...|
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 18th Severing...|
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 27th Severing...!|
WAA!
Noah's whole body pulsed with tumultuous brilliance as a System of Existence within his Mundi of Power burned far too brightly!

His Atlas of Existence vibrated at the sheer advancement of complexity as the golden flame within Noah gained a pristine white radiance as well, his very quarks, leptons, and psioneutrinos feeling like they were set ablaze at this moment as everything danced excitedly.
The 27th Severing.
It was an arduous line to cross as after it, three Globules of Blood of Pioneers were required just to proceed with a single Severing.

And yet...the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel that looked like it could diminish at any second continued to shoot out the pillar of flames wrapping around Noah, the colors becoming deeper and purer as it continued!
BOOM
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 28th Severing...!|
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 31st Severing...|
It was an unfathomably glorious scene.

Blasts of white gold flames exploded from Noah as they seemed to be getting grander and bigger each time, his aura and complexity attaining ever higher stages as the flames surrounding him gained a deep white gold hue!
This wondrous change continued as at this same time.
From the Frequency Gateway down below.
POP!
The visage of Ruination rose up with her arms outstretched, crimson gold bursts of lightning wrapping around her as the moment she rose, a golden flame also burned her whole figure.
A Singed Object.
A Singed Construct!
It was about to begin its own rounds of advancement after being locked away in Hell Terra Firma, but in the next moment...
WUU!
The body of Ruination pulsed with resonance.
She felt a pull, her eyes opening to observe that in the distance, in the hands of her Master, a glimmering wooden-like object released low hums towards her direction!
In the next moment, it phased through the hands of her Master holding it and shot towards her at high speeds, and this was none other than the Piece of the Core Trace of the Wheel of Existence!
Her body didn't even get the chance to evade when it smashed into her and began sinking between the bountiful mountain peaks on her chest.

Her expression showed confusion as memories regarding what this object was were quickly emerging in her mind due to her connection to her Master, and her gaze became somber at this as in the next moment, an explosion of complexity erupted from her as well.
Something bubbled forth madly within the depths of her existence.
Her head forcefully raised itself, her eyes and mouth opening wide as they released beams of golden brilliance above!
|An Unknown Resonance has occurred between Ruination and the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel.|
|A process of Fusion and Assimilation has begun with Ruination and the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel.|
It felt like too many things were happening all at once.
In his advancement, Noah's will steadied itself and turned towards Ruination as he looked at her with brilliance.
An unknown resonance occurred, and the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel shot out to her as if it was possessed.
As if it found a counterpart that it had to join!
Why was this? Noah remembered those many months ago when he put together the Ruination Core.
What it allowed him to do those many months ago!
What Ruination herself made possible- it was something critical to where he was today.
At this moment, her body attracted the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel as it was yet to be known what would come out the other side.
But it would undoubtedly be something glorious as Noah's will returned to observing his own changes- a white gold flame continuing to sever many times over!
