|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 31st Severing...|
It was an unfathomably glorious scene.

Blasts of white gold flames exploded from Noah as they seemed to be getting grander and bigger each time, his aura and complexity attaining ever higher stages as the flames surrounding him gained a deep white gold hue!
This wondrous change continued as at this same time.
From the Frequency Gateway down below.
POP!
The visage of Ruination rose up with her arms outstretched, crimson gold bursts of lightning wrapping around her as the moment she rose, a golden flame also burned her whole figure.
A Singed Object.
A Singed Construct!
It was about to begin its own rounds of advancement after being locked away in Hell Terra Firma, but in the next moment...
WUU!
The body of Ruination pulsed with resonance.
She felt a pull, her eyes opening to observe that in the distance, in the hands of her Master, a glimmering wooden-like object released low hums towards her direction!
In the next moment, it phased through the hands of her Master holding it and shot towards her at high speeds, and this was none other than the Piece of the Core Trace of the Wheel of Existence!
Her body didn't even get the chance to evade when it smashed into her and began sinking between the bountiful mountain peaks on her chest.

Her expression showed confusion as memories regarding what this object was were quickly emerging in her mind due to her connection to her Master, and her gaze became somber at this as in the next moment, an explosion of complexity erupted from her as well.
Something bubbled forth madly within the depths of her existence.
Her head forcefully raised itself, her eyes and mouth opening wide as they released beams of golden brilliance above!
|An Unknown Resonance has occurred between Ruination and the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel.|
|A process of Fusion and Assimilation has begun with Ruination and the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel.|
It felt like too many things were happening all at once.
In his advancement, Noah's will steadied itself and turned towards Ruination as he looked at her with brilliance.
An unknown resonance occurred, and the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel shot out to her as if it was possessed.
As if it found a counterpart that it had to join!
Why was this?
Noah remembered those many months ago when he put together the Ruination Core.
What it allowed him to do those many months ago!
What Ruination herself made possible- it was something critical to where he was today.
At this moment, her body attracted the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel as it was yet to be known what would come out the other side.
But it would undoubtedly be something glorious as Noah's will returned to observing his own changes- a white gold flame continuing to sever many times over!

chapters.title: Chapter 3502 The Embers of a Flame! IV
paragraphs: The Infiniverse Megalos.
Ruination.
Noah!
All three went through their own advancements, and while this unfolded...a part of Noah didn't forget the things most important to him.
A part of him was already separated from the one accepting the baptism of the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel as he was looking at the forming Severed Vein of Existence.
One could barely describe the multicolored radiance it currently gave off, with it seeming like a living, breathing vein that constantly circulated waves of terrifying weavings inside of it!
And around such a vein. They could no longer be called Aletheian Havens.
They were termed the Severed Megalos Pantheonic Havens!
They looked like a massive mixture of planar havens and pantheons, the brilliance of Matter and Dark Matter seen all around them as they expanded endlessly.
Noah looked at such a glorious scene as he closed his eyes, the Severed Weavings of Cloning pulsing slightly as this isolated part of him...began to divide into dozens of other hims.
Dozens of clones of himself carrying a thread of who he was!

All of these clones then connected with the Infiniverse Megalos as they sensed the locations of specific people within the Severed Vein of Existence and the Severed Megalos Pantheonic Havens...and they disappeared in different directions right after.
Within the Severed Megalos Pantheonic Haven of Genesis.
Stellar white brilliance seethed all around as stretches of a Haven continued to be forged endlessly.
Within the deepest parts of Genesis.

Even as tumultuous expansion bloomed all around, there was a domain the size of a small world that held an exuberant amount of life force- with stretches of farmland extending all around as magnificent spiritual herbs were planted throughout.
In such a place, a middle-aged woman could be seen harvesting white apples that contained the mark of a golden flame at this moment.
She was studying it closely when she suddenly smiled and turned around as there...
"Mother."
Noah called out to his mother who turned to him with a beaming smile. She looked into his eyes, which seemed to hold complex emotions, as she waved her hands dismissively.

"Whatever happened, you don't need to feel any sort of way. It wasn't that long anyway. Come on, help me harvest these new fruits that are budding crazily and you can tell me all about what happened."
A mother told her son as he smiled, going forward to help her as he talked slowly.
A distance away from here.
In the Severed Vein of Existence.

In an area filled with the very extremity of ice and frost, a woman in a bejeweled blue dress sat on the peak of a mountain while staring at the cold lands around her, thinking back to a beast world and the frozen temperatures she endured when she was young.
She remembered the man that the moment she looked at him, her eyes saw a blinding gold radiance that gave her hope.
That was the starting point of everything.

She smiled as she thought of this man, and a moment later, she felt the coldness in this area instantly fade away, the snow no longer falling, and radiant rivers began to form down below the mountain.
The disappearance of the cold was followed by a voice she felt like she had not heard in ages, and yet it had not even been that long period of time that passed.
"I didn't make you worry too much, did I?"
Another body of Noah floated towards Adelaide as he asked, and the mother of his child shook her head while rising up and jumping into his arms.
"No. You promised me that you would always return, so I just waited patiently."
She hugged him tightly, her hands wrapped around him so intensely as if she thought he would disappear at any moment!
In another area within the Severed Vein of Existence.
In the periphery of a radiant blue sea, a small visage of a woman with a blessed chest could be seen on the beach of an island filled with vibrant vegetation and fruits.
She had a black bikini on that only further enhanced her beauty, her dark hair flowing radiantly as she was issuing a challenge.

She wasn't alone as around her, other utterly gorgeous women could be seen- with them being slightly more covered with sundresses on as they reclined on the beach while smiling and talking with each other.
Barbatos was taking centerpoint as she held a stick while drawing something on the sandy beach.

"As I was saying, no matter how powerful and complex he becomes, he won't suddenly want to increase the number of his progeny unless we make him entirely smitten. Now, I'm confident in myself completely, but if the rest of you can also wear him down, we may just succeed."
She was talking seriously as if she was discussing battle tactics, the other women rolling their eyes while looking at her as Athena's bronze skin radiated beauty while she scoffed.
"You're the first to get weak in the knees and give him whatever you want- you're all talk!"
Her words caused a few heads to nod as on the side, Sona shook her head while speaking out.
"You all can also just choose to communicate without any strings. I mean, the sex is good, but you need more than that. If you can get that other part, then maybe-"
"Maybe what?"
All the women stopped their conversations and turned up, the reflection of Noah seen above the radiant sea!
"Little Fish!"
Barbatos lit up and shot out like a bullet, the others rising up in shock as they also joined in.
What mattered the most?
At the end of the day, it was preserving the relationships of those who made every day worth living.
Family.
Lovers.
Friends.
Those who you could always go back to regardless of victory or defeat, and they would always be there for you.

As Noah Severed the Weavings of a new Source towards the highest level he had ever achieved so far, he reconnected with those most important to him after they were locked away for a brief period of time!

chapters.title: Chapter 3503 The Embers of a Flame! V
paragraphs: At the bottom of a mountain in a domain filled with verdant landscapes.
The figures of The Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, Ayame, Erikson, Dr. Hall, and many others were gathered down below.
If one ascended the verdant mountain, one would see the visage of a young man with gold-blue eyes that pulsed with destiny.
He seemed lost in thought when a moment later...
"My son."
A voice that he had not heard in what felt like forever rang out; Henry's figure rose as he saw his father's dignified appearance behind him and he instantly went to embrace him!
Noah patted his son's head with a smile as he also looked down below to the throngs of many other people.
His people.
His family.
His loved ones.
Those worth protecting in these increasingly chaotic weavings of Existence!
Threads of himself appeared and reconnected with them while his complexity continued to be elevated towards grander levels!
Megalos Ynnere.
Omniverse of the Protectors.
Near shattered weavings of existence. The remnants of the battle between Outerversal Morphons and Protectors could be seen, but at this moment- neither side was focused on each other.
They were instead looking above where a dozen Faceless Entities appeared- the level of oppression they radiated exceeding anything Existence Severing could ever portray.
A sense of desolation spread out in the surroundings as currently, a Dark Tower was rising from a star-shaped Outerversal Morphon who had severed his weavings of existence.
Yet now, he lay decimated with his weavings being used as a nutrient for the rise of something nobody yet understood.

The Shield of the Commonwealth, Old Man Eudemus, looked at this scene with a despondent gaze as with the rise of the dark tower, he felt his weavings and the weavings of all others nearby drawn into it seamlessly!
No matter how much they fought back or tried to keep their weavings to themselves.
They leaked out at a steady rate as they were seemingly being used as fuel for whatever this was.
Old Man Eudemus felt a sense of helplessness as he spoke out while gazing at the Faceless Entities above who looked at them as if they were lambs to slaughter.

|This whole time, I sought the solution to the Three Body Problem. I sought a solution between Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter...but the entrance of an outside unknown factor with much greater complexity shattered everything. So...was greater complexity always the answer to the problem?|
He was despondent as in the face of these terrifying entities- unless the ancient forces of the Omnifather came, what could they do?
All their history.
All the years of questions and answers!
All of it was reduced to nothing.
|Was anything we did worth it? The eons of war between the Megalos. The countless conflicts...was there truly no worth to all that struggle?!|
His despondency roared out in the end as he saw that before the oppression above- before the Faceless Entities and the rising Dark Tower, nobody could answer.
The whole atmosphere was that suffocating.
And yet at such a time...
"The struggle of existence is what keeps the Wheel turning."
HUUUM!
A voice echoed out.
With its mere resonance, there came a sense of brilliance as from above, a man adorned in gold robes appeared while looking at the dozen Faceless Entities and the Dark Tower they erected!
It was none other than Tam of the Singed, his weavings erupting out silently as they were those of someone who had already enacted a path.
He was a Pioneer of the Singed.

He had yet to claim or locate a Source for himself, but his path was a clear and distinct one as his appearance caused visible alarm among the Faceless Entities, their bodies instantly moving in a formation!
Old Man Eudemus looked above at this figure of an unknown man as he observed an illusory gold flame seemingly burning around him.
As if his whole weavings were set aflame.
Eudemus felt a sense of hope within those flames as he wondered which ancient powerhouse of their Megalos Ynnere this was.
He sensed the shocking level of power and purity around this being as was this not what he and many others aspired to attain?
Even in this heavy situation, Old Man Eudemus could not help but ask.
|Is Honored Sir sent forth from the forces of the Omnifather? Or another force from the Expanse that has not entirely abandoned their Megalos?|
He at least wanted to know.

And the being above kept his gaze locked onto the Faceless Entities as stanchions of golden brilliance formed around him one after another- coming together to form a mountain made of pillars of gold light!
It towered oppressively over the Faceless Entities who were sent here to handle Existence Severing entities and not Pioneers as his intent echoed out.
"I am but a humble weaver of the flow of the Wheel. I was sent by that same personage you have met before from Omniverse X-999."
Ridiculous words that Old Man Eudemus never expected to hear echoed out.
Tam of the Singed was a Reconstruction of Noah's weavings as he was given the relevant information regarding Megalos Ynnere and those of the Commonwealth!
He knew and recognized Old Man Eudemus as after these words were uttered, this old man felt like everything he knew was breaking!
What did he just say? From the personage stemming from Omniverse X-999?
The one that was pulled into a terrifying gray rupture not too long ago? The one he had been discussing the Three Body Problem with?
The same one who had yet to even attain a State of Existence days ago?!

Old Man Eudemus felt as if everything he knew was breaking down while above him, golden flames began to rage along with a terrifying intent that targeted the Faceless Entities. "Disruptors of the flow of existence itself...do not think your purpose will be achieved so easily."
Along with this intent, thousands of pillars of light rained down as scorching golden flames spread!

chapters.title: Chapter 3504 The Embers of a Flame! VI
paragraphs: The burning golden flames and the dark light emitted by the Dark Tower and the Faceless Entities were like oil and water- with everything utterly exploding out maddeningly as of this moment, the golden flames were much more complex!
The pillars of flames broke past the expanding domain of the Dark Tower- smashing into it and piercing its hard shell while also falling on the Faceless Entities.
The flames were iridescent as they looked like a light of purification that could not be matched!
OOOOH!
Old Man Eudemus watched as the Faceless erupted with terrifying Runes he had never seen before, their bodies being covered by iridescent obsidian light as illusory Towers also rose around them.
But...before the pillars of golden radiance, everything was pierced through.

The scorching gold flames were akin to being the very nemesis of the brilliant obsidian light as the body of one Faceless Entity took a direct hit, the black suit covering them forming a hole through and through as the white band on their head dimmed tremendously thereafter!

The body contained in the obsidian suit then began to wriggle out and expand in a maddening and eerie manner, a vile black mass erupting from it as the moment it came out of the protective coverings of the suit...
SKEE!
A wave of silent brilliance descended from the surroundings themselves and began to scorch this black mass into oblivion.
Tam of the Singed watched this with cold eyes as his body radiated even more gold flames!
|Such a vile accumulation of weavings will never be allowed to achieve anything here!|
The flames rose an octave higher as a scene that many members of the Commonwealth and the few Outerversal Morphons here would never forget unfolded.
As flames began to rage within the Omniverse of the Protectors.
Back within the depths of Omniverse X-999, inside the Infiniverse Megalos spinning with heavy changes.
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 53rd Severing...|
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 54th Severing...|
Under the concentrated effect of an incandescent white gold pillar of light radiating from a small flickering flame, Noah attained his highest Severing yet.
When it reached this point, the brightness of the flame dwindled somewhat.
And the radiant white gold pillar was retracted into the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence as the voice of the Infiniverse Megalos resounded out.
|A critical limit for the usage of the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence had been reached.|
|The complexity of the Wisp of the Flame regenerates automatically, and the size of the Wisp is expected to grow with nurturing from the Infiniverse Megalos over time.|
|In its weakened state, more means of utilization of the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence are being analyzed.|
The Wisp of the Flame reached its limit in the elevation of complexity through Severings- taking Noah all the way to the highest severing yet!
The highest severed part of him became the Source of the Singed, and he reached another line of demarcation.
The 54th Severing...felt heavier than anything else before as proceeding further beyond it would take tremendously greater resources.
But having reached the 54th Severing, Noah looked within the depths of himself and admired the unfathomably pure white gold flames simmering within his Atlas of Existence.
Their size and brilliance had increased to the point that currently, a cluster of roseing flames raged within the Mundi of Power and simply waited to be unleashed.
The level of complexity exceeded anything from before as it deserved some testing to see its true extent!

Noah breathed out while feeling the brimming complexity within him, his gaze going towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body that carefully pushed out the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence and placed it opposite Noah's multicolored throne.

It radiated a warm white gold glow that covered everything, with Noah being capable of seeing countless threads emanating from it and stretching out across the changing Infiniverse Megalos as its influence would continue to be a major one.
Noah thought of something and asked.
"What can this type of flame forge within the Blacksmith's Forge?"
Yes.
When it came to Armaments and Weapons, even those of the Omniversal stage were a thing of the past.
What could he look forward to ahead?
|A possibility in forging complex Severed Runic Armaments of Existence is there, with the natural flames of the Forge already influenced and elevated currently as testing will begin soon.|
"Mmm..." Noah nodded at this with a smile as he continued.
"And their application towards Weapons of Mass Destruction..."
They were required to be renamed as the type of Mass Destruction they could achieve should be capable of eviscerating Megalos!
If Tzar Versepiercers were tainted by the golden flame of the Wheel. If grander weapons were capable of being Forged.
|Theoretical models have already begun calculations, Master. The only other unknown...|

The Infiniverse Megalos Body looked away from the stable Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence as she turned her head in the distance where the figure of Ruination could be seen in a fetal position.
An Unknown fusion.
An unknown result with the Piece of the Core Trace of the Wheel!
Noah nodded as his body flashed, appearing beside the figure of Ruination suspended in space while pulsing with a tremendous complexity of weavings- her body constantly emitting golden waves of heat.
He sat beside her in the brightly lit space as he waited.
Above him, a dazzling white gold eye opened, its pupil gazing at Ruination and every single particle within her as the severed weavings of the Megalos pulsed within that single pupil.
It saw the very structural makeup of Ruination twisting and changing- becoming older and more ancient as if it was finding new pathways of complexity!
At this moment of unknown, Ruination remained in a fetal position as beside her, her Master patiently waited!

|Such a vile accumulation of weavings will never be allowed to achieve anything here!|
The flames rose an octave higher as a scene that many members of the Commonwealth and the few Outerversal Morphons here would never forget unfolded.
As flames began to rage within the Omniverse of the Protectors.
Back within the depths of Omniverse X-999, inside the Infiniverse Megalos spinning with heavy changes.
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 53rd Severing...|
|The Severed Weavings of the Source of the Singed have undergone their 54th Severing...|
Under the concentrated effect of an incandescent white gold pillar of light radiating from a small flickering flame, Noah attained his highest Severing yet.
When it reached this point, the brightness of the flame dwindled somewhat.
And the radiant white gold pillar was retracted into the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence as the voice of the Infiniverse Megalos resounded out.
|A critical limit for the usage of the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence had been reached.|
|The complexity of the Wisp of the Flame regenerates automatically, and the size of the Wisp is expected to grow with nurturing from the Infiniverse Megalos over time.|
|In its weakened state, more means of utilization of the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence are being analyzed.|
The Wisp of the Flame reached its limit in the elevation of complexity through Severings- taking Noah all the way to the highest severing yet!
The highest severed part of him became the Source of the Singed, and he reached another line of demarcation.
The 54th Severing...felt heavier than anything else before as proceeding further beyond it would take tremendously greater resources.
But having reached the 54th Severing, Noah looked within the depths of himself and admired the unfathomably pure white gold flames simmering within his Atlas of Existence.
Their size and brilliance had increased to the point that currently, a cluster of roseing flames raged within the Mundi of Power and simply waited to be unleashed.
The level of complexity exceeded anything from before as it deserved some testing to see its true extent!

Noah breathed out while feeling the brimming complexity within him, his gaze going towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body that carefully pushed out the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence and placed it opposite Noah's multicolored throne.

It radiated a warm white gold glow that covered everything, with Noah being capable of seeing countless threads emanating from it and stretching out across the changing Infiniverse Megalos as its influence would continue to be a major one.
Noah thought of something and asked.
"What can this type of flame forge within the Blacksmith's Forge?"
Yes.
When it came to Armaments and Weapons, even those of the Omniversal stage were a thing of the past.
What could he look forward to ahead?
|A possibility in forging complex Severed Runic Armaments of Existence is there, with the natural flames of the Forge already influenced and elevated currently as testing will begin soon.|
"Mmm..." Noah nodded at this with a smile as he continued.
"And their application towards Weapons of Mass Destruction..."
They were required to be renamed as the type of Mass Destruction they could achieve should be capable of eviscerating Megalos!
If Tzar Versepiercers were tainted by the golden flame of the Wheel.
If grander weapons were capable of being Forged.
|Theoretical models have already begun calculations, Master.
The only other unknown...|

The Infiniverse Megalos Body looked away from the stable Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence as she turned her head in the distance where the figure of Ruination could be seen in a fetal position.
An Unknown fusion.
An unknown result with the Piece of the Core Trace of the Wheel!
Noah nodded as his body flashed, appearing beside the figure of Ruination suspended in space while pulsing with a tremendous complexity of weavings- her body constantly emitting golden waves of heat.
He sat beside her in the brightly lit space as he waited.
Above him, a dazzling white gold eye opened, its pupil gazing at Ruination and every single particle within her as the severed weavings of the Megalos pulsed within that single pupil.
It saw the very structural makeup of Ruination twisting and changing- becoming older and more ancient as if it was finding new pathways of complexity!
At this moment of unknown, Ruination remained in a fetal position as beside her, her Master patiently waited!

chapters.title: Chapter 3505 Ruin! I
paragraphs: Noah's gaze was serene as he thought of Ruination's origins.
From pieces of a Ruination Core to Ruination itself.
A relic of ruin and wonder that went from a Cosmic Treasure all the way to its current standing!

It thrived in the Primordial Era within the Universes of the Primordial Cosmos, with Sages and Great Sages being the first users of Ruination as even they couldn't utilize it to its full potential- with their fates being led to ruin.
From there, came Noah Osmont.
"Hmm..." Noah raised his hand and stroked Ruination's head as he felt her eyes gradually fluttering, the flames around her reaching horrifying levels as to Noah...they only felt warm.
Gradually, Ruination's consciousness began to return as through their link, Noah sensed a great deal of things.

A burst of incandescent white gold light erupted from her one final time before her figure rose in space, swirling gold flames surrounding her as moment later, she opened her eyes as her gaze locked onto Noah!
"Master."
She called out to him respectfully as no matter how terrifying her complexity became, this man before her would always remain her Master.
He nodded towards her with a smile as he asked.
"What happened, and what type of complexity have you become?"
The musings of the Weaver of Existence covered her fully along with a terrifying eye as she quickly understood many things about herself!
She turned and looked towards her body that held white gold skin, with all clothing being burnt off as crimson tattoos of ancient and unknown runes could be seen covering major parts of her body.
She raised her hands as she spoke with bright eyes.

"The closest I can identify myself as...is a Severed Piece of a Ruined Source of Existence. It is hard to grasp and explain, but my capabilities to alter weavings of existence like the multiplication of Loot, among other things, has become unfathomably advanced. My previous features that wouldn't have truly affected Master's complexity before and not really add anything significant...I have now advanced so much that I could greatly aid Master's complexity."
Her eyes burned with emotion as she said this!
All she wanted was to be the most useful tool for her Master.
But she had lacked and been left behind many times over, hidden within the Infinite Forge as she sought for a way to break past heavy shackles!
The fusion of the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel and the flames of the Singed burning throughout her being allowed her to confidently say she could aid her Master.
Significantly at that!
"Oh?"
Noah's brows raised as he asked with tremendous interest!
And Ruination moved to her Master's side instantly, her hand rising and landing on his forehead as she closed her eyes and began to brim with brilliance.
In a short period of time, extremely dense waves of complexity gathered near Noah's forehead as a wooden True Rune of Existence began to form!

Weavings of Existence in the surroundings began to twist and distort at its mere appearance, with Atmospheric Weavings of Existence sucked in crazily as a golden flame that Ruination controlled seemed to be etching a terrifying Rune on Noah.
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Burnt Weaver, is being applied to your Weavings of Existence.|

|Under the Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Burnt Weaver, the Entanglements of existences surrounding you become extremely clear, with its effects covering a Large Domain of Existence you currently reside in. A Map of the Large Domain of Existence will automatically be formed as on it, Allies will be marked and distinguished, while those your weavings deem as Enemies will also be marked and distinguished. Neutral parties with no relevance to you and not entangled in any way will not be distinguished. A Single Large Map of Existence can be active at one time.|
On his forehead, a terrifying type of True Rune of Existence neared completion as its effects were already displaying even before it was fully done!
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Burnt Weaver, is coming into effect.|
|The Large Domain of Existence you are currently in, ignoring the Infiniverse Megalos, is designated to be Megalos Ynerre.|
|A Map of the Megalos Ynnere is being constructed.|
An unfathomably vast eruption of radiance erupted between Noah and Ruination.

Ruination's figure was pushed back and separated from him as her eyes looked dimmer and weary, and yet they couldn't hide the accomplishment within them as she looked at a terrifying wooden-like ancient rune turn transparent and disappear into her Master's body!
Before Noah's eyes, an extremely vast map slowly unfolded.
The Infiniverse Megalos and Omniverse X-999 were marked on it clearly as rapidly, this map began to expand and stretch out.

It covered a distance equivalent to 100 Omniverses. And then a thousand, and it continued to rapidly expand further as covered entire Sectors, going further than the equivalent distance of ten thousand Omniverses!
And it still continued to expand!
Before such a vast map, millions of threads of information began to form as it was all distinguished clearly.

In one region on the map, a distance away from here, he saw tens of thousands of white names that had a runic symbol of [ALLY] above them, with the name Old Man Eudemus appeared in one area amidst other names of Protectors of the Commonwealth!
In that same region, he also saw the bordered white name of Tam of the Singed that had a runic symbol of [ALLY] above it as well.
And near them, seven names that were colored black could be seen.
They had the runic symbol of [ENEMY], and their names shone with a dull green light!
Noah focused on the names of enemies as they were zoomed in, with more details quickly made apparent.

[Unknown Faceless Lifeform #323](Green):: An unknown lifeform labeled as an enemy purely because your weavings have distinguished all entities like them as enemies. This one is marked with a dull green light to portray their level of complexity being far below yours, and to show the ease in collapsing their weavings...

chapters.title: Chapter 3506 Ruin! II
paragraphs: The details of the first ever viewed name under the Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Burnt Weaver, continued as extra information was given to explain distinctions!

[...An enemy marked with a bright orange light on their name portrays one with a similar complexity to you, but with an extremely high chance of you still being capable of collapsing their weavings. An enemy marked with a radiant crimson light on their name portrays one with a higher complexity compared to, with there still being a possibility of collapsing their weavings if unique methods are utilized. Lastly, an enemy can be marked with an extremely pure colorless light as this portrays one with extremely complex weavings in comparison to you. The collapse of your own weavings may not be far away if you come face to face with such an enemy. Of course, everything is always free to change depending on a myriad of factors...]
Under the [Unknown Faceless Lifeform #323], all of this information was displayed!
A black bordered name that shone with a green hue.
Someone with low complexity that he could decimate with ease.
And if he came across any other black bordered enemy names, he would be able to distinguish their complexity based on the hue of color covering them!
Green, Orange, Red, and Colorless!
As he absorbed all these waves of information, he zoomed out of this name as he saw that a second later, it became grayed out.
And the distinguished names of other Unknown Faceless Lifeforms in that region also began to be grayed out as their complexities...collapsed.

Noah looked as the blinking name of Tam in that same area as it seemed he was working hard, having decimated all the Faceless Entities he found in that area as the dot of light representing him began to move away from this place that was the Omniverse of the Protectors and head out elsewhere.
Tam of the Singed went to search for more Faceless Entities.
Noah zoomed out of the Map of the Megalos Ynnere further as slowly; he looked at everything else.
It was littered with names.

He didn't know how many irrelevant names were not even shown, but he observed a distance equivalent to tens of thousands of Omniverses on this map, with blinking dots that represented Omniverses stretched throughout!
Those entangled and known were either labeled as allies or enemies.
And even if he didn't know them, if their weavings fell under the same frequency as the Faceless Entities already distinguished as his enemies, they would also be marked the same as them!
He continued looking around until his eyes stopped in another region.
There, he saw a blinking white name covered by a very bright green light.
[The Prisoner](The Antediluvian Caretaker)
The Prisoner.
The man Old Man Eudemus spoke of!
His name held a hue of a bright green radiance as his complexity was considered low compared to Noah.
Not too far from him, Noah saw a distinguished entrance of the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather where apart from many white names of allies, black names of enemies were also there!
[Unknown Golden Titan #2135]
[Unknown Golden Titan #2225]
Golden Titans were seen in a very dull green light as their complexity was not even worth mentioning. And he continued to look.

At this moment, he filtered out across the map and ignored anything covered with a green hue of complexity- his gaze intent on finding Orange Hues that would represent a complexity similar to his or a red hue that would state someone dangerous with a complexity even higher than his.
And...
WU!
His eyes flashed as he saw a marked area on the map that was quite a distance away from Omniverse X-999.
There, he saw a radiant black-bordered enemy name with an orange hue that was on the move!
It was deemed to be...another Unknown Faceless Lifeform as around it, radiant names with green complexity followed alongside it.
Noah looked at this moving party with cold eyes as the tool he gained to observe their movements and the movements of many others across the Megalos Ynnere...was utterly dreadful.
Ruination's means were utterly dreadful!
He was about to continue observing other Orange hues of names when suddenly, in the corner of his eye, a crimson radiance flashed.
Red.
The color red painted one area on the map of Megalos Ynnere as Noah's eyes were drawn to it.
An equivalent distance of tens of thousands of Omniverses away.
In a dark corner of the map of the Megalos Ynnere.
There, a deep red hue covered a name that read...
[Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather]
The Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather!
It was shining with a dangerous red light as currently, it was bordered by a white color that designated it as an ally.
And yet it stood still in its position at this moment even in the midst of all of this chaos.
Noah looked at this crimson name filled with complexity as he rose, his eyes flashing with a myriad of thoughts before he turned towards Ruination.
What she had done a moment after her advancement was far too magisterial, and his weavings told him this was only the tip of the iceberg!
Ruination caught his gaze as she spoke out with a brilliant light.

"If Master allows me to rest a little bit or I get support from you and the Infiniverse Megalos, I can add another Severed Singed Affix of Existence. The number that can be attached to you is limited, but the cap is nowhere close to being hit yet. Aside from this, there are a few other weavings of complexity that will be of great use to Master. All I need...is authority."
All she needed.
Noah smiled towards her as he beckoned towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body in the distance as well.
"And Authority you shall have."
WAA!
Ruination's capability to distort reality was always terrifying.
She was now capable of doing so at a terrifying scale as from Noah and the Infiniverse Megalos, dense severed weavings began to pour into her as she became surrounded by swirling white gold flames.
In such a state, she closed her eyes while bringing her finger to Noah's head once more.
"Does Master have any ideas on how to permanently distort the weavings of existence? Under your command, I will bring the very foundational rules of weavings to ruin."
Her eyes shone with a powerful light.
It was a light that was ushering in the Resurgence of Ruination!

chapters.title: Chapter 3507 Ruin! III
paragraphs: A Resurgence of Ruination!
Noah observed this firsthand as the moment that he agreed, the authority of the Infiniverse Megalos, along with his own brilliance, flowed into the weavings of Ruination.

Her finger touched his forehead as another blinding true Rune began to flow. The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Burnt Weaver, was terrifying enough as how ridiculous was it that the topography- the entire map of a large domain he was in, could be obtained so seamlessly?
That those within it could be labeled and distinguished where they were at all times?!
That so long as there was some form of Entanglement, enemies and allies alike that he didn't even know would be displayed?
It was a true violation of the weavings of existence.
A ruination of Existence!
And he was not stopping there. Ruination did not stop there!
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, is being applied to your Weavings of Existence.|

|Under the Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, you are capable of analyzing, copying, and extracting the Source of Complexity of someone you face. Depending on their level of complexity and duration of the proximity in contact, a compatible Crystallized Severed Path Pearl will be formed, and the weavings contained within are able to be seamlessly added and assimilated to your current severed weavings of existence. A longer duration of proximity contact with an extremely complex being will also allow the analysis and extraction of their Records, with Crystallized Severing Globules capable of allowing the severing of Sources also being siphoned at the same time without any move being made.|
Another daring Severed Singed Affix of Existence bloomed.
As it did, Noah was already on the move to follow up on what he saw on the forming map of the Megalos Ynnere.
The position painted with a deep red hue that stated here, the Remnant Weavings of the Omnifather stood!
A body of his was already formed to go and observe just what this was, and it moved even faster at this moment as the terrifying second Severed Singed Affix of Existence was built.
Severed Extractor.
So long as he was just near truly complex beings, he could attain their compatible Ordinance to Path- and it would be sublimated to himself as his own Severed Weaving!
It went even further as so long as the contact of just being near them was maintained, Crystallized Severing Globules that could allow for more severings would passively be attained.
It was a true distortion and Ruination of the weavings of Existence!

Noah felt like Ruination had gained access to a sliver of a source code that allowed the weavings of Existence to flow, and she now was simply working from a vantage others could not see to distort these very weavings for Noah's favor.
Good.
Noah needed more of this as, throughout his journey, time was always something he didn't have compared to these complex beings that had lived for millions or billions of years already.
No matter how exceedingly above average and ridiculous he was, there were others out there with terrifying complexities.
Entities like Pyrrhus. Or the Singed. Or the Omnifather. Or the Great Beyonder. Or any others that he currently did not even know about.
Given time, what could these beings have achieved?
And since he himself did not have time, he had to bend the rules of existence to give himself an edge against those who had been roaming for cycles.
And so...
HUUUM!

Weavings of Existence filled with gray cracks and lines stretching throughout like a disease flickered in the surroundings as Noah arrived at the edges of the area tainted by the red light of complexity that should be much higher than his.
And yet...
He sensed nothing here.
He only saw how, in comparison to his own home, this area and many other areas of the Megalos Ynnere likely carried this same sense of desolation at this moment.
Gray fractures spread throughout as the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence were utterly decimated to low levels.
He delved deeper and deeper in while observing his surroundings, confirming with the Map enacted by the Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Burnt Weaver, but there was still nothing here!
BOOM!
He spread his severed weavings out madly.
Above him, a dazzling white gold eye opened and looked around as, truly, it couldn't capture anything!
At such a juncture, he could only smile as he thought about a certain place.
A place he had arrived at when he truly severed his weavings of existence.
He closed his eyes as all of his body buzzed and trembled, and in the next moment...
WAP!
He disappeared from this location.

Actually, this description was wrong as he didn't simply disappear, but it seemed like he melded into the surrounding weavings of existence entirely as he became indistinguishable from anything nearby!
Everything looked and seemed the same.
And yet at a place where those with certain levels of complexity could not even dream of...
HUUM!
Noah opened his eyes to once more find himself in that unique region of utter darkness where nothing could be seen, and even being here carried a sense of pressure as moving about...was even harder!
It was slightly easier to move around here now compared to before, but the difficulty wasn't altered too greatly.
But there were some changes.
Like the fact that around him, there was a serene white gold flame that made his body look like a candle in the middle of an immense darkness.
His surroundings were lit up to a certain extent as there.
In the distance.
A Humanoid figure could be seen.

Features of the Antediluvian Leviathans were present, but this entity was only a bit over 2 meters in size as he was adorned in a tattered white robe that seemed ready to fall apart at any second, and his skin had cracks all around that made him seem decrepit and old, and yet also filled with a dangerous sense of complexity!
But Noah recognized him.
It was the visage of none other than the Omnifather!

sentences.text: A Resurgence of Ruination!
Noah observed this firsthand as the moment that he agreed, the authority of the Infiniverse Megalos, along with his own brilliance, flowed into the weavings of Ruination.
Her finger touched his forehead as another blinding true Rune began to flow.
The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Burnt Weaver, was terrifying enough as how ridiculous was it that the topography- the entire map of a large domain he was in, could be obtained so seamlessly?
That those within it could be labeled and distinguished where they were at all times?!
That so long as there was some form of Entanglement, enemies and allies alike that he didn't even know would be displayed?
It was a true violation of the weavings of existence.
A ruination of Existence!
And he was not stopping there.
Ruination did not stop there!
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, is being applied to your Weavings of Existence.|
|Under the Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, you are capable of analyzing, copying, and extracting the Source of Complexity of someone you face.

Depending on their level of complexity and duration of the proximity in contact, a compatible Crystallized Severed Path Pearl will be formed, and the weavings contained within are able to be seamlessly added and assimilated to your current severed weavings of existence.

A longer duration of proximity contact with an extremely complex being will also allow the analysis and extraction of their Records, with Crystallized Severing Globules capable of allowing the severing of Sources also being siphoned at the same time without any move being made.|
Another daring Severed Singed Affix of Existence bloomed.
As it did, Noah was already on the move to follow up on what he saw on the forming map of the Megalos Ynnere.
The position painted with a deep red hue that stated here, the Remnant Weavings of the Omnifather stood!
A body of his was already formed to go and observe just what this was, and it moved even faster at this moment as the terrifying second Severed Singed Affix of Existence was built.
Severed Extractor.
So long as he was just near truly complex beings, he could attain their compatible Ordinance to Path- and it would be sublimated to himself as his own Severed Weaving!
It went even further as so long as the contact of just being near them was maintained, Crystallized Severing Globules that could allow for more severings would passively be attained.
It was a true distortion and Ruination of the weavings of Existence!

Noah felt like Ruination had gained access to a sliver of a source code that allowed the weavings of Existence to flow, and she now was simply working from a vantage others could not see to distort these very weavings for Noah's favor.
Good.
Noah needed more of this as, throughout his journey, time was always something he didn't have compared to these complex beings that had lived for millions or billions of years already.
No matter how exceedingly above average and ridiculous he was, there were others out there with terrifying complexities.
Entities like Pyrrhus.
Or the Singed.
Or the Omnifather.
Or the Great Beyonder.
Or any others that he currently did not even know about.
Given time, what could these beings have achieved?
And since he himself did not have time, he had to bend the rules of existence to give himself an edge against those who had been roaming for cycles.
And so...
HUUUM!

Weavings of Existence filled with gray cracks and lines stretching throughout like a disease flickered in the surroundings as Noah arrived at the edges of the area tainted by the red light of complexity that should be much higher than his.
And yet...
He sensed nothing here.
He only saw how, in comparison to his own home, this area and many other areas of the Megalos Ynnere likely carried this same sense of desolation at this moment.
Gray fractures spread throughout as the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence were utterly decimated to low levels.
He delved deeper and deeper in while observing his surroundings, confirming with the Map enacted by the Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Burnt Weaver, but there was still nothing here!
BOOM!
He spread his severed weavings out madly.
Above him, a dazzling white gold eye opened and looked around as, truly, it couldn't capture anything!
At such a juncture, he could only smile as he thought about a certain place.
A place he had arrived at when he truly severed his weavings of existence.
He closed his eyes as all of his body buzzed and trembled, and in the next moment...
WAP!
He disappeared from this location.

Everything looked and seemed the same.

But Noah recognized him.

chapters.title: Chapter 3508 Ruin! IV
paragraphs: The visage of the Omnifather!
Noah observed it clearly as the moment the light of his white gold flame reached out and enlightened this area and this figure...
BUZZ!
Arcs of heavy complexity erupted from the Remnant Weavings of the Omnifather before him as his eyes opened!
They were filled with a terrifying light of ferocity and power the moment that they opened, they were ready to collapse whatever had woken it up!
But they ascertained who it was an instant after.
The ferocious expression on the Remnant Weavings of the Omnifather faltered thereafter, his eyes gaining a sense of calm as he looked closely at Noah.
At the golden flame burning around him.
At the calm weavings of Matter and even Dark Matter that nobody should be able to easily observe!
The Remnant Weavings of the Omnifather observed all of this as Noah remained silent, waiting for something to be triggered as a moment later, in the depths of his mind...
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, has been activated.|
|The target in close proximity has been deemed to be the Red Tier Transcendent Source Complexity Weavings of the Omnifather. |
A visible smile bloomed on his face as the ridiculous boons of Ruination started right away.
He also grasped something new: the Red Tier Transcendent Source Complexity Weavings!
This was what he currently looked at as a moment later, the mouth of the entity before him opened to reveal an ancient voice filled with depth.
"Why has a Singed appeared before a segment weaving of mine after all this time? I came to you all before and you turned me away, promising no Entanglement of Weavings between us. So why?"
A burst of heavy information came as Noah looked towards the Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather while tilting his head!
He asked with bright eyes.
"Do you not know me at all? Is nothing regarding what is occurring in the Tresorverse Sacred Domain you enacted being observed by you?"
WAA!
The moment he said this, the pupils of the Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather before him trembled slightly before they began to shine with even grander light.
"The Tresorverse Domain...right, there was that."
He spoke as if he was recalling something from a long time ago.
Something he had long since forgotten!
Noah looked at such an expression on this being as he frowned.
"What happened to you? Do you no longer know what is occurring within the Megalos Ynnere? The Expanse? Your Origin Frequency?"
He asked freely and without worry.
So freely that the Remnant Weaving ahead of him raised its brows and commented on this!

"You speak without an ounce of fear even though you know who I am. Even though you should sense the complexity of even this Remnant of mine exceeding yours. Do you so heavily trust that I will do nothing to you just because you are Singed by the Wheel? Do you think that just because you have a part of your weavings here, I would not be capable of tracing it to your Source Origin? Has the quality of Singed fallen this far after just a few cycles?"
The eyes of the Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather flashed dangerously.
He asked something heavy as towards this, Noah did not even worry as he shook his head calmly.

"Whatever happens to this body here will be of no consequence. And if you think you can trace my origin weavings from just this body, you can always try. I do not show fear because I did not think I needed to. I keep a level of respect because of the help I received from you within the Tresoverse Domain. I have also been curious about the Omnifather, who left his name behind and disappeared. I've always had many questions that now that there is an opportunity to actually ask, I have to ask regardless of whether I receive an answer or not."
His reply was placid.
He was not worried about being tracked down as his weavings were truly and completely Severed.
He innately knew that another quality and boon of this was the fact that nobody could take one body of his and use it to locate another.
There was a sense of separation he could enact in between because of what he had attained.
Because of True Severing!
The Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather slowly changed his expression and looked towards Noah calmly before he spoke again.

"You are a Singed that has not gotten in contact with the rest of them if you do not know all of these things it seems. Unique. I did not think the Wheel still cared to make more Singed, not after what almost happened to its Flame...ah, no matter. My weavings do not matter to you. My path is my own and does not matter or coincide with yours. You should even be glad not to have Entanglements between us that reach irreparable levels, as by then...only pain and disappointment would lie ahead. The Weavings of Existence are unfathomably vast, and Entanglements...only bring about pain."
WAA!
As he spoke, his eyes seemed to remember too many things as Noah silently listened.
He remembered what had set off the chain of events for the Megalonians.
The love story between him and a Megalonian.
As he thought of this, he raised his hand as a multicolored brilliance began to seethe around him.
The Source of the Megalos within him burned brightly and came out at the very forefront.
The severed weavings of a Megalonian exploded from him in the next moment and became abundantly clear, the Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather seeing this as his pupils shook!
His gaze became extremely somber in the next moment as he looked towards Noah as if he were looking at a dead man.
"I see."
HUUM!

"You are truly too entangled now. And this...should also be my fault since you have been to the Tresoverse Domain. Ah, my idealistic old weaving is coming back to bite me even now. Very well. Young Friend, tell me nobody else knows about your weavings of a Megalonian."

chapters.title: Chapter 3509 Versality! I
paragraphs: An immense silence came as the Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather asked Noah a critical question.
That nobody else knew he held the weavings of a Megalonian!
And yet towards such a question, Noah was placid as he stated simply without explaining.
"Such knowledge has begun to spread."
The eyes of the Remnant Weavings of the Omnifather vibrated as they dimmed slightly.
He then shook his head as if it could not be helped.

"The Wheel turns as the wheel turns...how ridiculous. The Weavings of Megalonians were unique across the Frequencies. Their weavings, if utilized in a unique manner, would make it possible to affect multiple Megalos of different Frequencies all at once, and much more. If you have not been captured yet, then I will advise you to take all your weavings into this place..."
He pointed to the empty darkness all around as he called this a place of refuge.
"They will come after you. Regardless of what is happening right now."
His eyes dimmed more and more as he said this, with Noah remaining calm as he asked in turn.
"What is this place? Who are these entities you speak of?"
He asked, but he received no answer.
The Remnant Weavings only seemed distracted and lost as Noah asked once more.
"You failed Existence Severing, and yet your weavings did not collapse. Where did you go? What do you know about Faceless Entities?"
One question after another was thrown out as Noah even waved his hands to cause the emergence of an illusory scene that showed images of the Faceless Lifeform!
He wanted to obtain as many things as possible from this Remnant Weaving, so he asked all he could!

The Remnant Weaving didn't even flinch at the questions asked His last question and the display of Faceless Entities though...this caused the pupils of the Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather to constrict!
His voice was low as it echoed out again.
"I see. So they succeeded in the end."
WAA!
Even more cryptic words echoed out as Noah frowned.
"I enjoy mystery as much as the next guy, but you could make a lot of things clear by speaking straightforwardly for a few seconds. A lot of things are on the line as far as I know."
Noah's eyes were bright as he made his words clear!
And yet the Remnant Weaving only shook its head thereafter.

"I am preventing waves of calamity from falling on you by not telling you much. When complexity reaches certain levels, enemies are able to attack not just you, but also your Entanglements. For entishareho are severed from the weavings of existence, the connections we choose to form are that critical. Entanglements can be observed and utilized by others. Who you shared a conversation with. Who you provided critical information that altered their complexity greatly or led them towards other Entanglements. Answers...are sometimes sought, but should not be obtained. Uncover them yourself if you must. But any answers from me may just guarantee your death. I have too many enemies."
His gaze was unfocused.
As if he had seen too much. Gone through too much!

"If those guys are making their appearance now, then the ball has begun rolling. The Wheel is accelerating. In that chaos, you may flitter through the gaps and survive. If I can give you any possible advice without forming too heavy Entanglements, it is for you to find the other Singed. The only other possible safe haven may be with the Wheelomachy- over there, see if you can locate one by the moniker of Bob. Protect yourself...and good luck. And do not take this the wrong way, but I sincerely hope we do not meet again."
His ancient words were sharp as moments after he finished them, his Remnant Weaving here began to crack.
Noah frowned at this as he asked again.
"Where are you? What do you know of the Great Beyonder? Who else is chasing after the weavings of Megalonians?"
Question after question flowed, but no answer came from the Remnant Weaving as it only shook its head while things flickered away!
"I have made many mistakes in my time, and I will not make any more. The ordeal ahead will be a heavy one, good luck "
A dark radiance wrapped around the Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather as he was about to disappear.
In the fraction of an instant before he did...
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, has successfully attained a Crystallized Severed Path Pearl deemed compatible with your weavings.|
|The Crystallized Severed Path of Versality has been obtained.|

In a flicker of brilliance, the visage of the Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather disappeared entirely as on the map provided by the Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Burnt Weaver, the red marking was no more!
The red marking that represented this Red Tier Transcendent Source Complexity entity disappeared as it seemed that the Remnant Weaving of the Omnifather relocated itself entirely.
It did not wish to provide too many threads of information as this could form Entanglements that could pose great dangers.
But Noah had still obtained a lot as apart from a few threads of information, there was also the wonder brought forth by the Burnt Weaver.
The Crystallized Severed Path of Versality!
A word rooted in the weavings of Verse. A possible reason as to why even after failing Existence Severing, the Omnifather still managed to survive with the help of his lover!
Versality held its root in a simple meaning of turning or bending. Of composition and makeup.
Universe. Omniverse. Infiniverse. Unique compositions of Existence!
To follow the path of Versality was to be adaptable to any possible weaving of existence.
To even the adaptable when one's existence severing collapsed as they still found a way past this with another composition of their existence!
It was a unique pathway as Noah waved his hand to reveal a circular singularity that pulsed with waves of purple radiance.
The first loot obtained by not doing anything apart from staying in close proximity to someone truly complex!

chapters.title: Chapter 3510 Versality! II
paragraphs: The first loot was obtained by doing nothing!
Noah grasped the stellar purple singularity in his hand before he sent the command to take it into his weavings of existence.
|The Crystallized Severed Path of Versality is being utilized to incorporate the Severed Path of Versality.|
|A new addition is being seamlessly assimilated into your weavings.|
A new process began as Noah looked around the dark area of heavy complexity free of weavings of Existence.
It seemed that those truly complex entities loved to roam and be within places like this as for now, Noah's complexity was nowhere near enough to fully delve into such places yet.
His body became wrapped in layers of light as he disappeared from this place and returned to the Megalos Ynnere.
Before his eyes, the Map of the Megalos Ynnere flashed along with the countless entities within it and those distinguished as enemies by it.
The Map continued to be built and expanded even now as with it, the number of things Noah could do increased tremendously.
He could see all his enemies while they had no idea about him.

The Faceless Entities stretched throughout this Megalos as currently, only one with a burning Orange radiance of danger moved about, but the Megalos Ynnere was still a complex area that held its own secrets!
As the map continued to expand, Noah observed other areas covered by an Orange brilliance, and others even had a faint Red radiance of complexity!
And many shone with a neutral white border as they were not necessarily enemies.
He looked at the distinguished names thoughtfully.
[Unknown Red Tier Source Complexity #2]
[Unknown Orange Tier Constellation Complexity #4]
[Unknown Orange Tier Constellation Complexity #3]
Even though the most complex beings had likely relocated to the Expanse for grander weavings, there were still those that remained in the Megalos Ynnere!
Noah looked at the blinking lights that represented Faceless Entities as he debated.
None had Red Tier Source Complexity burning around them as he should be able to take them down without an issue. It was what would occur after that.

When the weaker ones fall, the stronger ones come to play. He needed to pace himself and elevate his power to at least be capable of standing against Source Complexity entities before this happened as for now...Tam of the Singed could continue clearing them out slowly!
He was waiting for a few more boons and bursts of power to kick in as in the meantime...
"Let's see what other mysteries the Megalos Ynnere holds..."

As the seconds trickled by on his way to a new target, his body buzzed with bursting Complexity as an add on was successfully assimilated!
|The Severed Weavings of Versality have Quintessentially fused into your being.|

|It is now possible to select a Verse to irreparably bind and mark, with your complexity rising and never being capable of fading so long as the bound and marked Verse remains intact. If the chosen Verse is ever destroyed, an unknown level of damage would irreversibly be imposed on your weavings of existence.|

Noah's eyes flashed sharply as he thought of this pathway that the Omnifather had forged. It allowed him to bind onto a Verse of his choosing and explode his complexity upwards, with his weavings always remaining intact no matter how many times he was destroyed so long as that Verse existed!
Noah didn't have to think before making a selection.
|Under the Severed Weavings of Versality, the Infiniverse Megalos has been selected.|
|Your connection with the Infiniverse Megalos is already at a Quintessentially maximum possible level.|
|The feedback of the Severed Infiniverse Megalos Physiology is being elevated to Quintessential levels.|
BOOM!
The heaviness of his body instantly erupted to reach terrifying levels.
The weight and complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos...felt like it was flowing through him im utterly ridiculous flows as how complex was a Megalos?
Has anyone ever dreamed of being smashed with the sheer majesty of an entire Megalos through a single fist?
The moment these weavings flowed through Noah, The colors on the map changed as the green lights around countless names became a dim green.
As if his complexity had taken another jump as compared to theirs, it was nothing to worry about.
Of the areas that had Orange lights...three changed colors from Orange to bright green!
The Unknown Faceless Lifeform that was moving rapidly while emitting an Orange light turned green.

It was an observation of changing complexity in real time as when Noah looked ahead to where he was going, and the red brilliance of that area only lost a portion of its luster, but still remained red.
Much higher in complexity than him.
He may be able to withstand it with his unique means as there was a low chance of killing such a being.
It had to be someone with a source as after some time...
WAP!
Noah warped to arrive in a space that pulsed with a unique frequency.
This time, Noah didn't have to look around too much before he observed an Omniverse covered by a transparent barrier- one that even Pioneers would have a hard time seeing through or getting across!
But his eyes observed it clearly, along with the neon light that surrounded it.
A hidden Omniverse.
He gazed at it calmly as he didn't even need to enter, with him simply remaining floating in space as his aura was wild and free.
Undoubtedly, whatever Source Complexity entity was here had already known that someone foreign had arrived!
And a second later...
HUUM!
A terrifying grandiosity erupted in front of him.
Space distorted as with neon radiance, the visage of a Source Complexity entity bloomed!
It was...a woman adorned in a neon kimono, her visage radiant as her dark hair was put up in a ponytail. Her eyes were sharp like swords, and her neon pupils shone with solemnity as she spoke!
"Who are you? What do you want?"
Her words were cautious and filled with solemnity as if she didn't even wish to be out of her Omniverse, but she couldn't leave Noah be after arriving here purposefully!
Noah's eyes flourished with light and brilliance as slowly, the weavings of this complexity before him were read in a limited manner.
"I'm Osmont. Noah Osmont. You are?"
He didn't state his purpose.
And the fair skin of the woman before him shone dangerously as she replied.
"Yoo Jin. Again, what do you want?"
Complexity began to buzz as Noah came across another Source Complexity entity!

chapters.title: Chapter 3511 Sources! I
paragraphs: Yoo Jin.
The Source Complexity Entity hidden in a small Omniverse within Megalos Ynnere continued to cautiously look towards Noah as she asked!
Noah looked at her in turn.
His purpose.
It was to always increase Complexity, but he couldn't simply tell her that just by being near her, he could siphon off her Source and increase his complexity!
So he spoke of other matters.
He looked around them at the gray cracks that extended even into her Omniverse as he spoke.
"A heavy Change occurred that affected everything in this Frequency. With Megalos Ynnere as my home, I wanted to see if it had any other powerful protectors who could help me combat these changes."
Protectors at a scale that the Commonwealth couldn't even imagine.
Yoo Jin listened to such words as she shook her head.

"I have isolated myself all these years and stayed away from any weavings of others. That so called Commonwealth, I steered them away if ever they got close. Outerversal Morphons weren't able to connect to anything in my home. I've stayed away this whole time...and I do not plan to change that. Please leave."
She was straightforward.
Even though she was of higher complexity than Noah, she still spoke politely!
She was someone who was genius enough to Pioneer her own path and even find her Source, and yet she chose the route of isolation and not getting involved with others.
It may have worked.
Before.
"You were able to stay isolated before. That will no longer be the case. I found you, others can also find you. Your biggest worry at this moment are these guys..."
He waved his hands to show the outline of Faceless Lifeforms.
He pulled from the Reconstruction of Tam of the Singed to display the scenes he had observed on the Omniverse of the Protectors, as well as what he had seen in the Palaces of the Wheelomachy!
"I'm sure you've waded across the Expanse even if you have been isolating yourself. Have you heard of the Wheelomachy?"
He asked while showing the shocking scenes that caused her brows to furrow.
She nodded slightly in reply.
"The Watchers...Palaces of the Expanse report to them if anything out of the ordinary arises."

"Yes. The bastion of Protection of the Expanse and the Megalos. And yet even this Wheelomachy...has now been compromised by these Faceless Lifeforms that appeared right after the Change began. They are spread out across the Megalos. They enact Dark Towers that seem to be eating up weavings of existence themselves as at this moment...there is nobody we can rely on for Protection apart from ourselves. No Watchers. No Wheelomachy. This issue will not solve itself. We either stand united...or perish one by one as these Faceless Lifeforms continue to run rampant."
His words and the scenes displayed caused her expression to rapidly change as she looked back and forth between him and the scenes he displayed.
Her eyes carried an internal struggle as Noah looked at her while asking.
"What is causing your hesitation? Do you not wish to protect whoever you deem worthy enough to isolate within that Omniverse?"
WAA!
Heavy arcs of complexity erupted the moment he said this as Yoo Jin looked at him coldly.
"It is precisely those behind me that I do not make any random moves. Their safety..."
"Their safety is jeopardized the longer they stay here. With me, I can at least guarantee the lives of those you protect."
Noah waved his hands and spoke with heavy affirmation!
Yoo Jin looked at him with cautious eyes as she probed.
"And just how exactly could you guarantee something like that?"
A line had been thrown.
A fish waited to be caught.
Away from the Megalos Ynnere.
In the Expanse.
The Palaces of the Expanse were stretched out across the regions of the Expanse, each one more ancient than the others as there was rarely contact between them.
But when there was a need for contact, it was astonishing how quickly and efficiently it could be established.
At this moment.
Above golden strings that had yet to snap, there was a region where a faint golden Blancverse floated with a sense of awe and majesty.

White gold clouds gathered beneath it as this type of Blancverse was extremely elevated and pristine, with there being only one of its kind in the whole Expanse as it was under the banner of many Palaces of the Expanse!
And within such a radiantly gold Blancverse...
"Order! Order!"
A booming voice of a Source Complexity entity echoed out as the clamor and voices towards the very center slowly quieted down.
At the very center of this place, Runes that radiated illusory images of Palaces floated grandly as each one represented a Palace of the Expanse!
There were dozens of such runes here as Palaces belonging to Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter were all here as they rotated with power and brilliance.

The one who had called order was standing on a floating stellar white gold podium that held vibrant gold clouds underneath it- this podium floating at the center point of this place as many gazes turned towards it.
It was a Golden Titan burning with source Complexity and a single gold eye pulsing with power.
He stood on the podium as he spoke.
"I have been given the role of the Speaker of Existence today as I will bring to attention all the points of discussion brought forth, and there are a few."
A Speaker of Existence.
Someone who took the reigns whenever the Palaces of the Expanse met as they directed the flow of events and talks!
Many entities with terrifying complexities looked towards the Speaker as he nodded and continued.
"On the table today, we have a few issues, but I will go through them in the order of importance as they were brought to me. And the first one is this..."
Around the Speaker, space distorted as the visage of Ozymandias was shown clear to all.
The eyes of many Palaces turned cold at the appearance of such a figure as the Speaker smiled while continuing!

chapters.title: Chapter 3512 Sources! II
paragraphs: "We have the Resurgence of the Megalonian here- someone that has caused the deaths of many Pioneers of our Palaces!"
The Speaker expressed his emotions valiantly as many eyes honed in on the visage of Ozymandias.
There were many Pioneers present here in this Meeting of the Palaces, and some Palaces even had Source Complexity entities with them as many of their gazes shone brilliantly at this moment.
The Speaker allowed the silence and moments of thinking before he continued.

"Eons ago, we gathered just like this before passing the resolution to obtain the weavings of the Megalonians in their Megalos Mountains. We all know the boons that came with that as today, we come across this Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian as his weavings...are something nobody was able to obtain all those years ago!"
WAA!

"But he is tricky. We all saw how paired against dozens of Pioneers, he brought down their level of power and slowly took them out one by one. His complexity doesn't seem entirely obscene, and he still managed to do this. The only course of action at this moment is to ensure that only truly powerful Pioneers and those who have attained their Source go after him. So that he isn't given any more fuel. And we should not just sit still as he continues to elevate himself as the proposition made by many Palaces and what is being voted on today...is the incursion into the Megalos Beyond to find and contain this Megalonian."
An incursion into the Megalos Beyond!
This was something not done by these complex beings by any measure in the past as at most, they moved within the Expanse to conduct their actions.

"We will coordinate and send at least a Source Complexity from every Palace. The Palaces that do not have a Source Complexity among them, their Pioneers will be distributed among other groups. For more logistics, The Source of Dreams here is the one to go to."
The Speaker pointed to his right as within a palace filled with the dignified auras of draconian, a half humanoid half draconic woman with glasses and vibrant golden hair stared out coldly.
The Source of Dreams.
Her information gathering and planning were unmatched as after this was cleared, the Speaker made his last point.

"I do not need to spell it out for everyone, but the goal is to obtain this Megalonian and for all of us to have continued access to him as we extend his Lineage. We will go about things differently this time. More orderly. More...humane."
WAA!
The smile on his face was chilling as after saying such words, he pivoted rather quickly as he waved his hands and caused the images of Ozymandias to disappear.
"The other important point is, of course, the Change that is taking place across the Expanse and Megalos."
This one didn't need a display of any images as they were all experiencing it!

"Atmospheric Weavings of Existence have reduced drastically as to impose our own weavings, much greater authority is required. We do not know much about this change, but the goal is to of course, reverse it. For this, we rely on those above us- the Wheelomachy. We-"
"Hold on."
A piercing voice came out from one particular Palace as the expression on the Speaker soured.

He stared into the distance at a sparkling white castle that had many women adorned in in white robes, with the one at the forefront being a Source Complexity entity surrounded by three others of the same level of power as this Palace of Existence was extremely terrifying!
An ancient one.
A deep one!
The Speaker changed his expression as he looked towards them, his voice booming out.

"One of the only rules we have here is that the role of the Speaker is respected. Pass along your words and wishes to me, and they will be relayed to everyone. We know the Palace of the Sages is distinguished and powerful, but even you have to follow the rules. So-"
"Our words will be short."
HUUM!
Booming authority began to emanate out.
The gazes of many changed.

They felt the tides shifting as the woman adorned in a white robe at the very forefront waved her hands to display the scenes of Faceless Lifeforms across the Megalos Ynnere, Megalos Beyond, and Megalos Nihilos enacting terrifying Dark Towers!

"Along with the advent of this Change, these monstrosities appeared as they have already began wrecking chaos across the Megalos. In our eyes, they are very clear sources of chaos, and yet our contacts have confirmed that these Faceless Lifeforms have also appeared in the highest ranks of the Wheelomachy. They have been called to be supporters of the Wheel as we do not believe so. We fear for our own weavings as this means we are speaking against the Watchers of the Wheelomachy, but I urge you all to use common sense and ignore the greed of complexity before it is too late. We will be going dark from here on out to preserve ourselves, and we urge the rest of you to choose your allies and enemies wisely. As always, the Wheel Turns as the Wheel Turns, and this will never change-...!"
BOOM!
From above, terrifying complexity exploded.
Above the white Palace of the Sages, multiple Faceless Lifeforms appeared as storms of obsidian light thundered down apocalyptically!
Amidst the appearance of the Faceless Entities, the visage of the Watcher, Persephael, appeared grandly with her bejeweled appearance as she boomed out with a heavy intent.
|Traitors of the Wheel seeking to confuse and tear our people apart. You will not have your way here!|
A terrifying development.
Down below, the women in white robes did not look distraught or shocked- as if they had expected this all along!
They looked up as the raging dark storm of complexity descended, and their bodies simply began to flicker away as if they were never there.
"Do not let the greed of Complexity cloud your judgments. Fight. Fight for the Wheel."
HUUM!
With such words left behind, the white Palace of the Sages entirely disappeared as if it was never here at all!
|Hmph, trace and search for them!|
Persephael bellowed out as soon after, she and the Faceless Entities also disappeared.
They left behind many contemplative Palaces of the Expanse as ever so slowly, chaos continued to bud and grow.
Away from the Expanse.
Within the Megalos Ynnere.
BOOM!
Space fractures as from it, thousands of figures wrapped up in white robes appeared!
At the forefront, multiple Source Complexity entities breathed heavily as an aged hooded woman looked towards the leading one with a tired gaze.
"You are sure it is here?"
The aged woman asked.

And a white-robed Source Complexity entity took off her hood to reveal a gorgeous entity with strands of sparkling white hair, her pupils also stellar white as she looked around the gray cracks of this region in the Megalos Ynnere!
She nodded with confidence as she hid the fear within her heart.
After all, they had just gone against the Watchers of the Wheelomachy.
If she was wrong, she would have just affirmed the genocide of all her people!
But...
"Yes. It is here. We have to find the Burnt One!"
