He stared into the distance at a sparkling white castle that had many women adorned in in white robes, with the one at the forefront being a Source Complexity entity surrounded by three others of the same level of power as this Palace of Existence was extremely terrifying!
An ancient one.
A deep one!
The Speaker changed his expression as he looked towards them, his voice booming out.
"One of the only rules we have here is that the role of the Speaker is respected.
Pass along your words and wishes to me, and they will be relayed to everyone.
We know the Palace of the Sages is distinguished and powerful, but even you have to follow the rules.
So-"
"Our words will be short."
HUUM!
Booming authority began to emanate out.
The gazes of many changed.

They felt the tides shifting as the woman adorned in a white robe at the very forefront waved her hands to display the scenes of Faceless Lifeforms across the Megalos Ynnere, Megalos Beyond, and Megalos Nihilos enacting terrifying Dark Towers!
"Along with the advent of this Change, these monstrosities appeared as they have already began wrecking chaos across the Megalos.
In our eyes, they are very clear sources of chaos, and yet our contacts have confirmed that these Faceless Lifeforms have also appeared in the highest ranks of the Wheelomachy.
They have been called to be supporters of the Wheel as we do not believe so.
We fear for our own weavings as this means we are speaking against the Watchers of the Wheelomachy, but I urge you all to use common sense and ignore the greed of complexity before it is too late.
We will be going dark from here on out to preserve ourselves, and we urge the rest of you to choose your allies and enemies wisely.
As always, the Wheel Turns as the Wheel Turns, and this will never change-...!"
BOOM!
From above, terrifying complexity exploded.
Above the white Palace of the Sages, multiple Faceless Lifeforms appeared as storms of obsidian light thundered down apocalyptically!
Amidst the appearance of the Faceless Entities, the visage of the Watcher, Persephael, appeared grandly with her bejeweled appearance as she boomed out with a heavy intent.
|Traitors of the Wheel seeking to confuse and tear our people apart.
You will not have your way here!|
A terrifying development.
Down below, the women in white robes did not look distraught or shocked- as if they had expected this all along!
They looked up as the raging dark storm of complexity descended, and their bodies simply began to flicker away as if they were never there.
"Do not let the greed of Complexity cloud your judgments.
Fight.
Fight for the Wheel."
HUUM!
With such words left behind, the white Palace of the Sages entirely disappeared as if it was never here at all!
|Hmph, trace and search for them!|
Persephael bellowed out as soon after, she and the Faceless Entities also disappeared.
They left behind many contemplative Palaces of the Expanse as ever so slowly, chaos continued to bud and grow.
Away from the Expanse.
Within the Megalos Ynnere.
BOOM!
Space fractures as from it, thousands of figures wrapped up in white robes appeared!
At the forefront, multiple Source Complexity entities breathed heavily as an aged hooded woman looked towards the leading one with a tired gaze.
"You are sure it is here?"
The aged woman asked.

And a white-robed Source Complexity entity took off her hood to reveal a gorgeous entity with strands of sparkling white hair, her pupils also stellar white as she looked around the gray cracks of this region in the Megalos Ynnere!
She nodded with confidence as she hid the fear within her heart.
After all, they had just gone against the Watchers of the Wheelomachy.
If she was wrong, she would have just affirmed the genocide of all her people!
But...
"Yes.
It is here.
We have to find the Burnt One!"

chapters.title: Chapter 3513 Sources! III
paragraphs: Thousands of women in white robes!
Those from the Palace of the Sages.
They had multiple Source Complexity entities among them, and dozens of Pioneers as they were an ancient force within the Expanse.
Respected.
Feared.
And yet at this moment, they were running.
They made their preparations as they knew who they would be going up against, but even then, how could they truly be prepared against utterly complex beings?
"How do we go about finding this Burnt One, O Maharishi?"
Another voice behind the vivacious woman echoed out as to this, she did not have a reply.
Around her, complex Runes began to unfold as she started to fly forward, all others following behind.

"Everyone has a different relationship with the Wheel. The Palace of the Sages observed, learned, and predicted the flow of the Wheel. We know many things, but we also know very little. What I know now is that the answer lies within the Megalos Ynnere, with the Burnt One. That is the flow of the Wheel that we must follow, and the Wheel has never betrayed us."
The Wheel had never betrayed them.
The Maharishi said this with strong conviction as inwardly, her source hid her tumultuous emotions!
She wondered if she had erred.
She wondered if she had read the flow wrong!
Because if she did, it meant that cycles of progress and weavings of the Sages...would all come to an end right here.
'O Origin Maharishi...I told you I was not ready. Why did you leave us? Why did you allow me to lead?!'
Her Source burned with heavy complexity as she thought about her predecessor.
The one who had led the golden era for the Sages as she moved even behind the backs of the Logos of the Wheel and the Watchers of the Wheelomachy.
She was now gone.
Where did she go?
Where did she and so many others go?!
The Maharishi had no answers at this as she could only move forward.
For now, they had to find the Burnt One.
With the Burnt One, the flow told her they would at least be able to escape the gaze of the Wheelomachy!
"Faster!"
She urged those behind her as she closed her eyes and tried to read the direction, and she then followed.
Within these same Megalos Ynnere.
Near a distant Omniverse, Yoo Jin, a Source Complexity entity, had a difficult expression after continuing her back and forth with the being before her.
She didn't have the means to protect the Omniverse behind her.
The Faceless Entities...would likely come for it like they were already coming for many others!
But...could this being before her truly do something even she couldn't do.
And why was he giving her so much time to think?
Opposite Yoo Jin, Noah was not in a hurry as he looked at prompts that cascaded over his eyes.
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, has been activated.|
|The target in close proximity has been deemed to be the Red Tier Source Complexity Weavings of the Isolated, Yoo Jin. |
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, has successfully attained a Crystallized Severed Path Pearl deemed compatible with your weavings.|
|The Crystallized Severed Path of Apomonosi has been obtained.|
While he talked with her, he also obtained something from her that she didn't even know about.
Her path.
The weavings of her Source!
Apomonosi.
An ancient word that meant isolation and seclusion.
Such a path was something unique even for Noah as he felt it begin to be added to his weavings.
It fit the woman before him as she had isolated herself without too many Entanglements until she gained her Source.
As he waited for more boons to come from being near in proximity to this powerfully complex being...

"Let me observe this place where the Faceless Entities will not be able to find. If it is truly free of the effects of the Change that is affecting everything, I see no issue in residing there until this change is resolved."
Until the change was resolved.
Noah smiled at this as he shook his head.
"Who do you think will resolve this change? But yes, I will take you there."
His Infiniverse Megalos.
He was truly Severed from existence as the Infiniverse Megalos....fell under the same banner.
It was truly and completely severed from the weavings of existence as it was akin to an isolated domain that even the effects of the Change did not appear within it!
The Entanglements within remained within.

Even Source Complexity entities would not be able to find it unless Noah wished them to, and any enemy Source Complexity entities would not be able to remain within the bounds of the Infiniverse Megalos if Noah did not deem it!
He had layers of protection as he nodded towards Yoo Jin.
"I will take you there. A clone of yours should be more than sufficient-...oh?"
His words came to a stop.
This was because on the Map of the Megalos Ynnere that he was always watching for changes....he caught a grand change at this moment.
Thousands of friendly white names...surrounded by a variety of colors!
Most of them were green as they were lower in complexity than him.

But there were at least 3 with orange hues of similar complexity to him or slightly lower, and 4 dazzling circles of red complexity that showed those with higher weavings than him...those with Source Complexity!
They were not within the Megalos Ynnere before.
They had just recently appeared, and they were moving at high speeds!
Their direction...constantly changed as he wondered if they even held a destination.
His eyes became sharp.
"Actually... let us pass by a place first. There are others I plan to meet; we can see them together. You're okay with this?"
Others.
He didn't explain who it would be as Yoo Jin split her body in two, her complexity not lessening at all as the other body calmly neared his position while speaking out.
"Lead the way."
WAA!
Noah smiled as space tore open in front of him, his eyes on the position of the newly appearing cluster of friendly designated beings as he rapidly went towards them!

chapters.title: Chapter 3514 Sources! IV
paragraphs: At the same moment that Noah and a Clone of the Source Complexity, Yoo Jin, began to head toward a direction only he knew.

Within the Infiniverse Megalos, Ruination had her eyes closed as she cooled down after enacting the second Severed Singed Affix of Existence, but they opened heavily in the next moment and looked towards a certain direction.
"Master, I can feel a resonance...towards the same direction where the weavings of the Burnt Weaver show the few thousands clustered complexities that you are currently heading towards."
Ruination felt a resonance.
Noah's eyes became brighter at such words as there was only one thing she would be resonating with!
"Come."
He spoke towards Ruination as she instantly followed, her figure turning into a streak of light that shot into Noah's chest and disappeared!
An equivalent distance of tens of thousands of Omniverses away, across the threads of weavings Noah was traversing through with Yoo Jin.
HUUM!
Noah's body here released waves of lustrous brilliance as Yoo Jin looked at him carefully while a crimson gold light erupted from his head and formed into the visage of none other than Ruination!
She joined the side of this body as she gave a light nod of recognition towards Yoo Jin who looked at this scene inexplicably as she could only nod.
"This is..."
"Someone who may be of help to us with those we are about to meet. This is Ruination."
Noah replied to the cautious and isolated Source Complexity entity as she could only nod while they proceeded ahead.
She didn't know, but the meeting with another unfathomable source would occur soon enough!
The Maharishi shuttled forth without looking back.
She could not look back.

She didn't have a clear destination, but she knew that she had to keep moving as the Watchers of the Wheelomachy were a terrifying breed of beings- and now they had these Faceless Lifeforms under their beck and call!
She knew there was not too much time before they went to their old abode in the Expanse and track their weavings into the Megalos Ynnere.
With every passing second, it was like a hammer of death was coming ever closer!
But as the Maharishi, she had to keep her cool demeanor as if everything was under control.
But it was not.
How the hell was she supposed to find the Burnt One? How would she know who he was? Even if he did exist here, she may also not be able to locate him in time as everything could still be for naught.
The flow of these weavings made her utterly maddened as-...!
HUUM!
Her color drained as she sensed a Source Complexity erupt ahead, preparing for the worst at this moment as she raised her hand to have everyone stop!
An instant later...
WAP!
Ahead of them, three figures appeared.
A man with the demeanor of an ancient emperor, his eyes calm and filled with endless solemnity.
His aura could not be clearly discerned.
A woman adorned in a hanbok robe, her eyes full of caution as they stared at the cluster of Sages in shock.
Another woman with crimson gold radiance surrounded her, her hair dancing as it was set aflame- her gaze also calm and deep!
The Maharishi calmed her beating heart as she wanted to ask who the hell they were when, in the next moment...
BZZT!

Her own weavings erupted unstably as within an isolated domain of space layered deep within her Source, a stupendous treasure passed down from her predecessor shockingly vibrated before it shot out of her Source!
Her body erupted with stern white brilliance as a wooden object surrounded by white flames flew out of her chest- her hand shooting towards it as...
SUU!
It passed through her fingers seamlessly as if she could no longer hold on to it.
What the fuck?!

She stared with incredulity as the treasure that had been with her for eons shot out towards the newcomers- eventually smashing onto and disappearing into the body of the crimson gold woman as a moment later, her body burst into white gold flames!
Beside her, the man with the demeanor of an ancient emperor also vibrated with radiance as around his body, white gold flames pulsed and came to light in response.
This...
The Flames.
The treasure passed down to her shooting in that direction!

The heart of the Maharishi pulsed as she looked towards the crimson gold woman who was now covered by raging flames, but she had closed her eyes as if nothing was of consequence to her. The Maharishi was forced to turn her eyes to the man who had similar white gold flames seething around his body as she asked.
"Are you...him?"
A unique question.

Because she couldn't just barrage an unknown entity she just met on whether he was the Burnt One she may have been looking for- the one who should be able to shield them from the weavings of the Wheelomachy that may rain down at any second!
But the Piece of the Core Trace of the Wheel that had just forcefully left her.
The flames surrounding them.
Her purpose here.
Even if he was not the Burnt One, she knew her time was running out as she had to place her hopes here. So before he replied, she sent a mental message only to him.

|I know not who you are, but you may be the one I am looking for. The matter is of extreme urgency and time sensitive, so I will ask something that may not make much sense. Are you able to give us refuge? In a place that even Source Complexity entities of terrifying power cannot find?|
It was a ridiculous long shot.
A glimmer of hope!
How could the exact person she needed actually appear before her like this?
But at this moment. All she had was hope. All she had was the flow. And the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel leaving her to fuse into the body of another was the biggest pillar of her hope.
It had to be him.
Please, let it be him!
The man whose body was set aflame smiled as he raised his hand and smashed the space to his right- weavings of existence shattering as a stellar blue rift formed.
The rift...led into a place nobody knew, but they could sense extremely pure weavings in it.
It was a gateway leading to the Infiniverse Megalos as Noah's voice echoed out grandly.
"Enter. Within lies a refuge."
WAA!
He nodded towards Yoo Jin as she only looked at him briefly before she disappeared into it, while Ruination also turned into a streak of light!
Opposite him, the Maharishi had a Sage look over with worry as she asked.
|Is it him? He is the Burnt One?|
They wanted affirmation.
And the Maharishi grit her teeth while looking at the dazzling blue rift as she replied, whether it was true or not!
|He is him!|
Thereafter, she gave her command to the Sages as one by one, without hesitation, they turned into glimmers of light that disappeared into the Rift.
The only one left behind was Noah and the Maharishi as she seemed to want to talk with him, but he pointed to the rift first as he also wanted to ensure everything was smooth.
"Urgency, remember? We can talk after."
Complexity pulsed and erupted.
The flame of the Singed around Noah became ever more radiant.
And the Source Complexity entity before him nodded as she disappeared into the dazzling blue rift.

Noah looked around briefly as he kept his eye on the map, noticing an eruption of crimson red complexity on the Map of the Megalos Ynnere as his eyes flashed with a cold light while he also disappeared into the blue rift that closed right after!

chapters.title: Chapter 3515 Hide and Seek! I
paragraphs: At the same region where the Sages had first appeared within the Megalos Ynnere.
Space distorted once more as a bejeweled Persephael appeared, followed by throngs of Faceless Entities who erupted with tendrils of heavy complexity all around!
The weavings of existence nearby creaked and shuddered as Persephael looked around coldly.
Her feet were bare as their fair radiance graced the Megalos Ynnere, her expression that of revulsion as she looked around while the many jewels and crystals around her shone.
"They ran into these backward Megalos for a reason. Any group that pushes in seeds of doubt must be eradicated. Spread out and find them!"
WAA!
The white bands on the Faceless Entities shone as accompanied by creaking weavings of existence, they shot out in different directions across the Megalos Ynnere!
As for Persephael herself...
She stood still while closing her eyes, multiple illusory golden Wheels manifesting around her alongside thousands of threads.
Threads.
Entanglements!
From the swirling wheel around her, these lines of Entanglements exploded out towards different directions of the Megalos Ynnere as some lit up brightly while others dimmed and turned to ash.
But these lines of Entanglements were looking for something as her voice echoed out coldly.
"Where did you prudes go?"
Where did the Sages of one of the more ancient Palaces of the Expanse go to? And did they truly think the answer they sought would be here, in the Megalos Ynnere?!
Yoo Jin had seen her share of things across the Expanse and Megalos Ynnere. She had seen many abominations and a great deal of wonder.
What she saw now...
"What the hell is this?"

She couldn't help but utter out as she was akin to a spec of dust that observed a massive structure taking on the shape of an infinity symbol- its exterior pulsating with multicolored radiance as it alone was the size of two Omniverses.
Even more astonishing was the fact that around it, radiant white gold flames were serenely burning as they didn't show destruction but instead gave a sense of mighty power and awe all around!

Even more astonishing was the fact that around it, swirling layers of what looked to be planar Megalos of different colors rotated, each one radiating terrifying complexity as they also burned with white gold flames at this moment.
These were the Severed Vein of Existence and the Severed Megalos Pantheonic Havens!
Yoo Jin looked at all of this as she also noticed something else.
She looked around multiple times to confirm but...the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence felt vibrant.

There were no cracks of gray brilliance stretched out across its vast space that she judged to be equivalent to at least 3 or 4 Omniverses on totality, and she felt like it was still getting bigger in real-time.
This...was the place that she was promised the effects of the Change would not reach, nor would the Faceless Entities be able to find her.
But why was Osmont doing this? What did he gain from reaching out to her and moving her home here?
In all her years of complexity, she knew that nobody did anything that did not fit their purpose.
For her to be at ease, she just wanted to know his purpose as at that point, she could manage.

In her thoughts and awe, she blinked as she felt multiple other terrifying complexities similar to hers entering this same space- her gaze falling on the white-robed women who looked around with eyes just like hers.
They were followed by the woman with the heaviest complexity they had net before this, and the visage of Osmont himself!
The new entrants looked around everything as seeing the radiant flames all around them, one of the older white robed Source Complexity entities looked around while mumbling.
"This has to be an abode of the Singed. Those that First Sage spoke of..."
Yoo Jin's eyes flashed as she heard such words, and she could not help but be shocked as she turned towards the white robed women.
"Sage? You all are of the Palace of the Sages in the Expanse? Why are you in the Megalos Ynnere?"
She couldn't help but ask.

And the moment she did, everybody quited down while looking around cautiously, with the gorgeous white robed Sage to come in last looking at Yoo Jin and Osmont before she nodded towards the latter grimly as she spoke.

"There is not much time, but I have to let you know that on our trail are the Watchers of the Wheelomachy and Faceless Entities. They have likely grasped our weavings and followed us here as we do not want to bring calamity to you all unless we are sure. This is an impossible and improbable ask, but if you are who I believe you are...is the place you have brought us to somewhere that even the Wheelomachy cannot touch?"
There was no time to proceed with things slowly.
So she had to ask.

And towards her question, Noah's eyes flashed brilliantly as he looked ahead where an Infiniverse Megalos Body cradled Ruination who was undergoing another assimilation with a Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel.
"Nobody will find this place unless I want them to. And the Wheelomachy...is already here."
WAA!
Words that caused the Sages to turn ashen echoed out, and yet no cataclysmic changes occurred around them as space remained stable and free of attacks.
Noah had said what he said because just as he took in all these beings, the Map of Megalos Ynnere exploded with crimson radiance en masse as a cluster of Red Tier Source Complexity weavings appeared.
[Unknown Faceless Lifeform with Red Tier Source Complexity #13]
[Unknown Faceless Lifeform with Red Tier Source Complexity #19]
[Unknown Red Tier Transcendent Source Complexity #3]
Multiple Red Tier Source Complexity, and one was even Transcendent!
Similar to the weavings of a part of the Omnifather that was left behind for eons!
A Watcher and over a dozen Faceless Entities with heavy complexities surpassing Noah at the Source level.
It was a heavy group as at this moment, he had to put the True Severing of the Infiniverse Megalos to the test!

chapters.title: Chapter 3516 Hide and Seek! II
paragraphs: Around Noah, white gold flames continued to burn slowly. Instead of isolation, he had made the choice to be entangled with the flow of the Wheel. With the multiple Entanglements, he gained far too many things that would otherwise not be a possibility before!
The Entanglements in the Expanse led to Bob and the Wheelomachy. To Hell Terra Firma. To entering the Palaces of the Watchers of the Wheelomachy where he attained weavings of the Singed!
This was what his Entanglements led to. And so he decided to continue being involved in the flows of the Wheel.
In the turning of the Wheel!
He knew he was not some grand destined figure. He had even stoled the identity of the Instrument of the Beyonder in the Megalos Beyond.
He was no messianic figure.

He was a guy who loved Mana. He was a guy that loved to eat. And he was a guy who enjoyed the company of his women, to a fault even. Everything else fell together to make sure his interests remained protected.
To make sure he could always enjoy the sensation of endless droves of mana and authority!

He was just a guy, but he was also the Weaver. The Omniversal Guider. The Lumen Emperor. The True Emperor of Quintessence. The Home of the Weald. The 9th Infernal Lord. The Anomaly. The Cartographer of Existence! The Scholar of Runes!
He was Noah Osmont, and he would play whatever role was needed for his grand ideals.
He brought his hand to his chest as a burst of white gold flames erupted, the Infiniverse Megalos shaking.
Outside of it, the Frequency Gateway was brought in as at this moment, this vast expanse of the Infiniverse Megalos...could only be observed akin to a grain of sand within Omniverse X-999.
No aura leaked from it as it currently surrounded stellar particles of Cappadocia, its grandiose complexity not leaking out one bit.

Noah looked at the multiple Source Complexity entities he had just now gotten entangled with as Yoo Jin had an ashen expression when she heard the affirmation of the Watchers of the Wheelomachy cooperating with Faceless Lifeforms.
"My family. My Omniverse..." She looked towards Noah as he raised his hand and held his palm up.
"Your hand."

Yoo Jin buzzed with complexity as she flashed before him, lining up her fingertips with his outstretched hand as from Noah, white gold arcs of flaming electricity surged out and wrapped around Yoo Jin as well.
This was her other body.

There was another in an extremely far distance that was inside of an Omniverse, looking towards its swathes of Domains of Existence with worry when suddenly, this body of her erupted with white gold flames that began to spread out all over the weavings of the Omniverse around her.
It took but a few seconds.
HUUM!
She felt a spatial light wrap around this entire Omniverse as she sternly added her own complexity into it, the Source of Apomonosi spreading out madly as in another instant...
WAP!
An entire Omniverse was distorted and disappeared.

Back in the Infiniverse Megalos, on the left corner that held seas of particles of different colors of severed weavings, space tore and made way as a massive Omniverse that took up a quarter of the space was transported in.

It was a grandiose action that the Pioneers of the Palace of the Sages and their Source Complexity looked at sternly, with Yoo Jin stepping away from Noah as the white gold flames receded from her as if they were never there.
"Thank you."
Her expression showed relief as she looked at her hands, her very cells buzzing as they had lit up with activity like never before when that white gold flame covered her.
It caused her complexity to buzz with fervor as it was an extremely terrifying sensation for someone like her who was isolated this whole time!
Noah gave a light nod as all actions he did were for his own selfish reasons, and right now...multiple Source Complexity entities landed within his Domain.
The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, was buzzing madly.
He also got a chance to test that truly, even if his flames touched others, they would not suddenly gain the status of a Singed as this required a truly deep Entanglement.
To either be burned by the actual Flame of the Wheel, or to do what he did with his Dream.
Either way, he was now fully on board with the churning train of the flow of the Wheel, the Singed, and whatever other Entanglements would cause his complexity to continue exploding upwards!
At such a time.
"We have been searching for a long time."
The Sages adorned in white robes lined up as at the very forefront, past Pioneers of Existence, four Source Complexity entities backed a single woman as she looked towards Noah.

"I am the Maharishi. The Leader of the Sages that had studied the flow of the Wheel over the cycles and intervened when needed. This time, the flow of the Wheel is being made chaotic. Murky. Even those tasked to watch, observe, and ensure its flow may be compromised by the very same force causing this chaos. When such a time came, we were to seek someone who could aid us in wethering through this chaos and possibly return the flow of the Wheel to what it was. We have been searching for the Burnt One, and it now seems that our Search...has come to an end."
HUUM!
Brilliance unfolded.
The visage of the Maharishi was clear to all as with her hood down, the strands of stellar white hair falling down to her shoulders only caused her to shine with ever increasing valor and glory!
Behind her, the Sages put their fists on their chest as they called out.
"O Burnt One!"
"O Burnt One!"
Unique weavings of existence unfolded.
Noah looked at all of this calmly as he felt his Severed Weavings buzzing.
Was he gaining another distinction already?
Was he-...!
HUUM!
Existence vibrated and trembled.
The gazes of all those here turned ashen as they looked up, retracting their weavings into their bodies as much as possible!

Noah looked up calmly and waved his hands as the multicolored boundary of the Infiniverse disappeared, and one could see that above, on the outer periphery of Omniverse X-999...a massive Faceless Lifeform emanating terrifying waves of Complexity was sweeping his weavings across everything.

The white band of vertical brilliance on its head pulsed as it could induce heavy terror, the Sages and Yoo Jin looking at it with heavy expressions while Noah had his hands behind his back calmly as he looked up!
True Severing...would be put to the test completely today!

chapters.title: Chapter 3517 Hide and Seek! III
paragraphs: A massive, towering figure of a Faceless Lifeform!
One with Red Tier Source Complexity as he had attained a Source- and a terrifying one at that.
Noah looked calmly as around him, the other Source Complexity Entities recently coming into his Infiniverse Megalos were tense and ready to strike out at any moment!
And yet...
HUUM!
The white band of vertical brilliance on the head of this being only shone with luminosity before in the next moment, it disappeared.
It truly was not able to find anything!
The Maharishi felt her heart pumping loudly at such a phenomenon as she remembered the words of the Origin Maharishi.
When she found the Burnt One, she would also find the flow once more.

So she turned her head towards the man who was surrounded by white gold flames, and who was the only one among those here who was not tense when faced with the terrifying brilliance of a Faceless Lifeform.

"The Sages descended from the Origin Maharishi of eons past acknowledge that we have found the one that was promised. When such a time came, there is a chance that the budding chaos could be scattered. That the flow of the wheel could be returned to what it once was. To do so, the Sages were tasked to put themselves at the disposal of the Burnt One."
A Source Complexity entity spoke in such a manner as behind her, Four Source Complexity entities and a few dozen Pioneers did not even blink when they heard this!
This was their core belief.
How all their weavings were raised.
At the forefront, the dazzling white hair of the Maharishi stole the show as Noah looked deeply into her eyes.
Her conviction.
And he sighed internally as yet again, another group came and looked at him as if he were some promised destined leader.
He couldn't tell them that just a bit over two years ago, he was just a normal human in a world where the biggest worries were societal pressures!
And all of this fantastically fell into everything he wanted as was he not looking for Source Complexity entities this whole time?
His eyes were bright as he saw the many prompts cascading down as he met and conversed with Source Complexity entities.
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, has been activated on multiple targets simultaneously.|

|The targets in close proximity have been deemed to be the Red Tier Source Complexity Weavings of the Maharishi-Noelia, the Sage of Kataklusmos-Sheydam, the Sage of Teresis-Calista, the Seeker-Himiko, the Sage of Sophos- Hildegard|
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, has deemed their Sources compatible with your weavings and began the formation of the Crystallized Severed Path Pearl.|
Yes.
5 dazzling new Sources that provided grandiose paths separate from Versality that he attained from the Omnifather and Apomonosi from Yoo Jin.
Each one would add a layer of complexity as afterward, the more time spent around these Source Complexity entities would even grant weavings that allowed him to Sever more parts of his existence.
At this time, he had a small goal.
The Severed Weavings of the Singed that had reached an extremely high level.
He would momentarily steer away all Globules of Blood of Pioneers obtained from Hell Terra Firma, and save any Severing Resources for the Singed.
He would see just how bright he could make this flame be!
As he thought this, his voice began to echo out.

"The Flow of the Wheel...is not something that even I can say I grasp fully. I do not guarantee whatever weavings you have been told, nor do I guarantee that all this budding chaos will be solved under my hands. What I have are my own weavings...and the choices that I make with them. Choices..."
He paused as he looked at all the Source Complexity entities here.
Yoo Jin, the Isolated Source.
The Maharishi, the Sagely Source!
And others that followed her.
He looked at all of them closely as he continued.
"One's life...is the sum of all their choices."
"I will make my choices, and if you truly elect to follow me, you will have to follow the weavings of those choices without question."
Source Complexity entities.
They would have to listen and obey everything he said!
This was basically what his words stated as at the very forefront, the Maharishi was unfettered.
She only placed her hand on her chest as she spoke out.
"As the Origin Maharishi ordained, we shall be your swords."
WAA!
Her intent was abundantly clear as Noah nodded and smiled, his gaze turning above as he looked out towards the distant Megalos!
"Very well, then the first choice...how about we hunt a Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform? They are scattered across the Megalos Ynnere looking for us, we should pay a visit to at least one."
A heavy and bold choice to make.
The eyes of the Maharishi trembled slightly at this. The ones they were running from...they would not actively hunt?
She looked towards the Burnt One that she couldn't quite grasp the complexity of fully as all she did towards his brazen choice...
"Let us know what we need to do."
She simply went along with it as she left all her reservations with the Origin Maharishi!
Noah nodded at this as he turned to Yoo Jin.
"Your Source...is that of isolation. Apomonosi. How confident are you in being able to isolate a Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform?"
His words were light, yet they shocked Yoo Jin to her core!
How the hell did he even know her Source? Her Weavings?!
She looked towards him sternly as he just looked back calmly.
As if it was nothing major.
She shook her head with a sense of incredulity as she replied.
"Maybe a few seconds. The stronger they are, the quicker they will break out. I won't be able to hold them while also protecting myself fully. If all of those here participate..."
She left her words in the air as she stated that it was possible!

He paused as he looked at all the Source Complexity entities here.
Yoo Jin, the Isolated Source.
The Maharishi, the Sagely Source!
And others that followed her.
He looked at all of them closely as he continued.
"One's life...is the sum of all their choices."
"I will make my choices, and if you truly elect to follow me, you will have to follow the weavings of those choices without question."
Source Complexity entities.
They would have to listen and obey everything he said!
This was basically what his words stated as at the very forefront, the Maharishi was unfettered.
She only placed her hand on her chest as she spoke out.
"As the Origin Maharishi ordained, we shall be your swords."
WAA!
Her intent was abundantly clear as Noah nodded and smiled, his gaze turning above as he looked out towards the distant Megalos!
"Very well, then the first choice...how about we hunt a Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform?
They are scattered across the Megalos Ynnere looking for us, we should pay a visit to at least one."
A heavy and bold choice to make.
The eyes of the Maharishi trembled slightly at this.
The ones they were running from...they would not actively hunt?
She looked towards the Burnt One that she couldn't quite grasp the complexity of fully as all she did towards his brazen choice...
"Let us know what we need to do."
She simply went along with it as she left all her reservations with the Origin Maharishi!
Noah nodded at this as he turned to Yoo Jin.
"Your Source...is that of isolation.
Apomonosi.
How confident are you in being able to isolate a Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform?"
His words were light, yet they shocked Yoo Jin to her core!
How the hell did he even know her Source?
Her Weavings?!
She looked towards him sternly as he just looked back calmly.
As if it was nothing major.
She shook her head with a sense of incredulity as she replied.
"Maybe a few seconds.
The stronger they are, the quicker they will break out.
I won't be able to hold them while also protecting myself fully.
If all of those here participate..."
She left her words in the air as she stated that it was possible!

chapters.title: Chapter 3518 Hide and Seek! IV
paragraphs: It was possible, the Source Complexity of Apomonosi stated.
Noah nodded at this as he raised his hand, which radiated a fantastical stellar black light.
"I will also support the isolation."
A black light.
A light of a truly Severed Weaving of Apomonosi!
When any severed concept joined him, his truly severed weavings were applied to it.
This was Yoo Jin's Apomonosi, yes. But Noah had already made it his own.
The moment it pulsed out, Yoo Jin blinked and shook her head as it didn't fully register.
It was only after a second passed that her pupils constricted, and she looked sternly toward Noah!
She wanted to ask how. She wanted to ask when! Why would he have weavings of her source, and why did it seem to be uniquely different even though it was the same?
But when she looked at his calm gaze and the fact that he showed this freely, she knew that he wouldn't give her any answer that she would be content with.
So she didn't ask.
She reevaluated what she knew and thought of him even further as she nodded.
"I'm on board. How will we find one isolated and alone?"
The Source Complexity entities looked for specific details as they prepared.
And when it came to specifics...Noah only smiled while looking at the Map of the Megalos Ynnere and the blinking red lights moving rapidly across it!
"Leave everything else to me, I'll let you all know. For now..."
He looked towards the Omniverse of Yoo Jin that was brought into the Infiniverse, parts of it seen breaking away and fusing into the Severed Megalos Pantheonic Havens as he continued.
"Familiarize yourselves with all the changes and be ready. You can breathe and relax in here without worry. As for the Sages...I believe we need to talk about a few more things."
He was curious about the weavings of this so called promised one. The Burnt One. Also, he needed to keep them in proximity to attain weavings of their Sources.
The Maharishi nodded as the four other Source Complexity Entities appeared alongside her, and they observed a golden portal blooming beside Noah as he welcomed them into it.

They disappeared into it in a flash as Yoo Jin and the less complex Sages were left behind, Noah smiling towards them as he flew towards the dazzling Severed Megalos Pantheonic Havens in the distance.
"Allow me to show the rest of you to your new homes."
Weavings slowly unfolded as terrifying plans were hatched underneath.
In the midst of all of this.
In the depths of the Infiniverse Megalos.
Where a Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel calmly burned.
Inside the place with a throne filled with countless multicolored lines extending from it.
The visage of the Infiniverse Megalos Body cradled Ruination as she analyzed her newest transformation.
Noah appeared near her as he saw similar advancements compared to before, and yet somehow even more potent this time around.
He observed her calmly as he thought about the plan to ambush a Red Tier Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform.
"Are any modified Tzar Versepiercers touched by the Flame of the Wheel ready?"
He asked a heavy question about one of his more terrifying weapons.
"A single one so far has been Singed without any catastrophic results. But it has yet to be tested for efficacy and range of effect, or what level of complexity it might be able to affect."
An equally terrifying answer came out.

Noah sat down next to her as radiant bursts of complexity raged around them, his eyes flashing thoughtfully as at that moment, the body of Ruination burning with white gold flames opened her eyes in the middle of her elevation as she called out slowly.
"Let me put my hands on that Versepiercer and multiply it for you, Master."
Even during her transformation, Ruination still sought to be of use!
Noah looked at her with a gentle gaze and nodded as gradually, a plan to face a Source Complexity entity took shape.
He couldn't face one alone, yes, but he was no longer just a force of one.
There was the Infiniverse Megalos. There was Ruination. And now, there were multiple Source Complexity entities under his banner!
The cards were set.
It was time to truly play a game of hide and seek.
Tam of the Singed gazed at the decimation of another group of Faceless Lifeforms as his eyes didn't show any joy as their foul obsidian weavings burned.
His eyes only became graver as with every Faceless Entities he killed; he only observed their distasteful weavings more and more as they were entirely contrarian to all he knew!
This wasn't even something close to the distinction between Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter.
This was something past all of that as it only carried a sense of revulsion to the very basal flow of the Wheel!
It could not be allowed to exist.
All of it had to be purged from Existence under the radiance of a glorious flame!
Tam's eyes blazed with brilliant light as he thought this while becoming even more energized as he received the command from the Origin Singed.
That soon, a Faceless Lifeform far exceeding even his complexity would appear.
Once this Faceless Entity appeared, his job was to draw him in. Express his weavings. And at a critical point, the Origin Singed would unleash wonders to take care of such a terrifying entity.
Tam of the Singed closed his eyes and spread his arms out wide as golden flames leaked out, everything around him burning as he was ready.
"It is a good day for all things to burn. For all things to be cleansed by the glorious fire of the Wheel. Let it come. Let it come!"
HUUUM!
His bellow boomed out.
"Hmm?!"
And a passing weaving of Existence caught this bellow as instantly, far above, space tore while the visage of a massive Faceless Lifeform appeared!
Tam of the Singed opened his eyes to observe such a scene as he didn't frighten...and instead unleashed a holy devilish smile!

chapters.title: Chapter 3519 A Hunt! I
paragraphs: A Faceless Lifeform stared down towards a region burning with embers of gold flames.

From the embers, the smell of its brethren was clear as it saw the melted obsidian skins, as well as what had undoubtedly spilled out from it, only to be burned by the very weavings of existence here.
The vertical bar of brilliance around its head flashed with the maddening glare of anger as it looked towards the sole being responsible for this action.
And the madness on the vertical white bar only became more intense as the faceless life form echoed out.
|A Singed!|
A Singed.
One that was touched by the Flame of the thing they were going against at this very moment!
And even though it was here, this Singed was looking up towards him with unrelenting burning of flames, not an ounce of fear within it as it even laughed.
|You burn my brethren and then laugh about it? You are the very thing that is wrong with existence itself- Come and face your retribution, O One Toched by the Flame!|

The source of the Faceless lifeform burned brilliantly as it was about to erupt...only for it to confirm that the Singed that it was looking at had been but embers of a flame as behind it, a spatial channel leading to an unknown location had formed.
The singed was running.
The bar on its head flashed brilliantly as this Faceless Lifeform shot out into this channel without fear.

|I am temporarily deviating from the task of searching for the Sages as I came across a Singed of the Wheel who has just decimated a small squadron of our weaker brethren that were assigned to these Megalos.|
He sent a message out to a certain bejeweled woman as his figure delved deeply into the channel that the Singed was running through.
Far from this location.
Within the Infiniverse Megalos.
Noah's figure took a Quintessential Breath as he felt the surging particles of Severed Weavings of Existence across his body, and his voice boomed out with magnificence toward those around him
|It is time."
Near him, Yoo Jin rose up with determination and a trace of hesitation that was hidden deep within, but she was still ready to make a move.

The Sages with the power of Pioneers and those at the Existence Severing stage looked ahead with burning gazes as they wished they could be a part of such a grand venture, but their complexity was too far from it.
Moments later, the Source Complexity Sages that Noah had left with returned with their main bodies as everyone was gathered.
Near them, the Severed Vein of Existence radiated a terrifying light as Noah looked at Source Complexities gathered around him.
He waved his hands- causing a purple-blue spatial brilliance to cover those selected as they disappeared in the next moment.
After crossing untold weavings of severed space, they arrived at a domain equivalent to a distance of a few hundred Omniverses from the Infiniverse Megalos.
The only ones here were Noah, Yoo Jin, the Maharishi, and the four Source Complexity Sages under her banner.
A total of Six Source Complexity entities that Noah now commanded.
As surreal as it was, this was the reality as these beings looked around them to see what looked to be a desolate battlefield.
The allure of gold sand ravaged their surroundings as it smelled of dreams.
Lost dreams that could never be accomplished and dreams that one would only think of and reminisce about how they came and went.
Apart from the golden sand swirling into small storms, shattered wheels could be seen as the space was filled with musings that Noah put behind.
"A very melancholic battlefield, you designed this yourself?"
Yoo Jin asked as the Maharishi stared towards her coldly due to the casual tone that she took with the Burnt One.
Noah only smiled lightly as he spoke out.

"I nearly became sentimental and designed a domain based on the first dungeon I ever entered. [Ape's Paradise], it was called back then. But I stopped my sentimentality and simply went for a domain representing lost Dreams of the Wheel. It is here that I plan to see whether a Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform could be defeated. Oh, and you may want to begin expressing the Weavings of Apomonosi around this place right away- our target is coming."
HUUM!
No sooner had Noah finished his words did a golden flaming singularity bloom above them as the weavings of Tam of the Singed appeared.
The Maharishi and the other Sages looked at the scene with shock and surprise, as they didn't expect another Singed to make an appearance so quickly.
But it seemed that such a thing should only be natural for the Burnt One.
Tam of the Singed looked around and saw the terrifying allure of Source Complexity entities gathered by the Origin Singed as he couldn't help but tremble at his sheer magnificence.
He never doubted him, but he didn't expect in the time span that he left him to somehow collect six Source Complexity Entities- or why they already there, but just not privy to him?
He shook his head in wonder as he spoke out.
"He is three seconds away, O Origin Singed!"
His voice carried a sense of urgency as truly, the power of the Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform was not to be underestimated.
Noah nodded at this affirmation as around him, the brilliant stellar light of his truly severed weavings of Apomonosi also erupted out.
Paired with the terrifying complexity of Yoo Jin, this entire area filled with dredges of dreamy sand and broken wheels became drenched with an obsidian light that covered and obscured everything.
It isolated weavings completely and entirely as in the next moment... everything began to shake as if a terrifying beast wanted to enter such a place.
|Singed! There is no possible place for you to run in the whole of these Megalos to hide from me!|
A booming intent echoed out as it promised the arrival of a terrifying force of nature!

chapters.title: Chapter 3520 A Hunt! II
paragraphs: What exactly was a source?
Until someone came face to face with such a complexity, they would not be able to fully understand what it represented.

It truly was an apex of power as for someone to forge a Source, they had to sever their own existence, and then forge a path that nobody else had taken, something unique for themselves- and after forging this path, they had to then proceed to form a Source.
Something only for them.
When such a Source was truly formed, what they could do with it was limitless!
Such a type of complexity appeared inside a domain filled with sandy gold light and shattered wheels that were currently painted with a dark stellar hue of isolation.
Of the Source of Apomonosi.
The moment he entered, he felt the cutoff and isolation of weavings as he could no longer send any messages outwards.
He also observed the emergence of 6 Source Complexity entities, the Singed he was chasing, and another Singed he had not yet met.
Of the foreign complexities, five were actually his targets as when he saw them, he calmed down even more.
He looked at all of them as he instantly understood what had occurred.
And yet this Faceless Lifeform... was shockingly unfazed even in the face of such a collection of beings waiting for him.
He was not fearful one bit.
And this was because...of his Source.
He looked around all of those here as his gaze came to ultimately land on one man.
The foreign Singed that he had yet to meet, and yet his gaze came to lock onto him because the orientation of everyone here put him at the very center.
A being whose complexity could not be properly set in stone, and yet he concluded that it was this being who actually commanded everyone here!
So he looked towards him as his intent weaved out.

|A domain isolated from the weavings of existence itself. Did you come up with this and truly think that it was a good idea for you to do so? You even have the Sages that I was searching for- the strongest among them, and you have actually collected all of them and put them in a single small domain as a present just for me.|
HUUM!
The Faceless Lifeform was unfettered as around him, a maddening Source began to form.
Even though he was one against many.
Even though there were multiple other Source Complexity entities around him.
He was still fearless as this expressed the singular power that Source Complexity entities held.
Depending on the level of complexity of their source, even if there were multiple other source complexity enemies around them...these entities may not be defeated.
Because for them, there was no longer a question of the usage of authority.
For those who had enacted their own Source, it was of no consequence how much authority they released as an output!
Below source complexity, one had to worry about the reserves of their weavings.
The mana they could utilize.
Just like any source of energy- as one spent, it was depleted.
But when one attained a Source, this very common and absolute ruling began to be violated.

The amount of depletion of authority for them to simply express their own Source Complexity...was so infinitesimally little that they could fight for unfathomably long periods of time and face multiple enemies if need be as they senselessly stretched out their complexity everywhere, without worrying too much regarding the depletion of their reserves of power.
This was a singular feature that made Source Complexity entities truly terrifying.
Noah understood this well as he looked at the Faceless Lifeform ahead.
His heart felt a sense of exhilaration as automatically, the Severed Weavings of the Protagonist began to play a booming symphony in the background.
DU! DU! DU!
Low in pacing. Heavy on the drums.
It caused his white gold flames to light up with an even grander brilliance as he looked towards the massive creature and spoke to it.
"If I were to simply ask you to tell me exactly what you all are doing with the advent of this Change, would you speak on it? Your purpose? Your aim in the grand scheme of things?"
An honest question.
And it was asked towards a Faceless Lifeform who could viably answer it as the level of power it held was that pristine.
And yet, this Faceless Lifeform looked towards Noah and the Sages around him as it replied coldly.

|Even if you were to know our purpose, it would not serve you anything, it would not help you in any way. Whether we achieve it or not is not something that is of consequence to someone like you. Among those who can speak to me in equal standing, you are not one of them. So I thank you for the gift of gathering my targets in one place, and I will let you know that today, your weavings of existence will collapse from the hands of none other than I, Maraxana!|
BOOOM!
Mayhem ensued.
Noah pulled back as the Source Complexities that he came with went forward.
The Maharishi's gaze was a cold one as she did not fear a single Source Complexity enemy.
The other Sages were the same as the only one with a tinge of cautiousness and a healthy level of fear was Yoo Jin.
Due to her personality and isolation, she knew that at the end of the day, it was always healthy to be overly cautious and even a tad bit fearful.
It has saved her many times before, and it would continue to save her now as the main part of her contribution remained to keep this domain isolated from any outside weavings!
Tam of the Singed came beside Noah as he watched everything.

Noah looked at the unfolding battlefield, the Quintessential League of Existence unfolding around him as he wondered exactly what his level of complexity would do against something as terrifying as the Faceless Lifeform ahead of them.
It was his first tough battle in quite some time as his weavings couldn't help but buzz with excitement!

The Faceless Lifeform was unfettered as around him, a maddening Source began to form.
Even though he was one against many.
Even though there were multiple other Source Complexity entities around him.
He was still fearless as this expressed the singular power that Source Complexity entities held.
Depending on the level of complexity of their source, even if there were multiple other source complexity enemies around them...these entities may not be defeated.
Because for them, there was no longer a question of the usage of authority.
For those who had enacted their own Source, it was of no consequence how much authority they released as an output!
Below source complexity, one had to worry about the reserves of their weavings.
The mana they could utilize.
Just like any source of energy- as one spent, it was depleted.
But when one attained a Source, this very common and absolute ruling began to be violated.

The amount of depletion of authority for them to simply express their own Source Complexity...was so infinitesimally little that they could fight for unfathomably long periods of time and face multiple enemies if need be as they senselessly stretched out their complexity everywhere, without worrying too much regarding the depletion of their reserves of power.
This was a singular feature that made Source Complexity entities truly terrifying.
Noah understood this well as he looked at the Faceless Lifeform ahead.
His heart felt a sense of exhilaration as automatically, the Severed Weavings of the Protagonist began to play a booming symphony in the background.
DU!
DU!
DU!
Low in pacing.
Heavy on the drums.
It caused his white gold flames to light up with an even grander brilliance as he looked towards the massive creature and spoke to it.
"If I were to simply ask you to tell me exactly what you all are doing with the advent of this Change, would you speak on it?
Your purpose?
Your aim in the grand scheme of things?"
An honest question.
And it was asked towards a Faceless Lifeform who could viably answer it as the level of power it held was that pristine.
And yet, this Faceless Lifeform looked towards Noah and the Sages around him as it replied coldly.
|Even if you were to know our purpose, it would not serve you anything, it would not help you in any way.
Whether we achieve it or not is not something that is of consequence to someone like you.
Among those who can speak to me in equal standing, you are not one of them.
So I thank you for the gift of gathering my targets in one place, and I will let you know that today, your weavings of existence will collapse from the hands of none other than I, Maraxana!|
BOOOM!
Mayhem ensued.
Noah pulled back as the Source Complexities that he came with went forward.
The Maharishi's gaze was a cold one as she did not fear a single Source Complexity enemy.
The other Sages were the same as the only one with a tinge of cautiousness and a healthy level of fear was Yoo Jin.
Due to her personality and isolation, she knew that at the end of the day, it was always healthy to be overly cautious and even a tad bit fearful.
It has saved her many times before, and it would continue to save her now as the main part of her contribution remained to keep this domain isolated from any outside weavings!
Tam of the Singed came beside Noah as he watched everything.

Noah looked at the unfolding battlefield, the Quintessential League of Existence unfolding around him as he wondered exactly what his level of complexity would do against something as terrifying as the Faceless Lifeform ahead of them.
It was his first tough battle in quite some time as his weavings couldn't help but buzz with excitement!

chapters.title: Chapter 3521 The Indefatigability of a Source! I
paragraphs: His weavings of existence buzzed with activity.
They did so without fear as he watched the complexities of multiple Sources bloom around him!
At the same time...
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, has been activated on another target.|
|The target in close proximity have been deemed to be the Red Tier Source Complexity Weavings of the Unknown Faceless Lifeform- Maraxana.|
A Severed Singed Affix of Existence in the depths of his weavings was buzzing again and again as it even turned its jaws towards a Faceless Lifeform!
But for the first time...
WUU!
A burst of crimson light flashed around the Severed Singed Affix of Existence.
|The Severed Singed Affix of Existence, Severed Extractor, has deemed the Source of the Unknown Faceless Lifeform, Maraxana, to be incompatible with your weavings of existence.|
Incompatible.
He saw such a prompt as the flames in the depths of his weavings rose up a whole other octave! His mind moved rather quickly.
Even though the battle here was just unfolding, in the span of a nanosecond, not to mention an instant- he could have a conversation equivalent to hours.
So his weaving of thoughts began conversing with two key figures in the Infiniverse Megalos as a horrific battle unfolded.

With a heavy, burning Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel burning in the distance, Noah observed the Infiniverse Megalos Body and Ruination as they surrounded two circular multicolored singularities with a smiley face drawn in and infinity symbols where the eyes should be.
It was the Tzar Versepiercer as, at this moment, there were multiple such weapons floating between the Infiniverse Megalos Body and Ruination as terrifying waves of complexity surged around them!
Noah looked at all of this as he exchanged words with that within this short span of an instant.
"What in the weavings of the Faceless Lifeform made them incompatible?"
His eyes swirled with magnificence as he wondered.
He felt like he was becoming a more ancient and advanced form of life as instinctively, he sought to understand the whys of what was happening around him more and more.
Why the flow of the wheel was going the way that it was. Why one entanglement in the Expense would lead to the propagation and eruption of power within him.
The Why.

He was curious of this as he asked, and the figure of Ruination that was cradling a Tzar Versepiercer in her hands and multiplying it to form more had a bright expression on her face with her eyes radiating burning flames as she replied.

"The weavings of the Sages or Yoo Jin were different from yours, but they were still along the same breed. They held the same synapses and weavings of records, extremes, and paths that all flowed together. Even though they were different, they were still compatible enough with your weavings of existence to be added on top. Apomonosi, Versality... all of these worked. But in the case of the Faceless Lifeform..."

Ruination shook her head with a fearsome light emanating from her flames. "The connections and weavings of that Faceless Lifeform are distorted. The synapses are in no way the same as the very makeup...it seems to be from a different fabric- a different weaving."

Noah listened intently as at the end, he simply had to sigh as he picked up what Ruination was implying. Such were the beings that had currently risen the moment that the change bloomed as they caused an unknown level of chaos across the Megalos and the Expanse of this Frequency, and who knew how many more Frequencies.
Those powerful who should be there to stop beings such as this from the Wheelomachy were already compromised.
So who would be able to stand in their way?
Who could possibly figure out their origins and their purpose, and stand to oppose them before they utterly made a mess of everything? "Haa..."
Noah sighed as he looked at Tzar Versepiercers and thought about all of this.
He was but a simple farmer. Why did he have to work so hard to make sure that Existence itself did not collapse when there were so many others out there? "But... I like it."
He enjoyed the sensation.

He enjoyed the feeling of power that came with it. After all, was he not the one who held the Severed Weavings of the Protagonist? If it all was truly in line with his weavings of the Protagonist, then he should be the center of attention! The one many conflicts revolved around!

He could not say with certainty how this most recent conflict would resolve with how extensive and wide spanning it was, but he would simply take things as they came. And at this moment, the thing in front of him was a source complexity Faceless Lifeform.
To kill it...
"The Tzar Versepiercers are ready?"
His eyes burned with a terrifying sense of ambition as he looked at the multicolored singularities with smiley faces on them.
He wanted to see a source complexity entity fall as in addition to those he commanded, these weapons were also a key part of it all to ensure success in this endeavor.
Add his words, the Infiniverse Megalos Body nodded, as a devilish glint crossed her multicolored pupils.
"We won't be sure of their efficacy until they're tested, but I have gone ahead and added another feature to increase their handling safety as well as the study of its effects for us."

"Borrowing a thread of power from the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel, I've gone ahead and categorized multiple sources of weavings of Existence and friendly or hostile. Your weavings and the weavings of any of those you are entangled with in a friendly manner would not be affected by the eruption of weavings within the Versepiercers. Even if you were at the hypocenter- at the ground zero of the explosion, your weavings and the weavings of those deemed friendly would not at all be affected."
A terrifying feature that would utterly change the landscape of battles unfolded under the hands of the Infiniverse Megalos Body!

chapters.title: Chapter 3522 The Indefatigability of a Source! II
paragraphs: The Infiniverse Megalos Body stated that one could be at the very epicenter of the explosion of a Tzar Versepiercer, and they would not be affected so long as their weavings were deemed friendly!
Noah's body exploded with a burst of white gold flames when he heard this as he beckoned his hands towards the Tzar Versepiercer.
Even if one exploded at this very moment within the center of the Infiniverse Megalos, nothing here would be affected.
Towards such a feature, he only had a single word. "Good!"
After that, the Tzar Versepiercers began to disappear one after another as they were transported towards a brand new location.
This entire conversation and interaction that just occurred all fell under the span of an instant as by the time Noah transferred the Tzar Versepiercers, only an instant passed.
Within an isolated Domain that nobody could locate or peer into within the Megalos Ynnere.

|None of you could ever hope to even come close to understanding my Source. And yet you thought you could actually stand against me with numbers?! You do not know us. You do not know the purpose we bear on our shoulders!|
The Faceless Lifeform was particularly talkative as around his body obsidian pillars filled with overbearing black lightning formed and rotated around him en masse.

Behind him, a massive illusory black tower formed as it held nine horizontal white bands around it. From the white bands on that illusory tower, millions of white tentacles instantly erupted out as in addition to the hundreds of obsidian pillars crackling with lightning, all of these white tentacles also surged out to oppose the Sages and Yoo Jin!
There was no question or management of reserves of authority. There was no need.
The Faceless Lifeform targeted every single person here, including the figure of the distant Noah and Tam of the Singed!
The Maharishi stood before Noah as her body was covered by holy white flames, her mouth opening to release bundles of thousands of flaming white lotuses that rotated with terrifying complexity.

They seemingly studied the trajectory and power of the coming obsidian pillars of lightning and white tentacles and then appeared before them to nullify everything they had while exploding into a burst of brilliance!
BOOM!

Heavy impacts shook the surrounding space as a side from the Maharishi, other Sages exerted their own Complexity towards the Faceless Lifeform as to face it... he only released more and more crackling dark pillars filled with lightning as the illusory tower behind him trembled with fervor while even more tentacles erupted out.
Sheer volume.
Sheer quality.
He released as much power as he needed to in order to match all the enemies that were here!
This was the difficulty of facing a source complexity. There had to be a large disparity in the complexity of different Sources fighting each other in order for one to overcome the other.
Or, there had to be another factor that was unaccounted for.

The Maharishi kept her gaze forward as her eyes flashed towards the figure of the Burnt One every now and then. She expected him to be the other factor as with the level of complexity of Sources they had on their side, they may likely be able to grind down this Faceless Lifeform eventually.

But the more time that passed, even with the weavings of isolation that Yoo Jin put out, the more chances there were of them being discovered as when such a time came...many more Faceless Lifeforms just like this, and even a Watcher of the Wheelomachy would thunder down here!
So.
What exactly could the Burnt One do to change this heavy battl-...?!

The Maharishi found herself blinking in confusion as she was not the only one. Beside Noah, the figure of Tam of the Singed was blazing with silent gold flames as he was taken back when he saw the Origin Singed pull out a multicolored ball of brilliance that had a smiley face on it.
A singularity.
With a smiley face.
Thereafter, the hands of the Origin Singed became a flame with brilliance as he grasped the singularity and pulled his hand backwards before he flung the object he held towards the Faceless Lifeform!

The battle occurring here was a high paced one as every single entity saw these actions. And they were baffled to see the seemingly harmless ball with a smiley face as in the next moment, it reached the periphery of the Faceless Lifeform as he harumphed while a white tentacle thundered down onto the singularity.
On to the Tzar Versepiercer!
In the next moment, a scene that the Sages and Yoo Jin would never forget in the years to come bloomed. A scene that gave some of them trauma and nightmares!

At the moment there was an impact between the white tentacle and the Tzar Versepiercer, the infinity symbols that were above the smiling expression flashed as the scribbled face on this singularity turned utterly devilish.
The Tzar Versepiercer then unraveled.
Unraveled.
This was an apt word for what it did as first, it sent out a blast of a searing heat of complexity that seemed to be a volatile mixture of Matter and Dark Matter, and after that...
BOOM!
A massive, archaic wooden wheel exploded out of the singularity.
It looked very real.
It looked unfathomably ancient.
The source complexities here shuddered at its sheer appearance as the Sages had disbelieving expressions.
"The...Wheel?"
The Maharishi and other Sages were ashen as they thought they were seeing something genuine.
They thought they were seeing the Wheel of Existence itself.
The white gold wooden texture.
That austere brilliance.
The heaviness of complexity they could feel from it!

None of them knew that it was something influenced by the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel itself. They only thought they were observing the genuine appearance of a Wheel as even the Faceless Lifeform moved back in alarm, and in the next moment...
BOOM!
This wooden wheel splintered and released an explosion that was akin to the Wheel of Existence itself breaking and shattering all weavings of existence around it!

chapters.title: Chapter 3523 The Indefatigability of a Source! III
paragraphs: It was unbelievable.
They looked at it and truly thought that they were witnessing the Wheel of Existence itself before it shattered in the next moment
That was how ancient it was.
That was how archaic and Singed the Tzar Versepiercer was made under the banner of the Infiniverse Megalos!
When it exploded, Yoo Jin and the Sages instinctively wrapped their sources around them.
Instinctively.
Because the breaking of the Wheel spread its effects all around them.
It threatened all of them!
It felt like time stopped under the brilliance of the breaking of the Wheel, and Yoo Jin was furious as she thought she was about to die from something a newly gained ally threw out.
Her father had been right. He had advised her not to be involved and to remain isolated as it had worked for eons when she told him about Osmont.
Now, because she didn't listen...
Under the brilliance of the unraveling complexity exploding out, she expected grievous injuries to her Source as...?
She blinked as she didn't feel any pain.
She opened her eyes and spread her senses out as she observed the most beautiful and devastating scene of destruction at the same time.
She saw white gold flames that felt older than her many times over.

She saw the breaking of existence as if she were there in primordial times when existence was first breaking and forming. She saw how all of this came together to form a ravaging explosive force that should be utterly shredding even the defenses of her Source, and yet...
'Nothing.'
It didn't affect her.
She looked around as she saw the Sages carrying similar expressions to her, but theirs were much more reverential!
As if they had witnessed something holy.
Behind them, Tam of the Singed had spread his arms out as if to welcome this explosion, and he basked in its white gold flames as he had a joyous expression on his face!
As if he has experienced something he only saw once in his life before.
This heavy unraveling and destruction of existence itself also did not affect him!
The only one it did affect...
|OOOH!|

It was the Faceless Lifeform who was currently surrounded by countless obsidian pillars stacked on top of each other to form dark towers- and there were so many that in the next moment, existence in that area began to distort and disappear!
As if nothing could be allowed in to change it.

But...the white gold flames of unraveling from the Tzar Versepiercer were too pervasive as they still entered through the gaps of existence, breaking down the dark towers and coming to land on the Faceless Lifeform as his body was soon aflame!
CRACK!

Horridly, in the next moment, the weavings of existence nearby collapsed, the white gold flames all surging to become concentrated into a single point of singularity near the Faceless Lifeform before this singularity underwent one final blast of incinerating explosion.
This time, the flames hung around and released a heavy light of radiation.
The sandy gold makeup of this domain was aflame, along with the shattered dredges of wheels stretched out all around.

The Sages and Yoo Jin were silent as they observed the body of the Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform simmering in these flames, its body holding streaks of burn marks all over as its right hand...was placed on its chest- covering a small scorched gash that nearly cut open the obsidian suit of this being!
It didn't have an expression.
It didn't have a face.
And yet at this moment, they could feel its palpable rage amidst the scorching waves of radiation that remained burning all around.
|You. Insignificant. Dredges. Of. COMPLEXITY!|
BOOOM!
Maddening black radiance erupted from this truly complex creature.
Noah looked at it from afar as the biggest thing he confirmed was the utility of the Tzar Versepiercers- the fact that they could actually affect a Source Complexity with their power!

The other thing confirmed was that truly, any Source Complexity entity was not someone easy to take down. Along with its enraged intent, the Faceless Lifeform brought its hands in front of its chest as if it were praying, a hymn beginning to resound from it that caused a sensation of unease to spread out!
"Continue!"
The Sages and Yoo Jin no longer sat still at the emergence of such a complexity as their Sources struck out.
And yet behind the Faceless Lifeform, an illusion of a black flame began to form and gradually become more real.
A black flame.

The moment such a thing arose, even Noah felt a sense of revulsion as if he smelled something that had gone bad, his expression turning serious as he waved his hands to reveal another three Tzar Versepiercers.
Tam of the Singed saw this scene as he trembled, falling onto his knees as he gazed towards the three Versepiercers with fanaticism.
"Let everything be bathed in scorching light of fire..."
He uttered out the words reverentially as by the time others observed the Tzar Versepiercers, it was when Noah was throwing them towards the Faceless Lifeform!
This time, the Sages and Yoo Jin did not falter with trepidation, using this chance to unleash their heaviest weavings as unique complexities lit up the nearby weavings of existence.
They were followed by the simultaneous emergence of three massive wooden Wheels of Existence.

Wooden wheels that then vibrated and shattered into multiple explosions, their focus entirely centered around a creature that was praying at this moment as he was drowned in scorching white gold flames!
Alongside this, the Sources of 6 other entities of the same stature came down to bombard this being as everything joined together to take down the grandeur of a single Source.
This alone was enough to show the indefatigability of a Source- the difficulty in ever getting past its defenses and actually wounding it!
But one man had the means to make it possible.
And he didn't even have to wait before he could hear woeful screeches amidst the raging flames!
