Instinctively.
Because the breaking of the Wheel spread its effects all around them.
It threatened all of them!
It felt like time stopped under the brilliance of the breaking of the Wheel, and Yoo Jin was furious as she thought she was about to die from something a newly gained ally threw out.
Her father had been right.
He had advised her not to be involved and to remain isolated as it had worked for eons when she told him about Osmont.
Now, because she didn't listen...
Under the brilliance of the unraveling complexity exploding out, she expected grievous injuries to her Source as...?
She blinked as she didn't feel any pain.
She opened her eyes and spread her senses out as she observed the most beautiful and devastating scene of destruction at the same time.
She saw white gold flames that felt older than her many times over.
She saw the breaking of existence as if she were there in primordial times when existence was first breaking and forming.
She saw how all of this came together to form a ravaging explosive force that should be utterly shredding even the defenses of her Source, and yet...
'Nothing.'
It didn't affect her.
She looked around as she saw the Sages carrying similar expressions to her, but theirs were much more reverential!
As if they had witnessed something holy.
Behind them, Tam of the Singed had spread his arms out as if to welcome this explosion, and he basked in its white gold flames as he had a joyous expression on his face!
As if he has experienced something he only saw once in his life before.
This heavy unraveling and destruction of existence itself also did not affect him!
The only one it did affect...
|OOOH!|

It was the Faceless Lifeform who was currently surrounded by countless obsidian pillars stacked on top of each other to form dark towers- and there were so many that in the next moment, existence in that area began to distort and disappear!
As if nothing could be allowed in to change it.

But...the white gold flames of unraveling from the Tzar Versepiercer were too pervasive as they still entered through the gaps of existence, breaking down the dark towers and coming to land on the Faceless Lifeform as his body was soon aflame!
CRACK!

Horridly, in the next moment, the weavings of existence nearby collapsed, the white gold flames all surging to become concentrated into a single point of singularity near the Faceless Lifeform before this singularity underwent one final blast of incinerating explosion.
This time, the flames hung around and released a heavy light of radiation.
The sandy gold makeup of this domain was aflame, along with the shattered dredges of wheels stretched out all around.

The Sages and Yoo Jin were silent as they observed the body of the Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform simmering in these flames, its body holding streaks of burn marks all over as its right hand...was placed on its chest- covering a small scorched gash that nearly cut open the obsidian suit of this being!
It didn't have an expression.
It didn't have a face.
And yet at this moment, they could feel its palpable rage amidst the scorching waves of radiation that remained burning all around.
|You.
Insignificant.
Dredges.
Of.
COMPLEXITY!|
BOOOM!
Maddening black radiance erupted from this truly complex creature.
Noah looked at it from afar as the biggest thing he confirmed was the utility of the Tzar Versepiercers- the fact that they could actually affect a Source Complexity with their power!
The other thing confirmed was that truly, any Source Complexity entity was not someone easy to take down.

Along with its enraged intent, the Faceless Lifeform brought its hands in front of its chest as if it were praying, a hymn beginning to resound from it that caused a sensation of unease to spread out!
"Continue!"
The Sages and Yoo Jin no longer sat still at the emergence of such a complexity as their Sources struck out.
And yet behind the Faceless Lifeform, an illusion of a black flame began to form and gradually become more real.
A black flame.

The moment such a thing arose, even Noah felt a sense of revulsion as if he smelled something that had gone bad, his expression turning serious as he waved his hands to reveal another three Tzar Versepiercers.
Tam of the Singed saw this scene as he trembled, falling onto his knees as he gazed towards the three Versepiercers with fanaticism.
"Let everything be bathed in scorching light of fire..."
He uttered out the words reverentially as by the time others observed the Tzar Versepiercers, it was when Noah was throwing them towards the Faceless Lifeform!
This time, the Sages and Yoo Jin did not falter with trepidation, using this chance to unleash their heaviest weavings as unique complexities lit up the nearby weavings of existence.
They were followed by the simultaneous emergence of three massive wooden Wheels of Existence.

Wooden wheels that then vibrated and shattered into multiple explosions, their focus entirely centered around a creature that was praying at this moment as he was drowned in scorching white gold flames!
Alongside this, the Sources of 6 other entities of the same stature came down to bombard this being as everything joined together to take down the grandeur of a single Source.
This alone was enough to show the indefatigability of a Source- the difficulty in ever getting past its defenses and actually wounding it!
But one man had the means to make it possible.
And he didn't even have to wait before he could hear woeful screeches amidst the raging flames!

chapters.title: Chapter 3524 The Indefatigability of a Source! IV
paragraphs: Woeful screeches.

This was truly what was heard as by the time the scalding flames and attacks from 6 sources displayed the scene around the Faceless Lifeform, one could see the humanoid body of this entity...distorted and leaking.
Leaking.

Half of its body had ballooned outwards as the black suit was shredded, black mass oozing out as in the surroundings, the white gold flames seemingly came alive and became filled with trillions of Runes that caused these flames to burn everything spilling out!
|Ridiculous.|

A booming intent echoed out from the Faceless Lifeform even as the contents of its weavings spilled out uncontrollably, surging flames devouring it all as something unfathomable was occurring to its Source!
|RIDICULOUS!|

He roared out his intent heavily once more as the white bar on his head had a portion melted, even more parts of his source becoming exposed as in the next instant, white gold flames erupted and sank into his body as erupted in a blaze.
These white gold flames...were not Noah.
Nor were they under his control.

They seemed to be from the surrounding weavings of existence itself as they concentrated themselves on the Source of the Faceless Lifeform, burning away everything it stood for as it screeched miserably!
As its weavings were quite literally being scorched away, it continued to screech as a scattered intent echoed from it.
|Unworthy!|
WU!
|Detestable!|
WU!
BOOM!
Amidst the sizzling and scorching weavings of existence, silence slowly seeped in.
The surroundings were filled with waves of radiation of flames, but they did not burn anyone here as they all simply observed this shocking happening.

After a few seconds, the wriggling black mass, the suit it was contained in, and even the white bar of brilliance that veiled everything...all of it became reduced into a single central point surrounded by white gold flames.

After some time, the flames lost their terrifying intensity and burned silently, slowly giving way to embers as where the Faceless Lifeform used to be, a glimmer of stellar black light floated serenely.
Noah's body began to walk across this space filled with burning radiation before he soon arrived where the Faceless Lifeform used to stand.
Apart from the revolting stench being wiped away gradually, a stellar obsidian spinning singularity could be seen.
Noah reached out to grab it as a dazzling illusory eye unfurled above him, everything being analyzed at a rapid pace as he became surprised at what he read!
|A Purified Source Pearl has been obtained.|

|Burned and purified by the Embers of the Wheel, the weavings of this Source are sufficient enough to form and be consumed- their utility being feasible in increasing one's own complexity. The Purified Source Pearl only has the basal intricacies of a Source, nothing regarding the path of this source or this identity has been retained.|

|After the purification of the Path of Pioneers or others below Source Complexity, too few weavings remain to be sufficient enough to leave behind anything. Only the purification of a Source or above is capable of leaving something behind.|

Details and observations were made that caused Noah's eyes to light up, and he grasped this shocking Purified Source Pearl that seemed to have been formed naturally from the burning of a Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform as he spoke out.
"Today, in the Megalos Ynnere, hours after the Change...a Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform fell for the first time under your hands."
He spoke towards the Sages and Yoo Jin as their gazes were complex. Yes, their Sources bombarded the enemy, but if there weren't those massive explosions from the very breaking of the Wheel...
"Well, probably the first one that. Who knows what is going on in other Frequencies...but, are you all ready?"
He turned towards Yoo Jin especially as her body still glimmered with Apomonosi.
His questioning caused her visage that was showing tired eyes to question.
"Ready for...?"
She had a foreboding sensation.
A sensation that came out to be true in the next moment as Noah smiled brilliantly amidst the backdrop of radiation!

"One Source Complexity Faceless Lifeform has been hunted, but there are still many more. Before they start grouping up and realize one has already died, we have to move quickly. I already have the next target chosen."
They had just barely crossed the tribulation of a single Faceless Lifeform, but the Burnt One seemed to only be getting started as he wanted to pull them to another one!

The Source Complexity entities looked at each other before they prepared themselves, ready to follow the man who threw bombs that exploded as if the Wheel of Existence itself was breaking toward his enemies.
As they did this.
In the Infiniverse Megalos.
Noah's main body waved his hands and took out a stellar black pearl, bringing it before Ruination and the Infiniverse Megalos as he asked expectantly.
"Tell me you can multiply something at the level of a Source."
WAA!
The Purified Source Pearl floated towards Ruination as she grasped it carefully.

She studied it before her body erupted into crimson gold flames, a golden rune flashing on her forehead as she radiated terrifying waves of complexity- her hands grasping the Purified Source Pearl as she forcefully made a motion to tear it apart!
BOOM!
An explosion of complexity resounded as, in the next moment, two Purified Source Pearls of the same size and magnificence as the first one could be seen.
The light of Ruination continued to surround them, but nothing changed this time as Ruination bowed her head.
"Only once, Master."
"Once is more than enough."
Noah patted her head with appreciation as he took the two Purified Source Pearls in his hands.
Something stemming from a collapsed source- broken and Purified by the Embers of the Flame of the Wheel itself!
"Let us see how close we can get to the 81st Severing."

He grasped such wonders in his hands as within him, the Severed Weavings of the Singed contained in his Atlas vibrated gloriously as they were about to be taken to a level no other weavings were even close to reaching!

chapters.title: Chapter 3525 Precipice I
paragraphs: He held two Purified Source Pearls in his hands.
And the target weavings to undergo severings burned within his Atlas in the form of a golden flame.
The Singed!
Noah's gaze was resolute as he looked towards the figure of the Infiniverse Megalos Body and Ruination.
"Let's see this one through. I will start with the Globules of Blood of Pioneers saved and multiplied so far."
The Globules of Blood of Pioneers.
Through the time dilation between here and Hell Terra Firma, a much longer period of time passed as his body within that Purgatory continued to make strides.

He obtained more Pioneers, and he obtained more Globules of Blood of Pioneers as he even set up a medical unit where Pioneers could frequent and receive medication that allowed them to very quickly recover their lost blood!
And since Ruination had returned, she could also multiply these Globules.
After all, she was just able to multiply something stemming from a Source, so why not a Pioneer?

Ruination nodded towards her Master as while she finished assimilating the latest Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel; she continued to divide her attention and do many things as she released 180 dazzling different colored drops of blood toward Noah. Each one represented a different portion of a Path of a Pioneer, and they flowed towards Noah before a suction force emanated from his Atlas of Existence and began devouring them hungrily one by one.
|The Weavings of the Singed have undergone their 55th Severing by utilizing 9 Globules of Blood of Pioneers.|
|The Weavings of the Singed have undergone their 56th Severing by utilizing 9 Globules of Blood of Pioneers.|
The number was one that caused Noah's eyes to flash coldly, but he was prepared for it.
First, a single Globule was required for Severing. As he went higher, 3 globules were required. And now, 9 were required just a single Severing!
That didn't cause him to feel deterred, but it made him that much more expectant.
The harder something was for him to achieve, the more ridiculous the result would be.
So he didn't bat an eye as the Globules of Blood of Pioneers continued to disappear, and more prompts cascaded over his eyes.
|The Weavings of the Singed have undergone their 61st Severing by utilizing 9 Globules of Blood of Pioneers.|
|The Weavings of the Singed have undergone their 70th Severing by utilizing 9 Globules of Blood of Pioneers.|
HUUM!
He approached a precipice.

His body burned and radiated a shocking level of complexity as, at this point, within that Mundi of Power...the golden flame had grown so intense and pure that it began to resonate with the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel within the Infiniverse Megalos.
The Wisp that was weaving just a distance away from his main body.
|The Weavings of the Singed have undergone their 74th Severing by utilizing 9 Globules of Blood of Pioneers.|
At the 74th point, all Globules of Blood of Pioneers ran out.
Here, Noah tyrannically grasped the Purified Source Pearl and began to devour heavily from their complexity!
|The Weavings of the Singed have undergone their 75th Severing by utilizing a portion of the complexity of a Purified Source Pearl!|
The process continued.
76th. 77th. 78th. 79th. 80th Severing!
HUUUM!
In the distance, the Infiniverse Megalos Body and Ruination watched with rapt attention.

At this moment, Noah's body was surrounded by searing waves of complexity that his surroundings were being distorted, his body entirely ablaze with an unfathomable flame that seemed to have undergone countless cycles of purification until it attained a stage that very few- if any could ever hope to reach in terms of purity.
And finally.
For the last straw.
The last step!
HUUM!
A Purified Source Pearl rapidly burned and reduced in size.
The complexity of a genuine Source. Burned down and purified, but it was still that of a genuine Source.
And yet at this moment, it depleted so rapidly as if it was some common disposable resource!
Noah didn't know what ridiculous numbers of Globules of Blood of Pioneers would have been required to accomplish the 81st Severing.

What he did know was that one of the Purified Source Pearls he held...turned to ash in the next moment while the other rapidly began to reduce in size and after it had reduced to barely be the size of a single inch....
BOOM!
He felt something within him shatter.
Break.
Severed!
His body instantly dissolved as everything about him turned into white gold flames.
Within these raging flames, only the backbone and structure of the Atlas of Existence could be seen!
And Noah felt....
Oh, he felt...!
|The Severed Weavings of the Singed have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of the Singed has opened.|
|The True Severed Singed Flame of Existence has been born.|
He felt waves of unfathomable heat coursing through him.
If he said he felt like a sun, it wouldn't be an apt description.
The heat he felt seemed so pristine. So inviolable!
The Pathway to the True Source of the Singed.
The birth of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence!
HUUM!
In the distance, the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel born within the Infiniverse Megalos danced uniquely as if it had found something similar to it.
|Within the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence, genuine Embers of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence burn gloriously.|
The glorious amalgamations of flames that was Noah Osmont spoke out at this moment.
What was that which every single creature in the Megalos and the Expanse spoke of? It was purity.
That Purity kept the flow of the Wheel going.
But purity had many definitions.

Today, Noah took his own path of purity as he truly severed the weavings of the Singed, and he then proceeded to undergo 81 rounds of severings and purifications on the other side, he attained...genuine Embers of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence within the depths of his own being!

chapters.title: Chapter 3526 Precipice II
paragraphs: He opened a Pathway to a True Source of the Singed.
He attained the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence!
But what exactly was it, and what could be done with it?!
Noah looked within the depths of himself as everything was gradually made clear.

|The True Severed Singed Flame of Existence is an extremely pure flame that contains the Embers of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence itself, and thus, it now carries the quality of purification. Your True Severed Singed Flame of Existence is capable of purifying the complexity of other weavings and is estimated to be capable of Severing your other Weavings of Existence up to the 27th level with their current complexity. The issue of limited resources would have been raised if this Flame was not backed by your weavings of mana and infinity that make the issue of limited resources null and void.|
A ridiculous prompt came.
One that Noah almost laughed at as he felt the simmering scorching flames within him!
But this was just the start.

|The True Severed Singed Flame of Existence is a tool of purification and destruction. Against enemies, its more destructive side can be released in the form of Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence that latch onto a target's weaving of Existence regardless of their complexity, and they begin to eat away at this complexity while strengthing your own. The Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame cannot be extinguished on their own; the condition of their disappearance is contingent on your collapse of existence and weavings entirely. Against those with much greater complexity than you, the rate of extraction of their Complexity will be tremendously reduced, but even they will not be capable of extinguishing the Embers unless they locate and collapse the entirety of your weavings of existence.|
An utterly horrific capability bloomed.
Arguably one of the most stupendous and ridiculous things Noah had ever attained!
It was so over the top and ridiculous that it should have taken Centerpoint!
But even as ridiculous as it was, Noah's eyes still came back to what seemed to be the relatively calm first feature of purification.
The feature that allowed him to Sever up to the 27th Severing of his other weavings of Existence.
He kept going back to this because saw this to be more ridiculous than anything else.
Severing required complexity and weavings.
A single Globule was sufficient for a single Severing in the early stages.
It was limited in nature.
But what Noah held was not limited.
He held Infinite Mana.

So even though the act of Severing needed an arduous amount of complexity, the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence that could sever and increase complexity paired with his Infinite Mana...meant he could infinitely increase his complexity!
Well, up to the 27th Severing, anyway.
For now.
If the round and simple number of 100 Severed Weavings were taken, close to 3,000 Globules of Blood of Pioneers would be required to bring all of them to the 27th Severing.
Even now, after Ruination's efforts of multiplying them, he had 180 collected!

Attaining the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence- attaining the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed...gave way to overcoming all those needed resources as Noah felt his burning flame and roared out with indefatigable tyranny.
"Sever it all. SEVER IT ALL!"
HUUUM!
Kuklos.
Outerversal.
Ingeniare.
Megalos. Conceputal. Infinity. Mana. Quintessence. Protagonist. Tyranny. Uncertainty. Apomonosi. Versality...
Every single thing under Noah's banner was made a target!

And within a certain Mundi of Power, an extremely dense flame rose and proliferated, spreading out madly as around Noah's figure, a stellar mountain of flames erupted out and burned brilliantly while his weavings stayed at the very center.

And this mountain of flames began to burn and purify multiple concepts simultaneously as it had an endless source of power to pull from, and it could continue severing for all concepts up to a certain benchmark!
And so it did.
BOOM!
Bursts of explosions of complexity constantly erupted from Noah with every passing second as over a hundred concepts underwent severings.
And for each passing second, they underwent even more rounds of severings!
|The Weavings of Ingeniare have undergone their 10th Severing by utilizing the burning Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence.|
|The Weavings of Outerversal have undergone their 11th Severing by utilizing the burning Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence.|
|The Weavings of Relativity have undergone their 13th Severing by utilizing the burning Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence.|
|The Weavings of Entropy have undergone their 14th Severing by utilizing the burning Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence.|
One by one.
Simultaneously.
A burning complexity with an endless source of energy burned and severed other complexities, creating a sequence of events that others could only look at in sheer amazement and horror.
If was doing something like this, then what the hell would other complexities out there have to do just to be capable of competing?!
He had many separate weavings that made him who he was.
Previously, they were selected and severed based on the resources available.
Less than a dozen were focused on to have a few Severings.
Cheats was in second place after the Singed.
Others were all very low in their severings!
And even then, Noah had the complexity that he did.
So when over a hundred concepts collectively began rounds of Severings 27 times, with every single severing adding to form a more complex being...just how tremendous would the change be?
The density and color of the flaming mountain became unfathomably more intense as time passed.
Outside of the Infiniverse Megalos.
In the vastness of the Megalos Ynnere.
A Faceless Lifeform that was moving with great speed suddenly came to a halt as he received a certain thread of knowledge.
The one he and many others knew as Maraxana...his weavings had collapsed!
Silently.
Out of nowhere.
And as this Faceless Lifeform received such news, a heavy stellar black source of isolation erupted all around him in this brief period of shock- Apomonosi erupting out daringly!

sentences.text: He opened a Pathway to a True Source of the Singed.
He attained the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence!
But what exactly was it, and what could be done with it?!
Noah looked within the depths of himself as everything was gradually made clear.
|The True Severed Singed Flame of Existence is an extremely pure flame that contains the Embers of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence itself, and thus, it now carries the quality of purification.

Your True Severed Singed Flame of Existence is capable of purifying the complexity of other weavings and is estimated to be capable of Severing your other Weavings of Existence up to the 27th level with their current complexity.
The issue of limited resources would have been raised if this Flame was not backed by your weavings of mana and infinity that make the issue of limited resources null and void.|
A ridiculous prompt came.
One that Noah almost laughed at as he felt the simmering scorching flames within him!
But this was just the start.
|The True Severed Singed Flame of Existence is a tool of purification and destruction.

Against enemies, its more destructive side can be released in the form of Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence that latch onto a target's weaving of Existence regardless of their complexity, and they begin to eat away at this complexity while strengthing your own.
The Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame cannot be extinguished on their own; the condition of their disappearance is contingent on your collapse of existence and weavings entirely.

Against those with much greater complexity than you, the rate of extraction of their Complexity will be tremendously reduced, but even they will not be capable of extinguishing the Embers unless they locate and collapse the entirety of your weavings of existence.|
An utterly horrific capability bloomed.
Arguably one of the most stupendous and ridiculous things Noah had ever attained!
It was so over the top and ridiculous that it should have taken Centerpoint!
But even as ridiculous as it was, Noah's eyes still came back to what seemed to be the relatively calm first feature of purification.
The feature that allowed him to Sever up to the 27th Severing of his other weavings of Existence.
He kept going back to this because saw this to be more ridiculous than anything else.
Severing required complexity and weavings.
A single Globule was sufficient for a single Severing in the early stages.
It was limited in nature.
But what Noah held was not limited.
He held Infinite Mana.

So even though the act of Severing needed an arduous amount of complexity, the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence that could sever and increase complexity paired with his Infinite Mana...meant he could infinitely increase his complexity!
Well, up to the 27th Severing, anyway.
For now.
If the round and simple number of 100 Severed Weavings were taken, close to 3,000 Globules of Blood of Pioneers would be required to bring all of them to the 27th Severing.
Even now, after Ruination's efforts of multiplying them, he had 180 collected!

Attaining the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence- attaining the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed...gave way to overcoming all those needed resources as Noah felt his burning flame and roared out with indefatigable tyranny.

SEVER IT ALL!"

Outerversal.

chapters.title: Chapter 3527 Inconceivable! I
paragraphs: As he received the feedback of one of his people dying, the whole area he was in was enveloped with a dreadful black light of Isolation!
One that cut off all connection to outside weavings.
The moment this occurred, the white bar of brilliance on the Faceless Lifeform shone fiercely as it looked around.
Was this the reason why one of them had died?
Were these the culprits?!
|Show yourselves!|
His voice boomed out as, in the next moment, the auras of multiple Source Complexity entities unfolded. The Sages they were looking for!
|You all...?!|
Two words that expressed its disbelief.
Even if it were these Sages, they would not have been able to kill one of them- and especially in such a short period of time at that!
But moments later, another two entities appeared.
One had distinct flames around his body as he should hold tremendous dignity and stature, and yet he held a gaze of utter shock and incredulity as he looked towards another being.
Tam of the Singed was connected to Noah as even if there wasn't major feedback, he was sensitive to the weavings of the Singed.
After all, Noah's attachment to the weavings of the Singed stemmed from the Path of Tam himself.
But at this moment, what Tam felt from Noah was more than just even the stature of an Origin Singed.
He felt as if on that day eons ago.
Before he became a Singed, he had stumbled into an area between Frequencies where he was burnt by terrifying Embers of the Flame of the Wheel.
This shows how his existence was slowly transformed into who he is now.
At this moment, he remembered that sensation of those terrifying Embers...from Noah.
As if he contained the Embers of the Flame of the Wheel inside of his body!
Tam dropped to his knees the moment they arrived here all Sources paid attention to this.
To this Pioneer who looked towards Noah's figure that was currently surrounded by a silent white gold flame as in the next moment, he uttered unfathomable words.
"Master, are you actually...an extension of the Wheel of Existence itself?!"
Astonishing words that caused the Sages to nearly stumble while Yoo Jin looked back in surprise.
What the hell was this Singed saying now?
An Extension of the Wheel of Existence itself?!
Such a power or concept would be too unfathomable even for Source Complexity entities!
Utterly inconceivable!
But why would he say this?
All Sources here heard these words.
So did the Faceless Lifeform.
It looked at the signature of the Singed between Noah and Tam as it roared out.
|So it was you who killed Maraxana! You have hidden yourselves deep!|
"Oh?"
Noah's eyes shine sharply at such a statement.
"It seems you all have a rather quick method of communication...we will have to move even faster. Attack!"
His voice fully held a commanding presence as he spoke to the Source Complexity entities.
The Sages and Yoo Jin moved as their complexities erupted out.
But the Faceless Lifeform ignored the budding Sources and kept his gaze on the two Singed. It knew one thing crystal clear.
Maraxana had just died to these beings. Its power was not too different from Maraxana.
Thus, if it did not break this enclosure and allow the others to arrive here, its fate may likely be the same.
So...
|Source Combustion.|
Noah's gaze rapidly changed as he waved his hands toward Yoo Jin and the Sages.
"Do not resist."
His weavings covered them entirely as in the next moment, the massive stature of the Faceless Lifeform had half of its body combust into black flames that covered everything nearby.

The black flames carried an inconceivable radiance of complexity that sought to latch onto and taint all weavings of existence, but they came at a heavy cost as half of the Source of the Faceless Lifeform burned!
This entity was terrifyingly decisive. And for a reason!

The moment the flames erupted, they covered everything nearby as the barrier of the Source of Apomonosi cried out as if it were dry wood, burning with black flames while crying out as it instantly became torn.
|You are good. But I...am far older than you can even imagine.|
The booming intent of the burning Faceless Lifeform echoed out as in the surroundings, only Noah's visage remained unburned!
All weavings of Apomonosi became shredded.
And yet Noah remained unblemished amidst all of this.
As if these terrifying dark flames could not stop him!
In the next moment.
WAP! WAP! WAP!

Terrifying auras of Source Complexity began to arrive in this region surrounded by tenebrous flames, their white bands looking towards the Source Complexity that had burned its Source as one could see from their faceless gazes...pain and sorrow.
Moments later, a flash of golden brilliance seethed as a bejeweled Persephael appeared, her fair, bare white feet shining as she also looked grimly towards the burning Faceless Lifeform.
For this entity to achieve what it did was not without consequences.

Because at this moment, terrifying bursts of white gold flames filled with trillions of Runes descended as if they had smelled something- all of them surging towards the burning Source of the Faceless Lifeform!
This showed that his fate was sealed.
But even in such a state.
|He is responsible for my and Maraxana's death. He is harboring the Sages somewhere, and has another Singed with him. He may be a designated Target within these Megalos.|
As his Source burned!
As excruciating pain crossed his existence, knowing he was about to be extinguished!
He was calm throughout all of it as he at least knew he had shed light on this entity bathed by white gold flames- an entity who could actually ignore the effects of his black flames.
For that to be possible, even among Singed, he had to have an extremely high and critical position.
|Please, do not let my death be in vain. I did it all for the mission.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3528 Inconceivable! II
paragraphs: He did it all for the mission! After he said this, the intensity of the unfathomable white gold flames filled with complex runes that were by the trillions entirely bathed his figure and scorched his source.
It was a heavy sacrifice, but in his perspective, he had achieved an even more tremendous gain!
And truly, he had prevented Noah's plan of slowly taking out one Source Complexity entity after another.
But when plans change...
"Sometimes things change for the better."
Noah's gaze was serene as he looked around.
At the terrifying figures of at least twice a dozen Faceless Lifeforms here.
Before, each one was radiating a terrifying red glow of danger, but at this moment, this deeply red hue had lost its terrifying radiance and become a lukewarm red.
The complexity of a Source was still something that could not be underestimated.
But at this moment, after just attaining the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed- a single Path at that, Noah already neared the complexity of normal Source Complexity entities!
He was not entirely fearful as he stared at the Faceless Lifeforms around him, his gaze even meeting the eyes of a furious Persephael as her intent boomed out.
"What thing are you?"
WUU!
Above her, a terrifying eye embedded in a golden wheel bloomed and spun, almost as if a terrifying authority of the Wheel of Existence itself was reading the records of existences within its Spokes!

And yet around Noah, the raging white gold flames of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence buzzed with friction as they were actually capable of obscuring the gaze and terrifying eye connected to the Wheel conjured by Persephael.
She was more than surprised.
"What. Thing. Are. You?!"
She asked again, this time with fearsome power stretching out and sealing all existence nearby!
Noah looked at her and the Faceless Lifeforms as he sighed in reply.
"I am but a humble farmer."
HUUM!

"But I can never seem to be left alone. There is always one world-ending and existence-shattering event, one after another. So I occasionally have to make a move to clear some trash who dare to dream too high."
Trash who dare to dream too high.
Such words echoed out.
Such words resounded!
Such words caused the mouth of Persephael to twitch before moments later, she covered her mouth and laughed.
"Oh, you motherfucker."
WAA!

"There are some dredges that always have a knack for saying the wrongest things at the most inopportune times. You have unbelievably fallen so deep into this category that you cannot climb out. But I am patient. Before torturing you for the cycles to come, I will ask you to make my work easy and unveil where the rats that call themselves Sages went. How they have been able to evade my gaze within these small Megalos so far. Make it easy, and your torment may be cut short a few cycles."
She spoke earnestly.
She held a terrifying sense of power and beauty as if she was truly trying to help Noah in the eons to come!

And Noah looked at her with cold eyes as he replied. "When did you stop being a Watcher of the Wheelomachy? When did you become such a lesser complex piece of trash? Do the jewels all over your body try to compensate for the utter worthlessness your existence has become? I'm genuinely curious."
HUUUM!
Existence tumbled and trembled as utterly hateful words were uttered.
The visage of Persephael seemed to be vibrating and seething before she closed her eyes and spoke out slowly.
"Hoo...go capture his weavings and find his Source before my rage entirely erases him."
She controlled herself. No matter what, she had grasped a Source and done much more with it.
At her words, the Faceless Lifeform buzzed as their sources flared, but Noah looked at all of them and shook his head while asking.
"Will you all have time for that when you are on fire?"
Will they have time?
As he said this, Noah raised his hand and observed the calm and silent white gold flames burning on him.
The flame that held Embers of the Flame of the Wheel of Existence!
The True Severed Singed Flame of Existence.
The Pathway to the True Source of the Singed!
Towards such a flame, Noah spoke to it tyrannically.
"Rage."
WUU!
"Rage against the weavings of the unknown."
"Rage...until everything is turned to ash."
BOOM!
Like an erupting tongue of flames, white gold wisps shot out in all directions and went towards the Faceless Lifeforms and Persephael!
Flames that could not be avoided.
Flames that could not be extinguished.
Persephael saw their brilliance as she harrumphed, her body becoming covered with an impenetrable layer of golden radiance that when the flame neared...
SAA!
Passed through it seamlessly to land on her body as an instant later, her entire visage was aflame with raging white gold flames!
"WHAT!"
She was utterly furious at this as her Source exploded out, covering her body entirely as a golden sea erupted behind her and gushed down over her body to extinguish the flames.
And yet...
The flames continued to burn around her.
"Preposterous!"

Genuine fury rose in her eyes as she focused on these burning flames and sought to isolate them from her body, but no matter what she did, they remained on her. And she wasn't the only one as at this moment, the Faceless Lifeforms who had erupted with their own unique Sources found that they could not evade the flames from landing on their bodies, and once they were there, they could not be extinguished!
Furthermore, they felt a prickling sensation of heat from their very own source and weavings of existence as these burning flames...actually began siphoning off and eating away at their Sources!
Persephael turned towards Noah in utter rage as her looks alone sought to crumple and collapse his weavings, her eyes piercing as her voice thundered out.
"You...you are not among those who should have attained or even come close to an Undeniable Telos Source! What are you?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 3529 Inconceivable! III
paragraphs: An Undeniable Telos Source!

Something only Source Complexities would understand as within the bounds of the Source Complexity of Existence, there were three distinctions: one could be A Lesser Source Entity, A Greater Source Entity, or a Prime Source Entity.
Lesser, Greater, Prime!
And yet among these distinction, Persephael spoke of an Undeniable Telos Source while golden flames crackled and burned around her!
And before Noah's eyes...
|25 Source Complexity entities have been afflicted with the Embers of the True Severed Singed Flame of Existence.|
|24 have been designated as powerful Lesser Source Entities, and 1 is an early Greater Source Entity wielding an unknown level of power. Caution is recommended while dealing with the latter.|
Caution was recommended.
The terrifying Faceless Lifeforms that he had been facing so far had all been just at the initial stage of source complexity.
Lesser Sources!
Even after he attained the true severing of the Singed and opened a Pathway to a True Source, these entities still remained just a tiny bit higher in complexity than he.
This was what eons of hard work from them had amounted to.
Noah's advancement was rapid as he was catching up to millions and potentially billions of years of growth and hardship from beings that lived far longer than he did!
For him, it was feasible.
So even as Persephael had a heavy expression at the flames she could not put out, he was fearless while gazing towards her as he replied.
"In the countless weavings of existence, there are many things that even a Greater Source would not know about. You-"
"I've had enough of your sophistry." Covered in flames, the visage of Persephael roared out as she raised her hands to halt the Faceless Lifeforms.
The damage they were receiving was minimal every single second, but the flames did still burn around them.
They could feel small threads of their complexity leaking out, but it was still a minor, manageable amount so far!
"My Source is that of Lapidekinesis."
HUUM!
Her voice was scintillating as her bejeweled figure began to shimmer with even more golden jewels and gemstones around her.

Noah wanted to tell her that he knew that apart from the Faceless Lifeform whose weavings of existence were not compatible with his, he had already received multiple prompts about how the process of crystallization of the weavings of Persephael was occurring!
It was one of the reasons why he was still here, after allowing them to burn with the Embers of his flames.
But he looked ahead silently as she continued.
"It is not a type of Undeniable Telos Source yet, but it is ny singular Source. I have raised it ever since I was young."
TING!
Around her body, a multicolored gemstone bloomed and covered her whole figure, even her whole body crystallizing to become a gem-like!
And yet, even after all of this...
She looked at herself as the white gold flames placed on her still burned even her gem like form!
They burned through the massive multicolored gem surrounding her!
She sighed at this as she turned her head towards Noah.

"I do not know how you managed to achieve the effect of an Undeniable Telos Source. If you truly did have it, its lethality would not be this slow, and many of us here would have already died. It leads me to believe you must have caught onto something that even you do not understand. And yet we know nothing about you. This is an oversight and a danger to the mission as at this moment, I have to ensure your capture and tracing of weavings. To find the Sages, and to ensure that all of you and this trace of Undeniable Telos Source is contained."

The moment she finished speaking, flat planes of multicolored gems erupted around him and enclosed him in layers upon layers of weavings, and he saw his reflection by the thousands on these multicolored flat gem surfaces!
Persephael floated down and came inches away as she looked inside.

"An Infinite Crystal Gem Prison no weavings can leave. Any weavings sent out simply reflect back. Any action to dissipate your weavings of existence are reflected and reversed. Give it a try to see if I am lying. But you...you truly think you are someone special in the grand scheme of things, don't you?"
WAA!
Persephael touched the Infinite Crystal Gem Prison as white gold flames burned silently around her body!
Her gaze was cold as she continued.

"You talk sophistry and claim that you are a mere farmer to bolster yourself up as some mysterious being whose life was just disrupted. You...I have seen many variations of people like you over the eons. A lot of the time, what you have is genuine. Because truly, you have likely grasped a pathway or the start of an Undeniable Telos Source you can just barely control to be able to do this."
She raised her gem like hand as she saw the flames slowly chipping away at her gems and jewels as she continued.

"You could have isolated yourself and continued growing your source. Likely become someone that even I would fear. But many of those like you...get this wild sense of confidence. This feeling as if the entire makeup of the weavings of existence falls in line to your being. You feel special, as if everything revolves around you. When you meet enemies, you think you will not die. That you have the strength or safeguard to overcome them no matter how powerful they are. After all, you are meant for great things, yes?"
Persephael's gaze was so unfathomably cold.
She looked Noah straight into his eyes, golden clusters of jewels and gems erupting behind her to form wings that then proceeded to shoot outwards!
They released clusters of gems in all directions, more and more being produced every single second as they continued to spread out.
Across the Megalos.

"I have seen many variations of people like you across the Frequencies. Even now, you listen to me calmly as you are wholly confident that everything is somehow in the palm of your hands. Even as I spread by gems to search for the resonance of your contained weavings in this prison."
